la ༄/ /snga ga yo gter (5 i skor gos bsgrigs/ guri dzinga ga 'dzin yongs bos chubabasnganardorjedran pod gsum pa'o// 32 tshe
༄༅/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod so gnyis pa bzhugs so//
༄tshocaX caXmanga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal mchog ni/ bod rab byung brgyad pa'i me mo lug spyi lo 1487lor mnga' ris glo bo ma thang du sku 'khrungs/ de yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas mdzad pa'i rgyud 'bum dkar chag las/ spyir skyes bu 'di nyid ni gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita chen po/ bzhon pa dang 'jol ber la sogs pa'i chos brgyad yongs su spangs pas shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug bsod snyoms pa chen po/ rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po des dngos kyi lam nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don bla na med pa mdzad cing / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po che'i skor tsho 'byed pa'ang rnam dpyod 'di kho na che zhing / lung gi rgyun la'ang bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab zhes gsung 'dug pas de las ngo sprod gzhan mi dgos pas bzhag gcung legs ldan rdo rje dang lhan du bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang gsang sgrom nas rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / 'on phu stag tshang nas drag po dbu dgu'i chos skor sogs gter chos dang / sdom gsum rnam nges sogs brtsams chos mang du yod kyang dang sdang cher bzhugs par mi snang / slob ma'i gtso bo gcung legs ldan rdo rje dang 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs sogs sa dkar rnying gsum gyi gdan sa 'dzin pa grangs las 'das pa byung ba'o/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing 'brug spyi
༄tsho/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo brag chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam so gnyis pa'i nang bzhugs/ rig 'dzin yongs 'dus pod gsum pa rgyab chos skor la/ grub dgon 'jigs med chos grags kyis bsgrigs pa'i rig 'dzin yong 'dus las bstan pa rmad byung ma'i dbang sgrub thabs bltas chog bkod pa/27 (1) spros bral bde chen ma'i dbang sgrub thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa/23 (55) sin dhu rgya mtsho che ba'i dbang sgrub thabs bltas chog bkod pa dang phrin las bcas 11 (101) sin dhu rgya malhango chung ba'i dbang sgrub thabs bltas chog ba'ekhod pa/15 (123) bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang sgrub thabs gsal byed bkod pa/20 (153) gu ru skurdzon tan gter mdzod kyi las byang nag 'gros su bkod pa/16 (193) 'chi med ye shes 'od mchog gi dbang bltas chog bkod pa/14 (225) gter srung ma gza' rdor gsum mchod thabs/1 (253) gnod sbyin bskul ba dang lo rgyus/4(255)gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/7 (263) dmag dpon gyi srog gtad pad+ma dbang gi gter ma/3 (277) btsan ya ba skya bdun gyi khyi 'gyed/2 (283) gnod sbyin gyi gsol kha'i sgrub
thabs / 3 (287) gnod sbyin chen po t+pū nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid la brten te sgrub pa'i skor/4 (293) rin chen rnam rgyal gyis bsgrigs pa'i gnod sbyin ya ba rkya bdun gyi sgrub thabs srog gtad kyi cho ga 'dod pa'i re skong /8 (301) sle lung bzhad rdor gyis mdzad pa'i dregs pa'i yang rje gnod sbyin tsit+ta dmar po mched bdun gyi srog gtad kyi rim pa rdo rje'i 'khrul 'bar/8 (317) sle lung bzhad rdor gyis mdzad pa'i ging chen bshan pa dmar po'i dam bsgrag rdo rje'i mna' tshig7 (333) sle lung bzhad rdor gyis mdzad pa'i gter bdag 'bar ba spun bdun gyi las tshogs rdo rje'i gsang tshig10(347) sle lung bzhad rdor gyis mdzad pa'i btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun gyi bsreg pa me'i las sbyor gyi cho ga reg 'joms me zhun/8 (367) sle lung bzhad rdor gyis mdzad pa'i dgra lha'i rgyal po gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po ya ba skya bdun gyi bskang gso chen mo 'dod dgu'i nyin byed/19 (383) 'jigs med gling bas mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar pe'i gsol kha rgyas pa mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i gter byon rtsa ba'i don rgya chen bkral ba dbang drag dus kyi pho nya/15(421) rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po las brtsams te lha'i zla bas dris pa'i lan gsang ba'i gter mdzod ces bya ba mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/41 (451) rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi cha lag sdom
༄tshi/ /rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las bstan pa rmad byung ma'i dbang sgrub thabs bltas chog bkod pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /oX swa stiX rnam mang 'khrul pa'i rig rtsal la/ /rnam mdzesagazigs mo'i mdongs mtha' ngom/ /rnam pa du ma'i gar bsgyur mkhan/ /rnam 'dusa'adren byed dpyid der 'dud/ /de yang zab chosabaka' brgyad yerdzongs 'dusasam rig 'dzin yongs 'dusalas gsol 'debs bstan pa rmad byung gi sgrub thabs dbang dang 'brel pa'i dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la/ sbyor ba yerdzo byad bshamasapa ni/ sgrub dkyil rdul tshon ras brisabasdu na tshom bu sogs bkod pa'i dbusasu mazhi'i khar rnam bum rgyan ldan/ gsang rdzas bdud rtsi ka pā la rdzas ldan/ 'og gi lha dbang gi tsaka li tshangs ba rigs tsaka rdo rje me long rdor dril/dbu rgyan cod paṇa sogs dang / lcags phur dar nag brgyan pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbusasu bkod/ sman gtor rak+ta/ phyi nang mchod pa sogs mthong brgyud bzhin bshams/ sprosan rgyan bkod sogs kyi sprad/ sta gon du dgosapa'i yo byad rnam kyang tshogs par bgyis/ ngag 'don gyi rims pa ni/ brgyud gsol nas gnas yo byin rlabs sogs rang lugs ltar bya/ skyabs 'gro ni/ na 31ljoX bde garo|gas ma ṭa/sa 'dus pa bla ma'i khru/ljoX sangs rgyas bye1sa dang dge 'dun rang bzhin laljoX bdag dang 'a11 ba drug gi sems can rnams4༷༷ 'di gno/nga byang
'tshi/ /chub bar du skyabs su mchi4༷༷ sems bskyed ni/ e ma hoX 'gro ba ma lus kun gyi don ched du spoX bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba kun bsgrub nas4༷༷ 'phrin las rnam bzhi gang la gang 'dul gyis4༷༷ 'gro kun byang chub mchog tu bsgral bar bgyi'ogaX yan lag bcu pa'i tshogs bsags ni/ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs pa'i yi ge las4༷༷ 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i tshul gyis spros4༷༷ sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad dang spoX rigs 'dzin grub pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa yigaX bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol4༷༷ nyi zla pad+ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs4༷༷ lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal 'o(spoXdngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod bzhes4༷༷ rang bzhin bcas pa'i 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags4༷༷ theg gsum lam zhugs sgrub la rje yid rang spoX sdom gsum smin grol chos 'khor bskor
du gsolagaX mya ngan 'da' bzhed de dag bzhugs gsol 'debs4༷༷ sgo gsum dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngogaX yang dag ye shes rdo rje gsum thob therdzogazhiX tshad med sgom pa ni/ e ma hoX sems can khams gsum ma lus bde bar ldan4༷༷ de dag sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar thekhogazhiX dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i bde ldan zhing ltoX nye ring phyogs cha kun dang bral gyur cigazhiX tshogs zhing dzaXbaX hoX bdag nas yerdzo byad la bstim bde stong ngang nas yud r+ya mnyam par bzhag de nas rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyi bgegs gtor ma/ raX yaXkhaX gyisabasang / tsaXr+sha.āXhūṃX gyi byin gyisarlabs la/ 3༷1 a ka ro mu kham sarba dharmā ṇa sogs kyi bsngo la/ hūṃX hūṃXltoX dus gsum bla ma byin rlabs rmad po che4༷༷ yi dam lha mchog ting 'dzin cho 'phrul 'baraltoX mkha' 'gro dam can mthu rtsal drag po yis4༷༷ mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub bar gcod bgegs4༷༷ bden pa'i stobs kyi rdul bzhin brlag par bya4༷༷ oX sum bha ni sum bha ni hūm̐X hūm̐X phaṭa4༷༷ āt+na āt+na hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ āt+na pa ya āt+na pa ya hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ a na ya hoX bha ga wan badz+ra bi du dzā ya hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa phaṭa4༷༷ bgegs gtar phyir dor/ hūṃX hūṃX nga ni ye nas khro zhing ngang gis 'khrugazhiX phyi nang mtshams gcod khro rgyal nam mkha' gang ltoX bgegs 'dul khro bcu rol pa'i bar mtshams bltams4༷༷ de la su yang 'da' bar ma byed cigazhiX drag sngags so lnga pa bzlas4༷༷ gzhung las ma gsal yang snga 'gyur spyi bzhin byin dbab mchod rlabs sogs
༄༅/ /sngon chos dgos nges rnams rig 'dzin rdo rje grod lod rtsal gyi gu ru lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs dril sgrub yang snying bcud dril ltar kha bkang bzhiX hūm̐XltoX snang srid rnam dag bde chen gzhal yas khang ltoX rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo dbye ru gsolagaX hūṃXltoX rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lhagaX rang gsal brda' yi sgo nas mjal phyag 'tshalagaX hūṃXltoX dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs ltoX srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub par bgyi4༷༷ hūm̐XltoX chos dbyings ngang nas sku gsum ye shes lhagaX 'dir gshegs dbang bskur byin gyis brlab du gsolagaX hūm̐XltoX rang snang dbyer med lha tshogs ma lus lagaX phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul gyis bzhes su gsolagaX hūṃXltoX sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas4༷༷ sku gsum ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlabs4༷༷ oX āXhūṃXltoX hūṃXltoX bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dgongs ltoX rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags mtho 'o1 bshags4༷༷ hūṃXltoX dpang po rang dang dbyer med bstim4༷༷ tshad med stong gsal ngang la gnas4༷༷ 'di skor la bum sgrub zur du ma gsal bas bdag mdun bum gsum4༷༷ rten brten pa bskyed pa ni4༷༷ snod bcud stong gsal rdo rje gur nang du ltoX traX las pad+ma'i mchod sdong pad zlum rtseraltoX a las zla ba ma las nyi stengs sugaX hrīX dkar 'od 'phros yongs su gyur pa las4༷༷

༄༅/ /kyi4༷༷ mkha' 'gro sde brgyad sku mdog ma nges shing ltoX zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag thogs4༷༷ rus rgyan dur khrod chas brgyad rkyang brkum garaltoX zag med yar mar dga' bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs4༷༷kun kyang ye shes 'od lnga'i me klong nagaX ha ri ni sa sngags kyi gdung dbyangs lenagaX byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi ngo por bzhugs4༷༷ kun gyi gnas bzhir oX āXhūm̐X dang hrī4༷༷ de ltar gsal bas 'jig rten khams 'di gang ltoX phyi rol snang ba bla ma mkha' 'gror gsalagaX bar du sngags kyi 'ug sgra di ri rigaX nang du bdag nyid gu rur gsal ba yigaX snying nang pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dbus4༷༷ nyi zla pad steng rdo rje thod pa rtsalagaXphyogs mtshams sgrub chen brgyad chen brgyad dang rig 'dzin brgyadagaX kun kyang zhal cig phyag gnyis dkar dmar mdogazhiX rdo rje dril 'dzin 'gyings ldem mdangs dang ldanagaX dar dpyangs rus rgyan dbang gi thor chugs canagaX 'od zer lnga ldan snying gi mun pa selagaX stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi grangs4༷༷ ma lus dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam mi khyabazhiX til gyi gang bu kha bye ji bzhin dugaX kun kyang hūṃX hūṃX ha ri ni sa zhes4༷༷gsang ba'i sngags sgra rgyun mi'i chad du sgrogs4༷༷ de nyid spyi gtsug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs4༷༷ zhal cig phyag bzhi dung mdog rgyan dang ldanagaX de yi dbu gtsug sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas4༷༷ dmar gsal zhal

'tshi/ /rab 'byams kun bzang mchod pa'i sprinagaX ma lus kun khyab yid 'ong phun sum tshogs4༷༷ phyi nang gsang 'dus yongs rdzogs bsam mi khyabazhiX bla ma bde gshegs skurdzongs rdzogs lha la 'bulagaX sku gsung thugs su bdag kyang 'gyur ba dang ltoX ye shes lnga yi ngo bor smin par mdzodagaX sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spar na sa ma ye hūm̐XltoXswā hāzhiX de nas bdag dang sems can rnams ye nas gnyis su med pa lagaX rang snang 'thas pas gnyis su gzung ltoX thar med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myangs4༷༷ da ni srid pa'i mtha' grol nas4༷༷ ye shes klong du sangs rgyas phyiraltoX snying nas gdung ba'i shugs bskyed cing ltoX mos gus bskyed cing 'chi ma slong ltoX'di ltar gsol ba gdab par bya4༷༷ ā+oX āXhūṃX ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūṃXltoX chos dbyings ma skyes skye ba med pa'i ngang ltoX 'gag med rang rtsal longs spyod rdzogs skur sharaltoX thugs rje'i smon lam bsam 'das sprul pa'i sku4༷༷ sku gsum dbyer med rje btsun pad+ma 'byung ltoX 'khor du rang rtsal rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros bskoraltoX gsol ba 'debs so sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs4༷༷ bdag dang rjes 'jug rnams la thugs rjes gzung ltoX'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bde ba chen por bsgyuraltoX dbang skur byin rlabs rang grol dngos grub rtsolagaX rnal shes tshogs brgyad bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyadagaX ye shes lnga ldan ma bcos lhun gyis grubazhiX rig 'dzin

༄tshi/ /nus pa la brten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed dbang zab mo bskur bar byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song zhig gal te mi 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlag par 'gyur ro/ / hūṃX hūṃXltoX dus gsum bla ma byin rlabs rmad po che4༷༷ yi dam lha mchog ting 'dzin cho 'phrul 'baraltoX mkha' 'gro dam can mthu rtsal drag po yis4༷༷ mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub bar bcod bgegs4༷༷ bden pa'i stobs kyis rdul bzhin brlag par bya4༷༷ oX sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐X sogs drag sngags kyi bskrad gul gul dud pa dang yungs thun gyi brabs/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐XltoX lan gsum gyi srung ba'i gur khang du tshud pa'i mosapa mdzod/ 'o 'a〈sna ba ma gyur nam mkha'i sogs spyi bshad rgyas bsdusaci rigs mthar/ de lam skabs su babs pa ni/ gu ru skurdzon tan gter mdzod gyi dkyil 'khosar du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su babs pa yin te/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa la gsang sngags kyi dbang la ma brten par 'grub pa ni ma gsungs dbang ma thob par rgyud nyan bshad man ngag bsgom pa sogs byas na dpon slob gnyis ka ltung ba can du 'gyur ba'i skyon 'byung ste/ phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med / /bye ma btsir bas mar mi 'byung / /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyi/ /dbang bskur med par chos 'chad na/ /
slob dpon slob ma sho ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /ces dang / sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thos par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs brtson pa ni 'bras bu med cing rlag par 'gyur/ /zhes ma thob pa'i nyes pa gsungs/ dbang thob pa'i phan yon kyang / rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de'i skye ba bdun pa la/ /ma sgrub kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba snying po las kyang / dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur na/ /dus 'dir phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /mtho ri thar pa'i bdag po 'gyur/ /ces gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon chen po dang ldan te/ der ma zad kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ gsang sngags kyi lha'i mtshan rna bas thos pa bsgrags pa tsam gyis bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gsum du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zad par byed do/ /gzungs sngags kyi mdo lan re bsgrags pas kyang de snyed kyi phan yon dpag tu med pa ji snyed 'dzin pas na chos ston pa la mos par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon rdzogs ldan gyi dus su bskal pa'i bar du chos bshad pa bas dam pa'i chos 'jig par nye ba'i dus ngan gyi skabs 'dir/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam
༄༅/ /'chad nyan byed pa ches lhag ste/ mdo las/ gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gags par gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig bsrung ba/ /de ni de bas bsod nams ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes tshul khrims la ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du/ dge ba gzhan la'ang 'dra bar gsungs/ byams pa seṅge sgras zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang gā'i phye snyed 'jig rten gser dag gi/ /bkang ste gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /dus ngan tshe na tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa/ /de ni de bas bsod nams ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa ni bslu ba med do/ /de ltar nyams su blang ba la/ bla ma mtshan ldan bsten dgos pa ni thal 'gyur las/ mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ yon tan kun gyi 'byung khungs zhing / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gzhi 'dzin pa'o/ /rang shar las/ rdo n+de don ldan bla ma ni/ /ngang rgyu bzang zhing slob la mkhas / / dbang thob gsang sngags don la sbyor / /phyi nang bya ba thams cad shes/ /yi dam lha dang 'du 'bral med/ /ting nge 'dzin la yengs ba med/ /rdzogs chen man ngag don ldan pa'i/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud la mkhas/ /phyi nang bya ba thams cad byed/ /lta ba'i don las mi 'da' zhing / /phyi nang gsang ba'i bya ba btang / /yon tan nor bu rin chen ltar/ /mi zad gter la spyod pa'o/ /zhes mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i
bla ma ni/ 'khor ba na rgyu ba thams cad sgrol bar bya ba'i phyir na/ de bzhin gshegs pa lta bu'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul par yang bshad de/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /smre bsngags ma 'don kun dga' bo/ /nga nyid phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ bshad ma thag pa'i yon tan dang mi ldan pa'i slob dpon/ bsdoms pa dang dam tshig 'chal zhing mi shes la nga rgyal che ba/ tshe 'di'i bya ba so tshig grub mtha' slob cing slob ma'i blo gros kyi mig zum/ thar pa'i lam gtor bar byed pa dag ni bsten du mi rung bar gsungs mod/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ni shin tu dkon yang / don gyi snying po thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam phyin ci ma log par ston shes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig byung phyin/ shes bya thams cad la gzigs rgya che ba'i mkhas pa'i yon tan la sogs pa'i sgo thams cad nas ma tshang yang rung ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ yun du bsten na dge la ngang gis sbyor/ /don gyi snying po thar lam ston mkhas pa/ /gtan gyi skyabs gcig yongs 'dzin bla mar 'os/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin don 'bras 'byung bar nges/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal nas mthun
༄tshi/ /mchog gi sgo nas bsten tshul dang mi mthun dgag pa gnyis las/ ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spong ba ni/ /de dang de la 'bad de brtag ces bla ma de ji ltar dgyes pa'i thabs la 'bad pa ni nyams len gyi gtso bor dgos pa yin no/ /mi mthun phyogs dgag pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'dod pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten par bya'o/ /sdig pa'i grogs po dag la nam yang brten par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dug gsum lhag par shas che ba gang dang 'grogs pa tsam gyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba ngang gis 'grib par 'gyur ba/ lhag par dag snang dang mos gus chung ba/ phyogs lhung gi bsam pa drag pos bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi skyon brjod pa la dga' ba/ 'di dag dang 'grogs tshe rang rgyud kyi yon tan rnams shugs kyis 'grib cing / las ngan tshabs po che gsog pa la dka' tshegs med pas nges par 'dzem dgos/ khyad par grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin gyi zhen pa che/ grogs dang 'grogs na chos spong gis las ngang gis gsog cing / bla ma dang chos la log par rtog pa dang / the tshom za ba mched grogs la dag snang chung ba rnams dang 'grogs na mos gus dang yon tan sngar yod 'grib cing / gsar pa mi skye ba'i
nyes pa shin tu ches yod pas nan gyis spang dgos gsungs/ nyan byed slob ma'i mtshan nyid de ji lta bu zhig dgos snyam na/ de yang dad brtson shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa yon tan du ma zhig dang ldan dgos pa ni / rang shar gyi rgyud las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ /phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ /zhes dang rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med// dam tshig ldan zhing bsgrub la brtson/ /breng nge dung nge brtse gdung ldan/ /lhang nge lhen ne bsgom la spyod/ /slob dpon gsungs pa ji bzhin sgrub/ /dregs pa'i tshig med 'jam por smra/ /pha rol sems dang mthun par 'jug /slob dpon dang ni de bzhin gshegs/ /khyad med gcig gi tshul du byed/ /de ni slob ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes dang rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long gi rgyud las kyang / nga rgyal dregs med ngang gi shes pa dal/ /bka' drin mi bsad gsang sngags don la sbyor/ /nges par dad ldan gtong phod phun sum tshogs/ /rdo rje don ldan gsang sngags snod du gsungs/ /ces tshul de las log pa'i slob ma/ dad pa dang ngo tsha med pa/ 'khril dang snying rje chung ba rigs dang rang bzhin ngan pa/ kun spyod dang skal ba zhan/ gnyen po stobs chung bas nyon mongs pa'i mgo mi non pa/ 'gu dka' la kheng sla ba/ chos min gyi bya ba la ngang gis 'jugs te/ khong khro dang tshig brtsub
༄tshi/ /'phel ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rkang 'dren/ chos kyi bla tshong / dge 'dun gyi sgab sdum pa'i rigs can de dag la ni gsang sngags kyi gdam pa zab mo ster ba'i snod du ma gyur par gsungs/ rgyas pa ni gsang sngags gsar snying rgyud spyi dang yang sgos zab chos yongs 'dus 'dir bla ma dang slob bu mtshan nyid rtag pa dam tshig srung sdom gyi dbye ba sogs yongs 'dus gter gzhung du mang du gsungs par gzigs 'tshal/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i zab chos 'di nyid gter byung lo brgyus cung zad brjod na/ byang bdag dpal bkra shis stobs rgyas dbang po'i sde'i gsungs las/ chos kyi rgyal po tshangs pa lha'i me tog/ mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen 'od zer mtshan/ /rig 'dzin yongs 'dus rnam snang gsang sgrom nas/ /spyan drangs pad+ma dbang rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gter ston mkhas grub chen po sku mched gnyis byung tshul mdo tsam brjod na/rigs ni 'od gsal lha rigs bod chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung 'dzin pa'i gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rgyud las byung ba yin/ yab sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis rje grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po dang gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i zhabs la thug mnga' ris su log 'byon khar gter ston kun skyong gleng pa'i bka' las/ khyod ḍom+bhi'i sku/ be+e ro'i gsung / mar pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa yin/ skye ba
sngon ma rab 'byams pa kun bzang nyi mar gyur dus gzhan la khyad gsod byas pa'i rnam smin la brten drin gang che sdang ba zhig 'ong / 'on kyang shing stag pa skye ba'i gnas su sgrub pa byas na phung po 'od skur smin/ mdo rgyud kyi bshad nyan byas na bstan pa la phan pa rgya cher 'ong / phal cher gzhan rkyen gyi chung ma len dgos shas che yang / de ga bstan pa'i rtsal lag tu 'gyur te khyod la rigs kyi sras brgyad 'byung ba'i dang po la/ don 'grub rdo rje gnyis pa la dbang rgyal rdo rje/ gsum pa la rin chen rdo rje/ bzhi pa la snang mdzad rdo rje/ lnga pa dang drug pa la ming mi dgos/ bdun pa la kun bzang rdo rje/ brgyad pa la mgon po legs ldan rdo rje thogs zhes dang po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sprul pa dang / phyi ma mgon po legs ldan gyi sprul par lung bstan/ sku 'brung pa'i yul ni mnga' ris stod kyi glo bo ma thang yin la rigs ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar zhal gsungs mar/skal ldan gyi btsun pa mtsho skyes bdag /rigs 'chang ba'i rgyud pa btsad po rgyal/ /sdang mig gi spyan gsum ldan pa'i brgyud/ /ma sang gi dpon du rgyud gtam pa/ /grub thob kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /mnga' ris kyi sngags 'chang mkhyen rtogs can/ /de nyid kyi brgyud pa bdun ldan gyis/ /dang po'i rjes su skyes pa'i tshe/ /ya mtshan gyi rtags bcu kun la grags/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par nus la de lta bu'i paṇa chen rin po che de
༄tsho/ /nyid sku tshe'i stod smad thams cad chos phyir du yongs 'dzin du ma bsten cing / mdo sngags gsar rnying gi chos zab pa dang rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan zhing shes bya thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gyur pa/ grub rtags kyang bsdu na phra mo'i dus nas shwa bud bzlog pa dang / chu la mi bying zhing brag la 'dzul ba/ mkha' la lding ba sogs phyogs der gnas pa'i skye bo kun gyi dbang po'i spyod yul du mngon sum du bstan dgung lo nyer lnga par glo bo mkhan chen las bsnyen par rdzogs shing dgung lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi bar nyan bshad sgom sgrubs kyi sgo nas mnga' ris kyi phyogs su bstan pa'i bya ba rlab po ches mdzad/ de dang chos mtshungs par gcung rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje yang thog mar yumagyi lhums su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ hūṃX gi sgra sgrogs ba nye bskor na yod pa rnams kyis thos pa dang / sku na phra mo'i dus nas nges 'byung skyo shas 'khrungs pas/dben gnas ri khrod rnams su phebs te thugs dam kho nar bzhugs pa'i mthus nyams rtogs phul du phyin pa 'khrungs te/ de nyid bog 'don phyir brtul shugs kyi spyod pa yang mdzad te/ yab kyi cung zad bkyon pa'i tshe/yab nyid dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ka dngos su gzigs pa dang / gzhan yang rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs grangs med pa zhal gzigs/ khyad par o rgyan rje dang lan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar dngos su mjal zhing phyis sbas yul
'bras shongs kyi gnas sgo yang 'byed par mdzad pa yin la/ de lta bu'i paṇa chen sku mched kyi zab gter bzhes tshul ni/ gcung legs ldan zhabs kyi lho brag srin mo sbar rjes brag nas kha byang spyan drangs de nyid las/bzhi bcur nyer dus thugs gter nges par 'phradagaX dngos dang nyams su nga yi dbang bzhir bskuraltoX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bskul ma thengs gsum 'ong ltoX de dus the tshom ma byed gnad them yinagaX rnam par snang mdzad thugs kyi klong sgrom nas4༷༷ bla ma sgrub pa yongs 'dus rnam gsum yodagaX sgra sgrogs 'brug gi lo la babs pa'i dus4༷༷ gter bdag bya dkar smyug rgod gtor mas mchodagaX rang nyid dbang drag nga rgyal ldan pa yis4༷༷ bden pa bdar zhing dam sgrags gnad them yinagaX zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skul tshul yang / bla ma brten tshul yang tig snying po'i 'jug gi gter byang las/ bdag sprul sku yon tan 'od zer pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rdo rdze rtsal gyi/ 'brug lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la/ dpal bsam yas bar khang g.yu zhal du bla sgrub kyi rim pa la zhag bdun bzhugs dus n+de 'bangs lnga'i sku srod kyi dus su mngon par bstan nas/ bu khyed rang gi nyams len don rgyas pa steng khang na yod pas long dang gsung byung dus/ rang snang 'khrul pa yin dag snang dang ma dag pa'i snang ba gnyis la ngo bo rang ci yod bsam nas dbu thum mdzad nas gzims bzhugs pas/ tho
༄tshi/ /rang gi dus su bu mo rngams brjid mthing nag 'jigs tshul ldan pa cig byung nas/ bu ma nyal tshur nyon pad+ma'i bka'akyuX sang yar ngo tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i dus4༷༷ khyod sngon byung dge slong nam mkha' ming ltoX rje sprul sku pad+ma rgyal po degaX khyed rje 'bangs nyer lngar gdams pa'i chos4༷༷ da smon lam dus la babs 'dug pas4༷༷ bu le lo ma byed dngos grub long ltoX nga dbyings kyi ma mo ral cig ma4༷༷ khyed rjes 'jug smin par bya phyir dugaXdon chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs su sprulagaX de smyo ba ma yin nges par bzung ltoX bu kheng pa ma byed gzhan don spyodagaX chos kha la ma byed gnad du snunagaX mi kun gyi blo ru mi shong pas4༷༷ don sbas pa'i chul nas 'gro ba drongs4༷༷ces gsungs byung bas had kyi sad rtsa na sngon gyi bag chags du ma dranagaX sang tshes bcur 'dug pas steng khang du mchod pa cig byed na dngos grub thob pa'ang srid bsam nas tho rangs kyi thun la gnas par bgyis so/ /las ldan gyi slob ma dge slong zhig dang gnyis kyi rnam snang sku bzhi sgrom nas gdan drangs so zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gcen gcung gnyis lhan gcig par bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod lta bu'i dkyil mun pa nag po'i gsang sgrom du rgyas btab pa'i zab gter rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi chos skor dgra bcom pa zung gi lhung bzed kyi nang nas spyan drangs/ chos bdag ni mchog dman bar ma mang du 'byung ba'i gtso bo ni/ chos
bdag skyes bu 'dud byed rigs lnga ni4༷༷ zhes pa'i nang tshan lha sras sprul pa 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs la mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches chos 'di dbu tshugs tsam ma gtogs gnang ma thub/ zhing khams 'pho khar zhal chems su/ bsam yas dbu rtse'i byang chub chen po'i sku mdun du kho bo'i rus pa gdan drongs la khyed rang gis dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du long gsung ba ltar rten 'brel sgrig pa mdzad cing / bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs ni gcung legs ldan rdo rje las gsan par mdzad/ chos rgyal gyi sprul pa 'a zha'i gdung las gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la chos skor 'di rdzogs par gnang / chos 'di nyid kyi chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i sprul pa'i gter ston chen po bzhi 'byung ba'i lung bstan pa ni/ pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa kun dga' dpal bzang / gnas gsar ba mdo sngags gling pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phrang mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer bzhir nges shing / rje mkhyen brtses rten 'brel 'phyugs pas gter kha mang ba zhig ma bzhes kyang thog ser gyi skor sogs gdams pa ngo mtshar ba 'ga' spyan drangs pa gsungs/ de yang gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma sogs chos skor mang ba zhig zangs sgrom du bcug grom pa rgyang gi lha khang du sbas pa lha sras rnam sprul sprul sku bzang po grags pas gter
༄༅/ /nas bton te rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can la gtad pa rig 'dzin chen pos shog ser las bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i nang skor/ zab mo thugs kyi sgrub skor bse sgrom smug por bcug pa byang zang zang lha brag la sbas pa/ rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi skye ba sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas 'thon pa lung bstan pa dang / khyad par gsang ba rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi skor ni/ rnam snang thugs kyi sgrom bur sbas shing / chos rgyal thugs sprul pa mnga' ris paṇa chen dang / bdud 'joms skye sprul legs ldan zhabs mthun mongs gi bzhes par lung bstan bzhin gter gnas gong smos ltar paṇa chen sku mched kyi bzhes pa'i zab chos kyi nang tshan sngon slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas lho nub srin po'i gling du gshegs pa'i dus su gung thang la thog tu lha sras mu khri btsan pos phyag dang skor ba byas/ zhabs spyi bos gtugs nas na bza'i slob mo la 'jus te gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btabs shing dran med du brgyal bar/ gu ru pad+mas rgyal po'i snyan khung du ljags kyi chab gtor te dran pa gsos lha sras kyi dbu sku 'phang du blangs te thugs ngal bsos ba dang ma 'ong bde sdug gi lung skyabs byed kyi gter ston byung tshul sogs gsungs pa'i mthar/ gu ru'i zhal nas lha sras nyid kyi gdung rabs tha ma mang yul gung thang du nga'i gter gyis skyob pa'i dus su bod sdug pa'i dus la bab pa yin tegaX sems
can la ci mi 'dod pa 'byung ltoX steng lha srin 'khrug 'og klu gnyan 'khrug par gzhi bdag 'khrugazhiX sdig spyod rgyal po 'khrug dmangs phal pa 'khrugazhiX pha spun nang 'khrugazhiX de'i dus su sangs rgyas bstan pa mthar thug yi dam lha'i dngos grub yal mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri rab la zhal gzigs4༷༷ sems gyi skyid pa zad pa yinagaX gung thang rgyal po yon mchod rje 'bangs rnams4༷༷ nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub la gter gyi chos la spyodagaX pad+ma bdag gi thugs rje myur la stobs che ba de'i dus su 'byung ngo ltoX dus rgyun chad med par nga la gsol ba thobazhiX ces gsungs te gnang ba'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i sgrub skor/ yon tan gter mdzod du grags pa'i dbang skur ba'i skabs su babs pa yin la/ brgyud pa'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sgrub chen bka' brgyad gtso dgu/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po rigs gsum mgon po rnams dgongs brgyud/ lha klu mi'i rig 'dzin slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje mkhas pa shri sing ha/ dpal gyi sprul pa rnam brgyad/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bar brda' brgyud/ o rgyan chen pos rje 'bangs drug la snyan brgyud du gdams shing / ma 'ong pa'i don du dgongs nas zab chos rnams gter gyi sgrom bu stsal ba rnams so so'i dbu thog tu bzhag ste/ ma 'ong pa'i dus rang rang gi gter chos la spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa ni
༄tshi/ /smon lam dbang skur brgyud pa/ dus der slob dpon gyi lung bstan pa ltar gyis sprul pa'i gter ston byon nas zab gter bzhes pa te bka' babs lung bstan brgyud pa/ gter ston gyi chos kyi bdag po rnams la gter chos mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi drod rlung ma nyams pa'i thog nas legs par bstan nas smin grol du mdzad pa ni tshig brgyud shog ser gyi brgyud par grags/ de ltar brgyud pa drug ldan nas gter ston paṇa chen pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal dang / gcung legs ldan rdo rje gro lod rtsal/ lha sras sprul pa 'bri khung rin chen phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ kun bzang pad+ma 'phrin las/ kham lung pa rig 'dzin dbang rgyal/ rig 'dzin chen po bskal bzang pad+ma dbang phyugrigs kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs sras pad+ma theg mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang 'phrin las dbang po'i sde/ des bdag kun bzang 'jigs med chos grags rgya mtsho la dgyes shing stsal ba lags/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'ber du smin byed kyi dbang skur zab mo 'bul bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyis 'os rnams legs par grub zin gyi rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa bla ma dang dkyil 'ber gyi gtso bo tha mi
dad pa la smin byed kyi dbang skur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du mos pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ de yang dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang gnyis su med pa bla ma la/ gu ru yon tan gter mdzod kyi dbang skur zab mo zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma ho/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams sugaX snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i byin rlabs g.yos4༷༷ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs tegaX 'dzam bu gling du 'gro ba'i don la byonagaX 'gro don rgyun chad med par thugs rje canagaX o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la garber+shal ba 'debs4༷༷ bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs nas kyang ltoX bsam pa lhun gyis 'khru/ba par byin gyis balce1bas4༷༷ zhesapa lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab: de nas bla mas 'di ltar rjesaganang sbyin: zhesagasungs pas/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla mas 'di ltar gnang ba sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan man chad nas4༷༷ chos rgyal gdung rgyud mtha' nas ma stong b.raltoX dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs4༷༷ bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen cig phugaX rgyal po chos spyod skyong ba'i thugs rje canagaX bār+sha rgyan pad+ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya4༷༷ de nas tshogs bsags pa'i slad du mosapa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma dang
༄༅/ /gnyis su med pa'i gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ khi/ rgyan lha srin sde brgyad/ o rgyan sman gyi bla/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha/ khi/ rgyan yi dam lha/ o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyen po/ o rgyan dpa' bo ging / dpa' bo'i gyad / o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi/ 37 rgyan rdo rje'i gur snang ba mtha' yas sogs dang gzhan yang rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi bskor ba'i skyabs yul dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar tshogs bsags pa'i phyir du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma hoX sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzadagaX thugs rje'i bod kyi sems can don la byonagaX ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpalagaX nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dulagaX brtse gdung rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can/ o rgyan pad+ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsolagaX dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshegaX nang re dgongs re bod kyi don la byonagaX nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la bcibs te byonagaX yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su 'byonagaX 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje canagaX 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs4༷༷ lnga brgya'i tha ma brtsod dus snyigs ma lagaX sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga hrags4༷༷ nyon mongs jol nyog dug lnga'i rang rgyud spyodagaX de 'dra'i dus na khyed kyis thugs rjes skyobs4༷༷ dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje canagaX o rgyan pad+ma

༄tshi/ /'debs4༷༷ khyed nyid gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor dang bcas4༷༷ chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom medagaX o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la rjes yid rangs4༷༷ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba canagaX 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshegaX yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷ khyed nyid dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas4༷༷ gdug pa'i sems can bkrod par the tshom medagaX o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la chos 'khor bskulagaX sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis4༷༷ sgyu lus nyen zhing 'jigs pa'i dus byung nagaX yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷ khyed nyid dpa' bo gyad dang ldan pa yis4༷༷ 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom medagaX 37 rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la bzhugs gsol 'debs4༷༷ lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshegaX gsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa nagaX yid nyid the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷khyed nyid phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs pa yis4༷༷ ñtsā ra mi rgod rngams sems rlag par byedagaX khi/ rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la lus 'bul logaX gang zhig gshegs ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas4༷༷ mtshon cha rnon pos brdeg cing nyen pa nagaX yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷ khyed nyid rdo rje gur dang ldan pa yis4༷༷ gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyuraltoX o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dge rtsa bsngogaX nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i

༄tshi/ /sugaX khyed rang rnams pad+ma nyi zla gdan gsum brtsegs kyi steng du/ rang byung pad+ma rgyal po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can skrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar zhing dbu la 'dab ldan dar gyi gnyen zhu gsol ba/ dar dmar gyi chos gos za 'og gi ber chen smug po dang mthing nag dar gyi phod ka gsol ba/ phyag g.yas thod pa'i mkhar ba thugs kha 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rin chen shel gyi bum bzang zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi gang ba nas dpal yon gyi dngos grub ster ba/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung drang por bzhugs pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs rig 'dzin brgyud pa sprin ltar thebs shing /phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dkar ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa cang ti'u dang g.yon pa dril bu gsil ba zhabs g.yas brkum g.yon rkyang gi gar stabs mdzad pa rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi cod paṇa can gyi bskor ba/ gtso bo'i sku las mkha' 'gro 'bum phyogs bcu 'phro zhing sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs thams cad sku la rdzogs pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor ā+oX / mgrin par āXthugs khar hūṃX gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros shing / bla ma la gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyi bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dag pa'i zhing spyi dang / khyad par lho nub rnga yab pad+ma 'od nas ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung

༄tshi/ /gdams pa'i gnad kyi don ston 'tshalagaX 'gro ba'i don du 'dir gshegs byin gyis rlabs4༷༷ ā+oX āXhūṃX badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃXltoX oX āXhūṃX ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūṃXltoX sa ma ya a be sha ya a a altoX gang mang brjod/ dbang gi nyams myong bde gsal mi rtog gsum sku gsum du ngo sprad do gsungs pas de ltar ye shes 'bebs bya'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo la kha nang du log te cer gyi ltas pas/ de'i ngo bo stong pa rang gsal ba/ gsal ba stong pas ma spangs shing / stong pas snang ba ma spangs pa'i bde stong zung 'jug bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams dang ldan pa de nyid slob dpon gyi bla ma sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can du ngo sprad pa ni/ don gyi byin dbab pa yin pas de'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par 'jog par mdzod/ cesabarda' sprad/ de nas dbang dngos kyi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma hoX gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur tegaX 'khrul snang dngos por chen pas sdug bsngal nagaX yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷ khyed nyid bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo nyidagaX sdug bsngal 'khrul pa brtsad nas gcod par byedagaX khe/ rgyan pad+ma'i dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs4༷༷ lan gsum / bum dbang bskur bar spro na rnam bum thogs te/ bum pa 'di nyid phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gu ru lngardzon tan gter mdzod kyi lha tshogs 'khosar dang bcas pa khra ram me bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa khyed rang rnams

༄tshi/ /bsam pa lhun grub ma'i brgyud 'debs ni/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mdzad rigs lnga'i lha/ /khrag 'thung bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor gtso 'khor dgur/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa shākya thub/ /'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang ba'i bdag /lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin rnam gsum bcas/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /snying po'i don rtogs grub chen dpal seng ge /paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs rig 'dzin brgyad/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa u rgyan rdo n+de 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /dag pa'i 'khor lnga 'jing yon pad na legs/ /gsang sgrom sgo 'byed ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /mkhas sgrub gtsug rgyan legs ldan bdud 'joms rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag
༄༅/ /rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /grub dbang rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rje/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur ba ngag gi dbang / /'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang dngos bka' 'gyur bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi nyin byed pad+ma dbang / /thams cad mkhyen pa bla med rdo rje rtsa la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa pad+ma phrin las zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ 7rigs kun 'dus pa pad+ma dbang gi rgyal/ /rig 'dzin chen po bskal bzang pad+ma dbang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma bshen gnyen zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ pad+ma ngag dbang kun bzang bstan 'dzin rje/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'jigs med dpa' bo dang / /bka' drin gsum ldan nam mkha' klong yangs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /smin grol chos kyi
'byung gnas pad+ma dbang / /zab dgu gdams pa'i mdzod 'chang bdud 'dul mtshan/ /matre/na de'i rjes bzung dpal ldan bla ma la/ /garbesal ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /tsha smin byed dbang gis rang rgyud legs smin nas/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i man ngag bcu gsum la/ /tshul bzhin nyams su blangs bas 'di phyi'i don/ /'bad med lhun gyi grub par byin gyi rlobs/ /byin rlabs snying po mos gus bla ma'i lam/ /gsol 'debs gdung sdo/gas drag 21 rab 'bad pas/ /rang rigs pad 'byung rgyal ba'i zhal malngardzong nas/ /ka dag lhun khru/ba lam bzang malha(na 'khu/ra phregag /cesapa 'di yang dge slongs spongs ba pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byar pa don grub dpal bzang gisabaskul ba ltar thub bstan rdo rje brag gi chosasmra ba'i dge slong pad+ma 'phrin kyisamyur bar bris/ / ra༅༅/ /thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal 8tho/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la: mkha' 'gro ye shesamatsho rgyal dang : lha srasami khri btsan po yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang : phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te zhuskye slob dpon chen po lags gong du gsung pa'i bsam pa lhun grub bka' stsal pa de ji ltar du lam du khyer ba'i gdams pa zhig zhu: zhesazhusaso: bkal rtsal pa/ gsol ba gang ma btabasakyang dkon mchog gsum kyi yerdzon ga dran pa gal che/ de'i nang nas bla ma dran pa gal che/ de la bla ma'i rnal 'byar phyi nang gsang gsum du bstan gyis: phyi rabs kyi bod 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal gyi dusasu nga yi yerdzon tan dran pa tsam kyi sdug bsngal skyob par gyur cing : de'i phyir dusadeng tshesagrangs bzang po la dbu btsug te: bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di rgyun du thun btsug 'tshal lo: nga ni gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang ye shesalas grub cings: dbang

༄tshi/ /na ma a yur dzñā na sid+dhi ye/ 'gyur med dwangs ma'i thig le mi bzhig khams/ yongs grub dran pas 'chi bdag mun mthar byed/'tsho ba'i bde sbyin 'od brgya'i snang tshul 'dzin/mtsho skyesa'achi med mgon de'i dge legs stsol/zab chosarig 'dzin yongs 'dusalas 'chi med ye shesa'od mchog gi dbang chog nag 'grosasu bkod pa la sbyor ba yo byad bshams pa ni gzhung du bsnyen pa'i 'jug gsal ba ltar dang sgrub mchod sogs gzhung bzhin las logs su bkod ma dgos/ dbang dngosal 'jug pa ni gzhung las de nas skal ldan slob bu khrusanas dbyung : gosargyan gsar bcas phyag 'tshal yon dbul la:cesagasungs pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi khrusadang bgegs gtor bshams la/ raX yaX khaX bhuX las rin chen las khru/ba pa'i ༷r+shad yangs (ken rgya che ba'i nang du gshegar mar bdud rtsi'i rgya malhag chen 21 khu/ra/ 6༷kho āXhūm̐XljoX lan gsum gyisabyin gyisarlabs/ na maX sarba ta thā ga ta a wa 'o1 zhi te 6༷khi sum+bha ra sum+bha ra hūm̐XljoX lan bdun gyi bsngo/ na 37/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi
༄tsho/ /bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad du yang 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la bsten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la 'chi med tshe dbang zab mo bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad gtor ma 'di'i tshim par bgyis la rang rang gi gnas su song shig gal te mi 'gro ba rnams lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlag par 'gyur ro/ hūm̐X hrīX lhun gyis grub pa'i rig pa la4༷༷ lha dang 'dre bgegs ming tsam medakyuX kun tu gsal ba'i ye shes kyi4༷༷ 'od kyis ma rig mun pa bcom4༷༷ bka' ni kun bzang don gyi bka'akyuX log rtog 'khrul pa phyir dengs shig4༷༷ hūm̐X hūm̐X phaṭa phaṭa oX sum+bha ni sogs kyi bgegs bskrad/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐X/
srung ba'i gur khang du tshud pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'o 'gro ba ma gyur sogs spyi phrad gang rigs mthar/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni brnyed pa shog tu dka'/ /skyes bu don 'grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i rten phun sum tshogs pa ni dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di nyid yin la/ 'di ni lhan tu brnyed pa dka' zhing brnyed pa don chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ slob spring du/ bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yi mi rnyed lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas/ /don du brnag pa gang yin de ni bstun te sgrub/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de thob pas mi chog spyir 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshe la nges par med cing / khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i tshe'i snyigs ma'i mthar thub pa dus min du 'chi ba'i rkyen dang bar chad mang po dang / ldan pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir bar chad kyi rkyen mang zhing khyad par dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rkyen ni tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad pa ste rkyang
'tshi/ /zad gsum dang / de dag gnyis gnyis zad pa dang gsum las/ tshe zad pa la/ tshe sgrub kyi cho ga las zad pa la/ srog bslu nye 'don sogs dang / bsod nams zad pa la mchod sbyin la sogs pas bso ba dang / de dag gnyis mnyam du zad pa ni/ gnyen po de dang des bso bar gsungs pa las/ bso bya'i tshe nyid nyams pa'i rkyen nyams pa'i rtags bso byed kyi slob dpon bso tshul dang bzhir rgyud las gsungs pa ste/dang po rkyen ni dam nyams sems dkrugs yid chad dngangs pa dang / zhes sdang drag pos rbod gtong tshar bcad dang / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang / gnas ngan dag tu gnas phob 'di dag ni/ tshe nyams dbugs dngangs bgegs kyi dbang du 'gyur/ zhes dang gnyis pa rtags ni/ 'khor la khro zhing sdug skad 'byin pa dang / bzhin 'gyur spyod lam rnams ni 'chal ba dang / slob dpon 'tsho byed dus las yol ba dang / kha zas rnams kyang yid gar mi 'ong rnams/ 'di dag rnams ni nyams pa'i rtags yin no/ zhes dang gsum pa bso byed kyi slob dpon ni/ ting 'dzin phra mo las su rung ba dang / rgyud kyi don la mkhas shing dbang thob pa/mthu byin che zhing dam can nye ba gsum/ 'di gsum gang gi bkug kyang khugs par 'gyur/ zhes dang bzhi pa ji ltar bso ba'i thabs ni cho ga ste/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rnam grangs ji snyed cig mchis pa las bka'
gter gnyis las da lam 'di nyid gter ma yin/ de'i nang nas kyang dbus gter paṇa chen sku mched gnyis kyis bsam yas steng khang nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi skor la rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la yang yang zab rdzogs chen gyi skor/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi skor bka' srung gnod sbyin gyi skor dang gsum las/ bstan pa rmad byung skor cig bu la'ang gsang ba lha'i sgrub thabs sum brgya tsam bstan pas gtsos gang zag gi nyams su len par nus na nyan thos nas rdzogs pa chen po'i bar gyi gdams pa'i nyams len ma tshangs ba ni gcig kyang med cing / chos rgyal dbang pos sde'i gsungs las/chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong don bsdus pa'i/ /zab mo'i gsol 'debs lam zab lde'u bdun/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshigs dang don mthun pa'i zab chos 'di nyid kyi nang / da lam 'di ni sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi skor las / bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med ye shes 'od mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su babs pa yin zhing 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa yang / chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku tshe dpag med mgon sprul sku o rgyan chen po/ las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/ gter ston paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal ye shes rol pa rtsal/ gcung rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/
༄tshi/ /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang pad+ma 'phrin las/ khams lung rig 'dzin dbang rgyal/ rig 'dzin chen po bskal bzang pad+ma dbang phyug bdag gi 'dren mchog rigs kun khyababadag thugs sras pad+ma theg mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang gi drung du/ bdag kun bzang 'jigs med chos grags 'bod pas nos pa lags/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang zab mo 'bul bar byed pa la slob dpon gyi bgyis 'os rnams legs par grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i skurdzon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul gzhung las/ gosargyan gsar bcas phyag 'tshal yon dbul la: zhesagasungs pas/ bla ma dang mabosten krerdzo tshe dpag med gnyis su med pa la dkyil 'ospusar phyi'i 'jug pa'i don du gadrar+shal ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyi4༷༷ bla ma kun bzang tshe dpag medagaX zhi khro rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dgongs4༷༷ bdag cag las 'phro skal bar ldanagaX smin grol ye shes tshe dbang stsolaltoX lanagasum/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud brtag pa'i phyir bla mas 'di ltar dris ba'i mos pa mdzod/ kye ho/ skal ldan rigs kyi bugaX kun bzang tshe yi dkyil 'khor dugaX 'jug par 'dod pa shin du legs4༷༷ dam tshig sdom pa kun thub cing / bskyed rdzogs don la
gnas nus pagaX 'gro la phan par byed nus pas4༷༷ zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hogaX bla ma kun bzang tshe dpag medagaX khyed kyi bka' stsal bdag gis bsgrubazhiX smin byed dbang dang gdams ngag zhugaX grol byed rig pa rang gsal stonagaX lan gsum/ de nas thog mar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung 'jug tu rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oX āXhūm̐X hrīX snang sems gnyis su med pa lagaX rgyu ma lta bur spyan 'dren gshegs4༷༷ 'pho dang 'gyu ba med mos kyang ltoX lhun grub ngo shes tshul gyis bzhugs4༷༷ yul dang shes pa gnyis med kyang ltoX rtag 'dzin dag phyir phyag 'tshal loltoX longs spyod rol pa mi dmigs kyang ltoX nam mkha' mdzod ltar mchod pa 'bulagaX bshis la sdig sgrib med mod kyang ltoX blo bu dri ma bshags par bgyis4༷༷ rang rig dus gsum 'gyur med kyang ltoX rol rtsal snang la rjes yid rang ltoX rtag tu nges pa lngar bzhugs kyang ltoXrig rtsal chos 'khor bskor du gsolagaX ji ltar snang yang chos kyi sku4༷༷ skye 'chi med par gsol ba 'debs4༷༷ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa yigaX don dam 'gyur med klong du bsngogaX rnam shes 'khor ba gdod med kyang ltoXye shes rtags rgyun smin byas lha gzhiX lan gsum/ de nas lam log pa las ldog pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'i mched du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oX āXhūm̐X hrīX rang byung ye shes rig pa chos kyi sku4༷༷ gsal dngas longs sku
༄tshi/ /chags bral dam pa'i chos4༷༷ sna tshogs rang grol sprul sku dge 'dun lagaX rang shar rang grol don dam skyabs su mchigaX lan gsum/ lam dman pa las ldog pa sems bskyed kyi slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod oX āXhūm̐X hrīX rig pa rang sar gsal ba'i 'od po che4༷༷ rang shar kun khyab bde chen brtse ba'i sems4༷༷ ma bcos lhun grub gnyug ma don gyi lhagaX mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen sems bskyed dogaX lan gsum/ de nas gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzodagaX ho tshe bdag rig 'dzin snang mtha' yas4༷༷ rgyal ba sras bcas mkha' 'gro dgongs4༷༷ bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tegaX 'od gsal mngon du ma gyur b.raltoX so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi4༷༷ sdom pa thams cad bzung bar bgyis4༷༷ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi4༷༷ ma (rdzol ba rnams 11la bar bgyi4༷༷ dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyungs zhing ltoX sems can myang ngan 'das la 'godagaX lan gsum/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum bsgom la: thugs khar zla ba rdo rje gsal: gsungs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi spyi ngesar tsaXr+sha dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po thugs par hūm̐X stsodan pos mtshan pa'i ngesas pa mdzod slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar pos mtshan pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oX āXhūṃX sarba yo

༄༅/ /gnod sbyin ya ba rkya bdun gyi sgrub thabs srog gtad kyi cho ga 'dod pa'i re skong zhesabya ba bzhugs so//
༄༅/ /o swa sti/ bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi/ /khyab bdag o rgyan thod phreng rtsal/ /der 'dud gnod sbyin rtsi'u dmar ba'i/ /sgrub thabs srog gtad cho ga bri/ /'dir rgyal ba'i bstan srung gnod sbyin ya ba rkya bdun gyi sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar srog gtad cho ga sgrub pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bshams/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i thabs dang srog gtad kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni dus khyad par can la 'di nyid kyi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la zangs gachod du 'bru'i phye khrag chang gis sgrus pa'i bshos bu mkhar thabs ba gam can gyi steng du gru gsum bdun dbus ma'i rtser 'ug pas mtshan pa rtsi dmar gyis byugs shing / sha dmar dang yungs dkar gyis brgyan pa/ sku rten tsakali gtor gdugs dmar po btsugs pa bkod/ mdun du me tog dmar po 'bru tshoms kyi dbus su phur bu 'am dbyug to g.yas rten rdzas kyi mdung dmar/ rgyab tu bla rdo 'am 'khor lo/ /g.yon du rten zhags/ de dag gi mdun du mchod gtor dmar po gru gsum gtso
༄༅/ /'khor bdun pa 'theb kyu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ sman phud/ rak+ta/ phye mar gser skyems dkar skyems mngar skyems/ nyer spyod sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i thabs la/ gong gnon gyi lha gu ru zhi drag gam rta mgrin lta bu bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor rnams nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ rten gtor la dmigs te gsol kha phyogs phyogs mas spyan 'dren mchod bstod mdor bsdus su bya ba'am/ spro na rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gi mdun du btsan yul zangs thang dmar po zangs brag gnam la snyeg pa/ rtse la rgod smug lding ba/ logs la btsan skya rgyu ba/ sked la gcan zan ngu ba/ rtsa bar dug chu khol ba/ brag ri dmar po'i nang du khrag mtsho khol zhing / bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi sgo lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi dmar ba sku mdog dmar ljang
ral ba dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me yi skar mda' 'khrugs pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khro zhing 'jigs pa rngam zhing gtum pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol bar rin chen gser gyi ska rag bcings pa/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon tu 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab tu 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pas dgra bo 'ching zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyi ru mtshon snying la bsnun pa/ rta bra bo sgab nag dar gdan dmar po sga khra bo/ dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob can/ gser gyi srab/ g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs/ sbrul nag gi gong smed byas pa la chibs nas stong gsum bskor ba/ sku la zhal gyi lha btsan sku mdog dkar ser khro 'dzum can sku la za 'og dmar khra'i gos dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas su stag dong dang g.yon tu gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis gser mda' gser gzhu bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha mdong sga srab can la chibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rje sku mdog dmar po 'bar ba rngam zhing 'jigs pa sku la leb rgan gyi 'jol ber dang dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/
༄tshi/ /stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon tu 'phyang ba phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra bo 'ching zhing g.yas kyi shang lang brdeg pa/ mtshal lu rting dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ rā tsa gong sngon gyi klu btsan/ sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral ga la dug sbrul gyi ska rags bcing ba/ dar sngon gyi thod can stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon tu 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang g.yon dug sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can la chibs pa/ rdo ring dmar po'i gri btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ber dmar gyi slog pa dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon tu 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang / g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ gang ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/ sku la dar nag ber chen dang bdud dar nag po thod du bcing pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon tu 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon phyar zhing g.yon 'bring zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la chibs pa/ rtsal thog rgyug gi gri btsan sku mdog khrag ltar dmar ba sku la zangs khrab dmar po dang / dbu la dar dmar gyi thod

༄tshi/ /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyabaltoX pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pagiX dam tshig gter bdag khyod la bstodagiX gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul 'o/ltoX bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la4༷༷ thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzodagiX ar+ghaX bi shud+dhi swa hā:༷༷ gtsang ma'i bdug sbos sprin ltar gtibs4༷༷ me tog snang gsal dri chab dngagiX zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul4༷༷ thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzodagiX d+dhā pe puṣ+ṭi ā lo ke ga〉giX nai wi h+ye shap+ta pā tsa ho:༷༷ kye4༷༷ skyes bu srog gi bdag po nigiX 'jigs byed rol pa sde bdun tshogs4༷༷ khyed la dgyes pa'i longs spyod nigiX sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs4༷༷ zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho ltar bskyil4༷༷ rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing bur gtams4༷༷ spyan gzigs 'ordzongs spyod skar ltar bkramagiX rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs4༷༷ glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcas4༷༷ dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskangagiXbtsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangagiX sde brgyad stong sde'i thugs dam bskangagiX dkor srung dam ldan thugs dam bskangagiX las bzhi'i pho nya'i thugs dam bskangagiX bh+yo:༷༷ bse mkhar dmar po ldems se ldemagiX dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ༄5༷༷ ba dan dmar po yengs se yengagiX dregs pa'i mda' 'phen sgrengs se sgrengagiX las byed shan pa ro lo lo4༷༷ bshug pa'i 'bod sgra di ri ri4༷༷ che btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangagiX slob dpon

༄tshi/ /tu h+la yul lcang ra smug por yab li rje gsang ba dang yum ut+pal rgyan gyi sras li sras 'chor ba zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ dge slong tsan+t+ra bha ha las so thar gyi khrims blangs te nag tshal gcig tu bzhugs pa las yul de'i rgyal po dharmā shri'i sras mo lha lcam bde sbyin zhes bya ba khrus la zhugs pa dug sbrul gyi 'jigs pas gtses pas li sras kyi de'i 'jigs pa skyabs pa blon po sdig to can gnyis kyis mthong bas lha lcam dang li sras gnyis mthun pa'i ya ga bsgrags pas rkyen byas/ rgyal pos li sras gsod pa'i pho nya btang bas lha lcam g.yang la lcebs te shi zhing li sras kyang kha ba can gyi ljongs su bros pho byung bsad/ mo rigs thams cad la spyod cing gnas pa las/ nam zhig gi tshe rgyal po'i pho nyas li sras bzung ste gri ru bkum par/ smon lam log pa'i mthu las nub phyogs zangs thang dmar po btsan rje zla ba thod dkar gyi sras mo gnod sbyin gdong dmar ma'i mngal du khrag gi sgo ngar bltams pas ji zhig na brdol ba'i nang nas gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po dang / de'i mgo las bdud btsan/ rus las lha btsan/ drod dang mdangs las brag btsan/ khrag las gri btsan chu ser las klu btsan/ sha las gri btsan te btsan rgod gdug pa drug byung ste/ gtso 'bor bdun gyis srid gsum gyi skye bo thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa la rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal pos mthu
stobs kyis gzir zhing brtul/ srog gi snying po blangs/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bde byed mas bskul te spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud gsungs/ rdo rdze theg pa'i bsrung mar bskos shing dam tshig gi gnyer kha gtad/ dus phyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i spyan sngar rang gi tha tshig rgyud dang bcas pa dngos gsol du phul te gter gyi srung mar khas blang/ mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud sgrub skor las phran bu dang bcas pa rnams zab mo'i gter du sba bar mdzad pa las/ ji skad du/ bdag dang rgyal po'i yon tan sprul pa nigiX pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal4༷༷ zhes lung gis gsal bar bstan pa'i sprul pa'i gter ston pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje'i gter kha las byung ba'i srog gtad rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song / slob ma'i bya ba maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye4༷༷ bla ma rje btsun khro dra'i rgyal4༷༷ dregs pa las la nye ba'i phyiraltoX dam tshig bka' yi bcings mdzad nas4༷༷ dregs pa'i dam tshig gnyer du zhugiX zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ rten gtor skad cig gis rta mgrin sku mdog dmar nag khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon phur bu sgril ba dur khrod rol pa'i chas thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbu gtsug tu/ ma hā gu ru thod phreng
༄tshi/ /rtsal sku mdog dmar nag lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dbu gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher zhing gzi byin nyi ma 'bum gyi rang bzhin ltar gsal bar mos la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /sogs kyi rgyun bshags bya/ slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros slob ma'i lus la phog pas phung khams skye mched sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ ma dmigs pa'i ngang las dpal chen rta mgrin du sngar ltar gsal btab/ gnas gsum brlab ye shes pa dgug bstim sbos rol bya/ gnyen po'i dbang la yang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs gsum las/ dang po gtor ma dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba las/ mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa chad de byung ba spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam la/ rten gtor sgyi bor bzhag ste/ hrī4༷༷ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las sprul pa'i skugiX khro rgyal rngam pa dregs pa'i bdag po stegiX rta skad rngams sgrogs bdud dang dam sri 'dul4༷༷ h+ya gh+ri wa'i dbang mchog thob par shogagiX oX hrīXbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa4༷༷ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oX ltoX zhes brjod cing sbos rol bya/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas gsung gi byin rlabs rnams sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po rang
sgra sgrogs bzhin du byung ba mgrin pa nas thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus ldan du gyur bar bsams la/ sngags kyis btab pa'i me tog dmar po gtor zhing / hrī4༷༷ gsang sngags rgyal po hu lu'i sgra dang ldan4༷༷ 'bad par bzhugs nas dngos grub myur du steraltoX sangs rgyas gsung mchog 'dus pa dpal gyi thugs4༷༷ yang dag sngags kyi dbang mchog thob par 31gagiX rtsasngags kyi mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:༷༷ spos rol bya/ gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams phyag mtshan phur bu dang dbyug to la sogs pa'i rnam par byung ste/ snying kha nas thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus ldan du gyur bar bsams la/ phur bu'am dbyug to snying khar gtug cing lag tu gtad la/ hrī4༷༷ ye shes rig pa byang chub sems kyi dbang ltoX nyon mongs mthar byed rta mchog 'gro ba'i shugs4༷༷ rang bzhin yon tan 'bum gyi gter mnga' bltoX mi gnas thugs kyi ye shes thob par phre(gagiX rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa nyu4༷༷ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ de dag ni gnyen po'i lha dbang bskur ba yin no/ /de nas dregs pa'i srog dbang dngos la'ang / sku gtor ma/ gsung bla rdo/ thugs phyag mtshan la brten nas srog gtad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi ga|(ra ma 'di nyid btsan yul zangs thang dmar lngardzo sogs sngar bzhin gnod sbyin 'bor bcas su bskyed pa dmigs pa rgyas
༄mya/ /bsdus ci rigs su sbod nas de ltar dbang grags rol pa'i pho brang sde brgyad rba klong 'khrugs pa'i rten mkhar gyi nang du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs khra lam me bzhugs pa khyed rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i lag tu gtad pas dregs pa 'khor bcas gus 'dud dang bcas pas dam la gnas par mos la/ gtor ma lag tu gtad de/ kye4༷༷ sku mkhar dmar po ldems se ldemagiX rtse la rgod smug lings se ling ltoX bzhugs pa'i rten du bu la gtadagiXdregs pa rtag tu gnas par shogagiX rak+ta ma dha la hūm̐ swa hā:༷༷ chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po/ tsi'u dmar po/ sku la zhal gyi grib btsan/ rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan/ rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan/ gang ka thod nag bdud btsan/ rā tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan/ gro shed bod gyi sgang dmag rje/ yang sprul srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma thod 'phreng / rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal/ 'bri gung rin chen/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal sras kun bzang / rin chen dar rgyas/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ kun mkhyen rdo rje thogs med/ rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar zhes sogs kyi bka' bsgo rgyas bsdus : rigs bya/ gnyis pa ni
mdun bskyed dregs pa'i srog gi snying po hrīXyig dmar nag srog sngags dang bcas pa'i rnam par byung ba khyed rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la sib kyis thim pas dbyer med du 'dres shing dregs pa'i srog dbang du 'du bar mos su bcug la/ bla rdo mgrin par bzhag cing lag tu gtad la/ bla rdo srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags4༷༷ mda' yi shugs dang thog ltar myuraltoX 'bod rbad rten du bu la gtadagiX rtag tu srog rgyud 'brel bar shogagiX oX rak+ta rak+ta snying la hūm̐ hūm̐ shu la gh+ri wa tri shu la hrī hrī dzaXdzaX zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni dregs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ srid gsum dregs pa'i mthu nus thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ mdung zhags la bstim pa gnod sbyin bran 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams kyi gus pa chen pos rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dngos grub tu phul bas dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu stobs thogs med du gyur cing bstan pa srung ba'i lag char bcangs par mos su bcug la mdung dmar g.yas dang zhags pa g.yon tu gtad la/ mi 'bral srog gi dam tshig nigiX mdung dang zhags pa btsan gyi chas4༷༷ pad+ma dbang chen dam tshig ldan4༷༷ phrin las rten du bu la gtadagiX rak+ta garma dza bh+yo rbadagiX ces brjod cing mdung zhags g.yas su bcug spos dkar gsur dud rnga gling rol ma'i sgra sgrogs pa sogs bya/ des gnod sbyin chen po ya ba skya
༄tshi/ /bdun gyi srog gtad kyi rim pa brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin du rdzogs par grub pa yin pas/ deng nas bzung ste srung ma'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rten tshogs pa'i sgo nas brten gsol mchod pa'i las la 'bad cing / de yang dregs pa rang sems las logs su med par shes pa'i sgo nas gnas lugs kyi lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa gces te/ btsan bdud rol ba skya bdun kyangagiX rang las byung zhing sprul par snang ltoX gnyis med don dam gcig tu rdzogs4༷༷ rang gi sems su shes par bya4༷༷ go gsungs/ rta dmar dang rkyang gi sha mi za/ yug sa mo dang ming sring la mi spyod/ btsun pa bsad pa'i gos mi 'gong /btsan gnod pa'i phyogs la brngan sbyin pa sogs mthun 'jug gi rten 'brel drag spyod mi bya/ spyang ke dang bya rog la mi brdeg thab gzhob mi gtong / lo zla dus kyi gtor ma ma chags pa dang / khyad par nya stong la gsol ba shin tu gces shing / len spong bgyis na srung mar rang gshed du bab par 'gyur te/ rgyud las/ spyod dang dam tshig gi rim pa nigiX rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi mang sa spangs4༷༷ go lag gtso yis mi bgo stegiX dred stag brten du mi ldang ngo4༷༷ rno dbal sngags kyi ngar mi bsadagiX rangagi zhe sdang lam mi 'gagagiX g.yu li cho long mda' mi bcagagiX rdo yi sol ba rlung mi skuraltoX na bun rlangs pa sngo mi btang ltoX khas blangs dus las yol
mi bya: lta med na ni bkol mi gtub: dam tshig ma bsrung byin rlabs rdugs: lha bsnyen ma byas rang la ldog: ces dang / len spong byas na rang srog gcod: mchod pa yol na god kha gtong : zhes gsungs pa'i dam tshig gi gnas la brtson par bsgrag cing / gasgyum nges ji ltar sogs kyi khas blang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍala'abulab spyi dang 'dra zhing / mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog gong du bstan pa bzhin no/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi/ /sgrub thabs srog gtad tshig nyung don gsal 'di/ /rang dang skal mnyam 'gro la phan phyir du/ /rin chen rnam par rgyal bas bris pa'o/ /dge'o// bkra lhas// //
༄༅/ /dregs pa'i yang rje gnod sbyin tsit+ta dmar po mched bdun gyi srog gtad kyi rim pa rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs//
༄tshi/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i blo ngo dang mtshams par/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i gar/ /'gyur med rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs su/ /ston mdzad mtsho 9skyesardo rjer snying nas 'dud/ /'dirir rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo 'od dpagatu med pa dragapor bzhengs pa dbang chen rta mchogrol pa lasaganyisasu snang yang gnyisasu med pa'i bka'i srung ma gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar srogagatad bya ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshoms/ /dngosagazhi sgrub pa'i thabs/ srogagatad ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni gnod sbyin 'di nyid kyi dam tshigagi brinasasku bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu kheb ldan gyi khar me togadamar po'i tshome bu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzir 'bru bzang gi phye/ mar khu dang khrag chang girisasprusapa'i bzhosabu mkhar thabs ba gam can steng du bzhosabu gru gsum bdun dang dbusama'i rtser 'ugapas mtshan par rtsi dmar gyisabyugs shing / sha dmar dang yungs dkar gyisabargyan/ dar dmar gyi ru mtshorne btsugs pa bkod/ mdun du me togadamar po'i 'bru tshormes kyi steng du phur bu'am dbyugato/ /g.yas su rten rdzas kyi mdung dmar/ rgyab tu bla rdo'i 'khor lo/ g.yon du rten zhags/ de dgagi mdun du mchod gtor dmar po gru gsum gtso9 'khor bdun pa mtheb kyu
༄tshi/ /brgyad kyisabaskor ba dang g.yas g.yon du sman raka/ phyi nang gi nyer sbyod/ khrag chang / zho 'o/ bur sbrang ka ras sbags pa'i mngar skyems/ rgya ja/ phye mar/ dkar mo lag g.yas sogs ci 'byor pa'i mthun rdzas spyan gzigs sogs bkod pa mdzesapar bshams/ rang gi nye logs su rdo dril/ las bum/gul yungs/ sposadakar/ rol chen sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshoges par bya'o/ /gnyirisapa ni/ rang nyi4da gu ru zhi drag gam rta mgririn gyi bdag bskyed la gnas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor bskang rdzas rnams nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs/ rten gtor la dmigs te gsol kha phyogs phyogs mas gnod sbyin 'khor bcas spyan 'dren mchod gsol mdor bsdusasu bya ba'am/ spro na rten bsang sbyangs/ hrīr+shang pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mdun du btsan yul zangs thang dmar lnga1 zangs brag gnam la bsnyeg pa/ rtse la rbestod smug lding ba/'o1gas la btsan skya rgyu ba/ rked na gcan gzan ngur ba/ rtsa bar dug chu spusal ba/ brag ri dmar po'i nang du khrag mtsho kherdzol id bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi 〈sna lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i
dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi dmar ba sku mdog dmar ljang ral ba dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me'i skar mda' 'khrug pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khro zhing 'jigs la rngam zhing gtum pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol bar rin chen gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab tu 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pa dmar pos dgra bo 'ching zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyi ru mtshon can snying la bsnun pa/ rta bra bo sgab nag /dar gdan dmar po sga khra bo/ dngul gyi yob thag /zangs kyi yob chen/ gser gyi srab/ g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs sbrul nag gi gong rmed byas pa la gcibs nas stong gsum bskor ba/ sku la zhal gyi lha btsan sku mdog dkar ser khro gtum can/ sku la za 'og dmar khra'i gos dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas su stag dong dang g.yon gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis bse mnga' bse gzhur bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha gdong sga srab can la bcibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rje sku mdog dmar po me
༄tsho/ /'od 'bar pa brngam zhing 'jigs pa sku la le rgan gyi 'jol ber dang dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra kro bcings te g.yas kyis shang lang brdeg pa/ mtshal lu rting dkar sga srab can la bcibs pa/ ra tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral ga la dug sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dar sngon gyi thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzigs shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang g.yon dug sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can la bcibs pa/rdo rengs dmar po'i grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ber dmar gyi slog pa dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ /stag gdong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la cibs pa/ gang ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/ sku la dar nag ber chen dang bdud dar nag po thod du bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzigs shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas 'brang zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la bcibs pa/
