༄7/ /gser skyems mthun rdzas rnams sngags rgyas rlabs shoring / gdung ba dang bos pas/ hoX chos dbyings khyab gdal phyogs lhung dang bral ba mkha' khyab kyi 'khosar 'ordzo kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga mchog tu yangs pa'i 〈snang / 'ja' 'od zer lnga 'khrugs pa'i zhing khams sems kyi rdo rje'i pho brang gi snang cha dbang drag rol pa'i gur khang du dengs pa'i dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i klong nas gtum rngams gar dgu'i nyams can du shar ba'i dus kyi wo nya srog gcod las kyi bshan pa chen po/ dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi srung ma chen po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi mngag gzhug chen po/ gtsug lag yongs kyi gnyer pa/ zab gter kun gyi bdag po/dam ldan kun gyi mgon po/ dam med kun gyi gshed ma/ bka' srung yongs kyi pho nya/ dregs pa yongs kyi rje bo/ 'byung po kun gyi stong dpon/ 'than dang byur gyi sna 'dren/ nad dang rims gyi bdag po/ rnal
༄tshi/ /'byor bdag gi dgra lha/ ging chen bshan pa dmar po/ gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi rigs las mdog dmar bse'i sku can du grags pa khyod kyi lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po'i thugs las gnyis su med kyang gnyis su shar ba'i bka'i blon por mnga' gsol zhing / gdug pa can gyi gnya' gnon/ thar 'dod can gyi re ba bskong bas legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin par byed cing /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sngon mo g.yu'i lding khang du srog gi snying po blangs/ dam tshig gi rdo n+de spyi bor bzhag ste rdo n+de theg pa'i srung mar bskos te gzengs bstod/rgyud gsum dregs pa kun gyi rje bor gyur kyang g.yo thabs dang sgyu 'phrul la mkhas pas 'ga' zhig tu 'bangs dang 'ga' zhig tu gtso bo/ la lar sna 'dren pa'i bla rkun 'byung po'i tshul bzung ste skye bo kun la
gnod par byed cing / zhing gi lo tog /spang gi rtsi bcud/ nor gyi 'o zho/ ja chang gi ro bcud rnams la nyab par byed pa/ srod kyi dus su skye bo'i bla srog brku bar phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyug cing brel ba/ nam gung dben gnas ri sul rnams su sgom chen gyi drod tshad nyul ba/ tho rengs na chung bud med yongs kyi lus la rol zhing rtse bas bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ pho la mo dang mo la phor brdzu zhing bslu brid kyi 'phung thabs la mkhas pa/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan zhing / rab tu rno ba'i mche ba gangs ri lta bu khrag gis sbags pa aX tshigs bsdams pa/ dmar zlum 'khyil ba'i spyan gsum 'khrug cing me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ shangs nas bskal pa'i 'thor rlung dug rlangs dud sprin gyi rnam par 'thul ba/ ral pa dmar ser khrag gis sbags pa dar thod dmar pos bcings pa'i lhag ma 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis dgra stu kha chen brdeg stabs su 'phyar bas dgra bo'i mgo lus bshag cing phral ba'i snying khrag g.yon pa'i thod par bskyil te rol zhing spyod pa/ zhing bcu'i bla srog thogs med du 'gugs pa'i bdud zhags nag po a lung lcags kyu dang bcas pas 'ching zhing sdud pa'i las rnams thogs med du sgrub pa/ dar dmar gyi ral ka lhab lhub tu gsol zhing / nor bu'i phra tshoms kyis spras pa'i hor lham gyon pa/ shin tu rags pa'i nya sul gyi ba spu gzings pa'i khrod
༄tshi/ /nas thog ser gyi bu yug 'chub cing sring gsum skad cig myul ba'i bdud rta nag po rlung gi gshog pa can la chibs nas rgyug cing mchong ba/ /stag gzig dom dred spra sprel rol tu 'khrid cing dur srin gyi bya tshogs mang po klad la lding ba/ btsan dmag bye ba/ bdun dmag 'bum sde/ the'u rang stong / ru 'dren sde bzhi yang sprul srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gang du mchis kyang thogs pa med par myur ba'i shugs kyis dgyes pa'i gar stabs dang bcas te byon zhig rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar ldir zhing dgyes pa'i gad mo dang bcas te byon zhig /log 'dren dgra bgegs rnams la gtum zhing gshe yang dam ldan rnal 'byor kun la brtse zhing dung ba'i dgongs pa dang bcas te byon zhig bar snang rlabs kyis bcad de byon zhig nam mkha' dar dang sprul gzugs kyis khengs pa/ sa gzhi sprul pa'i dmag gis khengs pa/ thug tshom 'ur sgra dang bcas te byon zhig a tsa ra dang mon pa'i tshogs rnams rang skad kyi ngan sngags sgrog cing / las byed bshan pa'i dmag mi rgyob gsod kyi sgra dang bcas te byon zhig gdug pa'i ma mo 'bum sde 'jigs pa'i dul mo rdul zhing dmod mo'i ku co dang bcas te byon cig hoX gnod sbyin chen po khyod ni/ nam mkha' bas rgya che/ nyi zla bas mdangs gsal/ gza' skar pas bkrag che/
rta rnga bas nyag phra/ yungs gar bas 'bru zhib/ /'ug pa gra ma bas mig rno/ pho rog nag chung bas rnam pa bkra /dug sbrul nag po bas zhe gnag /g.yu 'brug gzhon nu las skad che/ stag mo grus ma bas mchongs che/ /seṅge dkar mo las rtsal che/ gzhin rje khros pa las do thung / srin po'i dmag tshogs las srog la rngams pa/ sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa khro zhing gtum pa/ srid pa gsum yang skad cig nyid la myul bar byed cing / ri rab klad la skor te/ rgya mtsho hub kyis 'dren pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ skye 'gro kun gyi bla srog dus gcig la gcod par nus pa'i drag shul can dmar zlum dpral ba'i mig rtsa g.yo zhing 'khyug pa'i ltad mor dus gsum gyi gnas tshul dus gcig tu mthong ba lkog gyur blang ngor gyi gnas rnams rjen par ston pa'i mngon shes la mnga' brnyes pa/ dam la gnas shing 'dris pa'i khrel gzhung dang ldan pas sgrub pa po la brtse zhing dung ba/ /'khor srid gsum 'byung po'i dmag tshogs bsam mi khyab kyis bskor ba'i dbus na/ lha zhal mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal po chen po yin na/ deng 'dir bdag gis ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su mnga' gsol zhing gzengs bstod par byed pa lags pas/ gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di dang / ri bo ltar brtsegs shing rgya mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i sha rus khrag zhag
༄tshi/ /nang khrol rkang mar klad pa dang bcas pa phung por spungs pa'i gtor ma 'di dang / sha gsur tshil chen/ spos dkar shing sna'i dud pa lang long du g.yo ba nam mkha'i khams khengs pa 'di dang / rnga sil dung chen rkang gling bshugs pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra ltar ldir ba 'di dang / mdzes sdug lang tsho'i snyems pas 'gying ba'i sman shar gzhon nu snyan pa'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur ba 'di dang / rtsal chen dmag gi las la chas pa'i stag shar go zhub btsan pos spras shing / rbad dang 〈sgra rngams par ldir ba 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / tshogs kyi 'bor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis mnyes shing tshim par gyur cig stag ltar rngams pa la gsol lo/ khyung ltar lding ba la gsol lo/seng ltar mchong pa la gsol lo/ khra ltar 'dzul ba la gsol lo/ sprul ltar 'khyug pa la gsol lo/ spyang ltar rgyug pa la gsol lo/ me ltar 'bar ba la gsol lo/ chu ltar 'khrug pa la gsol lo/ rlung ltar 'tshub pa la gsol lo/ ri ltar brtan pa la gsol lo/ glog ltar myur ba la gsol lo/ sprin ltar 'khrigs pa la gsol lo/ pha ltar byams pa la gsol lo/phu bo ltar dung ba la gsol lo/ grogs ltar brtse ba la gsol lo/ /rje ltar skyong ba la gsol lo/ 'bangs ltar bkur ba la gsol lo/ bran ltar nyan pa la gsol lo/ hoX gzhan yang gnod sbyin chen po khyod ni dmar
la dad cing dmar la rtsi ba/ drod ldan gyi khrag zhag 'gul zhing 'phrig pas ma gtogs gzhan gyis tshim par dka' ba/ dal por za zhing banyung bas ro myong ba'i long med pa/ dgra bo'i gshed du rings pa'i shugs kyis skad cig 'dug pa'i long med pa/ zhe sdang drag pos khro zhing gtum pas skye bo'i srog dbugs sdud pa la mchog tu rngamasapa/ phud la mnga' brnyes shing skyur dad che bas grong kha 'grims nas 'jig rten gyi skyur phud sdud pa/ri klung thams cad du thal byung du brgyugs nas 'o zho'i sris brku zhing bcud nyob par byed pa lags na/ rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag zhag drod ldan du bsgyur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'dis gsol lo mchod do/ /ro mchog brgya phrag dang ldan pa'i dza gad bdud rtsi'i mchod pa gser g.yu gtsang mas spran cing / 'bras chang rgun chang bdud rtsi'i chang sogs chang sna brgya phrag 'dus pa'i ngo bor brlabs te mang por sbar ba'i zhal skyems dam pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do/ /rtsi bcud kyi dwangs ma 'khyil ba'i nying khu 'o zho'i rang bzhin du 'khyug cing 'tsher ba'i dkar phud dam pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do/ /hoX gnod sbyin chen po khyod kyis sngon tshe rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas rnams kyi spyan sngar srog gi snying po phul te dam bcas bskal pa'i tha mar mi rje srong btsan sgam pos khra
༄༅/ /'brug mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bsrung ba'i gnyer kha bcol/ /dam tshig gi stangs bzung / slar yang zan g.yang chos 'khor chen po'i dbang chen rta mchog bzhad pa'i gling du dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'khor 'das yongs kyi rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis nub byang mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ phyi rabs skyong ba'i rdo rje'i bka' bsgos pa'i tshe na rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i 'khor lo dpang du btsugs nas khas blangs/ dam nod/ mna' bskyal ba'i tha tshig gnyan po rjes su dran par gyis la kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa sbyi dang / khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i snying po'i ring lugs de 'dzin dang bcas ba bsrung zhing skyongs lhag /yang sgos khyad par du yang sngags 'chang bdag gi phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen du gces shing nye bar mkho ba'i bran g.yog slob 'bangs sde rigs dang bcas pa khyod la gnyer du gtad pas rtag tu skyongs shig /rang gi gzhis la gnas sam/ byes kyi phyogs la gnas sam/ lam 'phrang chu la rgyu'am phyogs dus gang du gnas kyang nyin gsum rgyang nas bya ra mdzod cig /mtshan gsum drung nas mel tshe mdzod cig /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs shog /nyi ma dang zer bzhin du 'grogs shig /gur kum dang dri ngad bzhin du 'grogs shig /nyams pa sos shig /yar ba khug cig /zhig pa sdoms shig /
byer ba bsgril lhag /gas pa sgrigs shig /chad pa mthud cig /zad pa spel cig /yo ba srongs shig /'gyel ba slong zhig /brjed pa skul shig /mi rgyud chu bas ring ba/ dbu 'phang ri rgyal bas mtho ba mnga' thang nyi zla bas gsal ba/ snyan grags nam mkha' bas yangs pa/ dgongs pa rgya mtsho bas zab pa/ rta ra rtas khengs pa/ phyugs lhas phyugs kyis khengs pa/ bang mdzod nor gyis khengs pa/ zas g.yang rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/dgra mgo rdog pas non pa/ ci 'dod grogs su khugs pa/ gang bsams rtse ru slebs pa/ bsam don lhun gyis grub pa/ lhun grub rgyun chad med pa/ rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub pa dam can khyod kyis sgrubs shig /dpa' dar du khyod 'phyar ba yin no/ /rgyal mtshan du khyod bsgreng ba yin no/ /phrag pa la khyod gzar ba yin no/ /kha skad du khyod 'don pa yin no/ /bcol ba'i las la rems shig rbad pa'i dgra bor mchongs lhagbskul ba'i bya bar rgyugs shog bos pa'i dus su byon zhig ji ltar gsol yang don mi bsgrub na/ khyod bsten pa'i don med pas re ba'i don sgrubs la sun ma 'byin zhig rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' ma bcogdkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig ma 'dral/ rdo rje'i mna' ma za/ gsang sngags kyi zhabs ma 'dren/ cha 'gying gi dbang ma che/ rgyud ngan dang snyoms las ma mdzad/ ngo bsrung dang zas phyir ma 'greng / ko long dang ru nga ma che/
༄tshi/ /mig ser dang phrag dog ma che/ brtse dung dang byams skyongs ma g.yel/ deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying dang snying gi grogs por mdzod la phrin las thogs med du sgrubs shig cesapa dang / dgra bo dmigs bsal la rbad dgosapa'i dusabyung na/ hoX gzhan yang gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bcol bar 'os pa'i don gal po che 'di ltar mchis te dam nyams pa'i dgra bo pha bu bza' tshang mi nor srid sde dang bcas pa 'di rnams/ snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon khyod la zas skal du gtad pa yin pas dgra bo che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba'i gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig /sa'i rten phur phyungs shig snying khrag thang la pho zhig klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs shig pho lha dang phyes zhig pho 'dre dang sprod cig mo lha dang phye zhig mo 'dre dang sprod cig zhang lha dang = zhang 'dre dang : yul lha dang : yul 'dre dang : srog lha dang : srog 'dre dang sprod cig 'go ba'i lha lnga dang phyes zhig /gnod pa'i 'dre lnga dang sprod cig gzhan yang dgra bo 'di la bsrung ba'i gur yod na pho nya'i lag gis sdus shog brtsigs pa'i mkhar yod na rdo rje'i thog gis choms shog brdeg pa'i mtshon cha yod na rang mtshon rang la 'khor cig bsags pa'i nor rdzas yod na brlag pa'i gzhir gyur cig bzlas pa'i sngags yod na sdig can rang la sdigs shig skyobs pa'i srung ma skurdzod na gnod pa'i 'drer gyur cig gzhan yang khang pa ro yis
'geng ba/ gshin rje'i lcog brdungs thong zhig rims nad khrag tu 'dzag pa/ ma mo'i lcog brdungs thong zhig pha tshan gri khar 'chi ba/ bdud kyi lcogaza dpon g.yog bza' tshang 'khrug pa/ rlung lha'i lcog: cir snang 'dre ru mthong ba/ mon pa'i lcogaza mdze lhog phol mig 'ong ba/ klu'i lcog brdungs thong zhig gag lhog skrangs 'bur 'ong pa/ gnyan gyiza dmu chu rdel nad 'ong ba/ dmu'i: kha mig ltag par skyel ba/ gza'i lcog: dug gzer sbos grir 'chi ba/ btsan gyi lcog: thog dang ser ba gtong ba/ sde brgyad kyi lcog: stod kyi tsha ba'i nad rnams nags me rlung gis sbar ba bzhin du thong zhig smad kyi grang ba'i nad rigs shwa 'od dang chu rgod rdol ba bzhin du thong zhig rlung mkhris bad gan ldan 'dus kyi nad rnams rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa bzhin du thong zhig lus bye ma'i mkhar chus bshig pa bzhin du thong zhig srog mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin du thong zhig khar rje dbang thang 'dab chags ga31ga pa chagaza ngag pi wang gi rgyud chad pa: sems dha ru ra'i khu ba 'thung pas myos pa bzhin du thong zhig dbang po lnga chu la snag tsha blug pas mogs pa bzhin du thong zhig yan lag shing sdong gi mgal skam rengs pa bzhin du thong zhig /pha tshan pho rgyud kyi rigs rnams shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad pa bzhin du thong zhig ma tshan mo rgyud kyi rigs rnams sgo nga brag la brdabs pa bzhin du thong zhig
༄tshi/ /bu dang che rgyud lcug phran zor bas brngas pa bzhin: steng gi mi rabs shing sdong rtsa ba nas bcad pa: 'og gi rta nor phyugs rabs rtswa phung la me rgyab pa bzhin du thong zhig /bar gyi g.yog rabs ser bas lo tog bcoms pa bzhin du thong zhig mdor na dgra bo gzugs ling ka la bris shing / ming byang dmar gyi dkyus su bkod pa 'di rnams mthu stobs dang drag rtsal thogs med mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sha zo/ khrag 'thung / rus mur / lings thob la ming tsam brda' tsam ma lus par tshar chod cig kha rje/ dbang thang / rim gro bsod nams kyi dbang du ma gtong / las kyi dbang btsan zhes snyad ma 'dogs/ tshe phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyi skye 'chi la khungs ma 'byin par da lta nyid du rab dkar tshems kyis chem chem bzhes la ming tsam brda' tsam tha snyad tsam yang ma lus par thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig cesadrag tu bskul zhing / brang brdung / 'o dod 'bod/ dul mo rdul/ thal mo sdeb pa sogs kyang bya zhing / las dmirigs bsal thor bu 'ga'i ched du byed na zur du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /cesapa'ang brtag pa'i 'char sgor 'di lta bu zhigadagosatshul byung ba ltar bzhuXd phyaX'i rdoX rjeXsaspel ba'o/ /sarba maṅgalaX/ /
༄༅/ /gter bdag 'bar ba spun bdun gyi las tshogs rdo rje'i gsang tshig ces bya ba bzhugs//
༄tshi/ /na mo gu sa mkha' 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum gtsan rgod dang bcas pa'i las tshoges don gnyisamachogastsol gyi sabacad dang po bla rdo khyad par can la brten nas mngon shesasogs las phran tshegs bsgrub tshul ni/ rtsa tho las/ tsan+dan gla rtsi gur kum dang / dam rdzas khu khragam da na/ rgya skyegs rnams kyisrtse chen brag /tshang ba'i bkod pa brisapa'i dbus/ /ri'u migadagu la tri dgu bri/ /bgegs bskrad khrusagasol de nyind ni/ /dur khrod rab 'jigs rtse chen brag /rim gsum srogabadag gnas su bsam/ /tri dgu srogabadag btsan rgod bdun/ /the'u brang gnyirisadang bcasapar bskyed/ /rang srogasngags kyisabod la bstim / / sngags kyisabasgrubs la 'jigarten sgya/ /sde brgyad srogabacud thim par mos/ /me toga'athor la shinasapa brjod/ /bskang bas zhal sred me mchod dbul/ /rgyun tu dar snasadril la bcang / /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dusaston dang / /khyad par spang blang brtag pa'i dus/ /nor sgrub dam can rdor legs kyi/ /las mtha' mngon shesabasgrub pa yiri/ /rim pas bsgrubs na shin tu myur/ /sam ya/ zhesagasungs pa ltar/ gsang rten bla rdo bca' ba/ de la brten nas sde brgyad kyi dusaston bya ba/ mngon shesabasgrub pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtse chen brag gi ngogs la bang rim gsum mchinasapa'i dang po mkha' 'gro
༄7/ /gsang sgrub rin chen kun khyab dang gnod sbyin nor lha'i gnas/ gnyirisapa brag logs nasashugastong skad gciga'akhyogapor skyesapa/'ogatu sde brgyad sho mo 'phen sa'i bragagadan bting ba lta bu mchisapa sde brgyad rnams sho rtsed rtse ba'i gnas shin tu gnyan pa/ mkha' 'gro nang sgrub zla ba rang gsal srogbdag rgyal po sku lnga dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas/ rim pa gsum pa mkha' 'gro phyi sgrub bde chen dpal 'phreng btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun rgyu ba'i gnas/ da lta lam thogatu yongs su grags pa'i shugasdong bdun dang bcasapa de yirin pas rim pa gnyisapa'i bragangogs nasardo leb cham pa ji ltar 'tshams pa zhigablangs te/ rdul bsal sposadakar gyisabadugs/ /tsan+dan dmar po/ gla rtsi/ gur kum/ chosasman/ byang sems dkar dmar rnams chang dang rgya skyegs kyi khu bar btab pas snyu chen drag them rim pa gsum pa ji lta ba bzhin brisapa'i rim pa gnyirisapa'i sde brgyad kyi ro gdan rdo leb kyi bkod pa'i dbusasu mu khyud zlum por bskor ba :ring dgur bcad pa'i re'u migarer tri re brisapa stegs gtsang ma'i steng du bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshoges par bgyisal/ sbyangs bkrusasngon du 'gro bas bsang sbyangs/ 3steng pa:sdi ngang 95traṭa skad cab/ lha/ //shār
khrod rab 'jigs rtse chen brag /ri gsum srog bdag gnas pa'i dbus/ tri dgu gtum drag btsan rbesnad bdun/ mdog dmar bse yi khrab rmog gyon/ /rab tu rngams pa'i cha byad can/ /mdung dmar zhags pas dgra bgegs sgrol/ /'khor gsum dpa' bo'i chas kyis brgyan/ /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i rta mchog bcibs/ /las byed the'u brang dkar nag gnyis/ /rang mdog can gyi zha gos lham/ /myur mgyogs g.yo ba'i bzhon pa can bla srog 'jug pa'i rkyal ba 'khur/ /rtsis 'debs rnge'u'i gal rta dang / /bre srang sho mo gdan dang bcas/ rnam 'gyur cha byad nyams re mtshar/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /thugs srog dwangs ma'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros spyan drangs gnyis med gyur/ /bcan rgod kyi rtsa sngags mthar/ tri'u tri'u shan+ti dzaXdzaX tri'u tri'u ṣaṇ+ḍa dzaXdzaX badz+ra sa ma ya dzaXsaspyan dwangs/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta dang bcas pas mchod/ kye/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i thugs dam can/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun po/ /rab 'jigs rngams pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sde brgyad dregs par bcas la bstod/ /gdags kyi the'u brang dkar po dang / /sribs kyi the'u brang nag po ste/ /shan+ti ṣaṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba/ /'phung byed cho 'phrul can la bstod/ /ma rtogs btsan rgod mched bdun te/ /tshogs drug kun gzhi nyid kyi rtsal/ /rtogs na byang chub yan lag bdun/ /ye shes chen por smin la bstod/ /phyi ltar

༄tshi/ /bdag gi srog phywa/ dgra phywa/ grogs phywa/ khyim phywa/ mgron po yong mi yong / nor rnyed mi rnyed/ bor ba rnyed mi rnyed/ nad pa 'tsho mi 'tsho/ don 'grub mi 'grub sogs gang yin pa de gsal por ston cig cesadamod bor te sho stan gyi steng du sho gnyirisamanyam du 'phangs pas/ kyu/ tig gnyis shar na/ 'phags pa shel bzang gi sgron me'i lha thig le rtsal gyi zhal na re/ /mi khyod kyis bsten pa'i chos phywa ni bzang ste/ bla ma'i thugs rje dang rang gi las 'phro 'dzoms / chos byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ skye bo yin na rgyal po'i bang mdzod la dbang / ma bsams pa'i sa nas nor 'byung / ma byas pa'i las bzang po gtam dang bcas 'ong bas bzang / spyir khyim phywa/ nor phywa/ don phywa / grogs phywa/ srog phya kun la bzang / khyim la srung ma 'khor bas gzhi brling / nor la dbang thang che/ don 'grub ste nor gyi bsnyen bkur 'bul/ srog la tshe rgyas thebs bas sra/ rdo rje legs pas 'di ltar smra/ phu na gangs chen lha 'khor/ bar na mi nor g.yang che/ mda' na chu chen klu phyugs/ mo 'di ñtsu la btab kyang bzang / rtser song bas phal pas 'khyag pa dka'/ zhes gsungs/ 7/ do lo gnyis shar na/ lha mo brtan ma na re/chos phywa slob dpon gyis zin/ bsgrubs na lha 'grub/ mchod na lhas mgon byed/ rtag tu chos byas na dga' 'o/ /khyim phywa la rang nor mi la mi shor/ mi nor dbang du bsdu ba'i ngo / /srid phywa la bu gnyis 'ong ba'i ngo / /
don phywa la don 'grub/ nad pa la sngags bon gyi dkor bdag chags pa'i nor rjes 'brangs pa'i 'dre gdon rgyal po dang / grib ngo che bas rgyal mdos skyol/ brgya bzhi thong / rnam 'joms lo grangs sum 'gyur bton na phan / nor bor na rnyed/ bden nam mi bden zer na bden/ e 'grub mi 'grub zer na 'grub/ yin nam min nam zer na yin/ khyim phywa chos byas na bzang / rang dbang thob ste bzang / gang la btab kyang mo 'di bzang zhing bden no/ /zhes gsungs/ mya/ sug gnyis shar na/ gangs lha dkar mo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / chos phywa ni lha phran kun gyi rje/ /gangs ri phu la bzhugs/ /chos srid sa la btab/ /bden pa'i chos la bsnyen / kun gyi phyag gi gnas/ khyim phywa ni kun gyis bkur/ mnga' ris mtho/ mi pho rgas khar skyid/ chu bo chad khar che/ nyi ma nub khar dro/ srid phywa ni/ lhas skyob/ gnyen gyi mgon/ lus bskyed/ tshe bsring shin tu bzang ngo / don phywa ni/ don 'grub grogs che/ ngo so dang bcas pa 'byung / mgron phya ni/ dga' ba'i 'dzum/ snyan pa'i gtam/ nom pa'i nor dang bcas te/ da lta myur bar 'ong ngo / nor bor ba rnyed thang / yin nam min zer na yin/ e bden zer na bden/ chang zhim/ char 'bebs sra yang 'bebs/ zhes gsung ngo / / mya/ cig gnyis shar na/ gnam sman dkar mo na re/ /chos phywa ni seng ge dkar mo 'dra/ sder chags yongs kyi rje/
༄tshi/ /dpa' rtsal stobs dang ldan/ gzhan snang zil gyis non/ khyim phywa ni// gser gzhong mar khus bkang bas bzang / srog phywa ni lcags kyi rdo rje yin pas bzang / nad pa ni nad thog tu sman song bas myur du sos yong / don phywa ni/ dam can skyes bus grogs byed pas myur du 'grub/ nor phywa ni g.yang sgo nyams/ phyugs kyi nang du god 'dre bsen mo zhugs 'dug pas gzungs 'dus brgya tshar sgrogs/ g.yang skyabs thon/ klu 'bum bklag bud med sbrum ma'i rnal gyis lha mnol 'dug pas/ lha bsangs khrus gsol gyis/ srid phywa med/ dgra phywa phugs pham/ g.yul dang shwa 'gyed na rang rgyal/ bsgrubs na gang yang 'grub/ e bden zer na bden/e yin zer na yin/ e yod zer na yod/ zhes gsungs/ lhe/ kha gnyis shar na/ lha sman gcig shar mo'i zhal nas/ chos phywa ni lha chos mi yong / skyes sgrub skye bo'i mo la bzang / /skyes pa 'phan po'i bu yis gso/ /pha mnyes byas pa'i lag rjes che/ /khyim phywa la pha yi ma 'dre rjes la 'brangs pas mnan bsreg bgyis/ na tsha 'ong nyen che/ srog phywa ni/ bla 'khyar 'dug pas tshe 'gugs kyis/ srog la drod nyams pas tshe gzungs thon/ tshe dbang zhus/ tshe sgrub gyis/ nor phywa bzang / tshong byas na rang rgyal te bsam pa bzhin 'grub/ dgra phywa ni dgra med/ byams pa dang 'phrad/ don phywa ni/ 'bras bu'i snye ma la glo bur gyi ser bas brdung grabs yod/ yang na
'ja' tshon 'ded pa 'dra/ spyir mi khyod spro thung / rgyud 'khrug /tshig pa za ba zhig rgyun du brda'o/ /e bden zer na bden/ yin nam min zer na min no/ /zhes gsungs/ mya/ thug gnyis shar na/ sman mo khrag kun gser mig ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa rnga mong ga pa yin/ than rigs kun tshang chos ni ñtsu la yong / /mi khyod rgyal khams thags su 'thag /ri klungs spyang ltar myul/ don med ha thang chad/ khyim phywa mtshan mo gnyid srungs / nyin mo ma yengs par bros/ mgo dpon bzang po zhig btsal na rnyed tsam yong la che/ srog cha srog sra bas mi 'chi yang / nad ngo che bas brgya bzhi thong / gtsug tor sgrogs/ dgra phywa ni/ dgra'i lag tu nor snying dang 'dra ba shor dogs yod/ don phywa ni/ kha mchu dang thug nad pa shin tu ngan/ dpyad mi tshugs/ yas mi nus/ lhas mi skyob/ nor phywa ni/ yod pa bor/ med pa rnyed/ phar 'jal tshur len gyi ngang du mi tshe zad 'gro /bsgrubs na 'dre 'grub/ bden nam mi bden zer na skyug rdzun kho na yin/ e yin zer na ngo ma min te ngo tshab yin/ ngan pa dgu 'dzom/ rnga mong gwa pa'i mo 'di gang la'ang ngan/ zhes gsungs/ mya/ tig dang do lo shar na g.ya' sman dkar mo'i zhal nas/ chos phywa ni/ tshe stod la chos byas na tshe smad la sdig pa 'ong / gzhon dus btsun pa byas na rgas khar bu dang 'phrad/ 'dam btsan ya ba skya gcig yin pas skye bo byas na mi rgod po
༄tsho/ /gcig 'ong / khyim phywa khyim la gser yod de sgo la nor med/ lto ston pa nyung / khyim gyi dur sa de spos na bzang / srog phywa srog lcags mkhar sgo rim la chud/ srung 'khor me ltar 'bar bas bzang / grogs phywa grogs chung / ri bong gi sha tsam la dka' las dang sdug sran bskyed dgos/ don phywa don 'grub pa dka'/ phyi thal che/ mgron po mi yong / nad pa nad yun ring yang mthar sos yong / rim gro dge slong bzhi la ston mo zhus sngags pa dgus rgyal mdos thong / dgra cha dgra ngo yod/ 'bros sam thub na da ni ran/ bor ba mi rnyed btsan mo'i mo/ 'bring tsam yin/ zhes gsungs/ mya/ tig dang sug 'phrad/ shing gi lha mo gser zangs ma'i zhal nas/ chos phywa ni/ sman sgrom kha phye na 'dod dgu'i rtsa ba ste shin tu bzang / khyim phywa/ srog phywa/ don phywa/ dgra phywa/ grogs phywa kun la bzang / mgron po lam zhugs bzang / srid phywa bu gnyis yong / gnyen phywa mthun gnyis zung du bsdebs na spang dkyil la zhing rmos te bzang / mgron po phy-i thal che/ 'bring gi rab yin pas legs/ zhes gsungs/ mya/ tig dang cig shar na/ bdud mo shu'i ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ phu'i rabs chad dang / mda'i srin mo gnyis 'phrad pas gar 'gro gar sdod kyang bkra mi shis/ khyim la the'u brang dang / gre bo gre mo gnod pas bdud mdos thong / nor phywa la nang nas rkum mas khyer/ phyi nas jag pas bdas/
bar du god kha mang bas dgra sri gnon/ srid phywa la/ chung sri kha dmar sre mong 'dra bas bu tsha byi'u ltar sgug 'dug gdon chen bco lnga'i mdos glud thong / don phywa don mi 'grub/ bsam pa dang bya ba mnol/ grogs phywa la/zan gzhong pa'i nang du khyi yis za/ bse rags kha nas sde brgyad bcoms bya ba yin pas pha mes kyi lha srung gsol/ srog phywa ni/ srog gi byi'u mgo dmar la/ khra yis sbar mo btab zin pas/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog ma gtogs pa/ /sus kyang de nyid blu ba dka'/ /spyir khrag ngo yod/ mgron po mi yong / bden kyang mi bden/ lha dang don gang yang mi 'grub pa'i mo/ zhes gsungs/ rmya/ tig dang kha shar na/ sman gyi lha mo tshe 'dzin ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phya ni/ dpag bsam ljon shing nor bu'i sdong po la/ /'dod pa'i shing lo cha ma cho/ /snying po'i me tog si li ñtsā/ /dgos dgu'i 'bras bu sha ra ra/ /rtse la lta bya khu byug lding / /snyan pa'i gsung skad lhangs se lhang / /sang phod nga tshod mi khyod dgos dgu'i dbus su 'dren/ khyim phywa ni pha srid bu yis dbang / yul mkhar gyi bdag po byed de/ khyod la sngar bslu nyes dang gyod kha byung na des 'thus/ ma byung na da 'ong blos gtad pas snying rku nyen che/ rlung khyim sbug nas ldang ba la/ sgo mo bcad pas ga la phan/ bor ba myur du rnyed/ grogs phywa la/ phyi thal gyis ma chod na grogs shin tu che/ tshong la btang na khe che/ lha bsgrubs na dngos
༄༅/ /grub myur/ nad par myur du phan/ yong ngam byas na yong / /yong mi yong byas na yong / yin nam min zer na yin/ e bden zer na bden/ spyir dpag bsam tshe'i lha mo yin pas mkhar brtsig zhing 'dabs bag ma len/ ldum ra bskrun/ mthun bsdebs/ gseb gtong / chang 'tshod pa la sogs pa thams cad la bzang ngo / /zhes gsungs/ mya/ tig dang thug shar na/ mtsho'i lha mo lcug phran ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ dbyar zla gsum la mgron dang 'khon/ thab gzhob 'ong / dgun zla gsum la ma smad sdug kha mchu 'ong / dpyid zla gsum la mu ges 'chi/ ston zla gsum la dgra 'thab/ bros kyang mi thar/ bsags tshad zad/khyim phywa byer zhig la song dogs yod/ tshe stod las tshe smad skyid/ ban bon gyi nor khyim du ma 'jog 'dre 'ber dogs 'dug go /rang 'gro na phyi thal du 'gro/ nad pa nad gzhi che ste skyon med/ srog phywa bum pa'i nang du 'dug pas bzang / grogs phywa dpag bsam shing du 'dug pas bzang / srid phywa la bu bzhi 'byung / gdon phywa la mo 'dre gnod/ lcugs phran rtse mo chu la phyogs/ mdza' bo mthun 'jug byed pa'i mo yin/ zhes gsungs so//lhe/ de lo dang sug shar na/ tshe bdag mkha' 'gro dmar mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa la/ /dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i gzungs thag dmar po la/ /rdo rje tshe yi
rig par ldan/ /mi khyod kyi tshe srog de'i nang du 'dug pas/ 'chi bdag bdud kyis mi thub/ bsam pa'i don 'grub pas legs/ khyim phywa ni/ mkhar khra mo nor 'dzin gyi rdzong / sman khra mo zas kyi rdzong / bag kyang yangs na khyi dang rkun mas kyang bag yangs su spyod nyen yod do/ /srid phywa ni bu mo mang / bu dkon/ lha bzang pos mgon byed pas don 'grub/ nad pa 'chi nyen yod pas 'chi blu bskyel/ byad kha che/ dgra ngo yod pas gzabs/dgra mnan gyis/ grogs phywa la mi khyod kyi gna' bo lha yis byas/ grogs ngo so dang bcas pa 'ong / tshe'i bum pa sgrub pa byed pa'i mo la bzang / zhes gsungs/ mya/ do lo dang cig shar na/ 'dod 'byung srin po'i zhal nas bstan pa'i chos phywa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin chen yin/ bsam pa kun 'grub kun gyis mchod/ khyim phywa gtam snyan gyis rgyal khams 'gong / mi khyod la smon lam lhas 'debs/ sdang ba'i dgras mi tshugs/thams cad dbang du 'du/ srid phywa bu gnyis sam gsum la dbang / pha bas bu phyug srog cha bzang / gdon phywa 'gong po dang btsan gnod/ don phywa grogs phywa gnyis grogs che yang lan chags yod pas chu gtor thong / lha bsgrubs na 'grub/ tshong byas na gang bsam 'grub/ gnyen dang mthun bsdebs byas na bzang / bden yang nges par bden/ nor bu'i lha mo yin pas don gang che 'grub/ phran tshegs tsam mi 'grub pa'i mo yin no/ /
༄tshi/ /zhes gsungs/ rmya/ do lo dang kha shar na/ rdo rje lha mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ sus kyang mi thub rdo rje'i gur du tshud pa 'dra/ thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs khyim phywa bsod nams las 'phro 'dzoms / chos dang nor gnyis ka la dbang bas bzang / bya ba dur sa gcod/ srung ba bcos thabs dang rim gro byed pa bzang / nad pa rim gro byas na skyon med/ rgyal po dang / bsen mo/ klu dang sa bdag gnod/ srid phywa la bu gcig yod/ lha ni gang bsgrubs kyang 'grub/ rdo rje'i lha mo yin pas gzhan don thams cad 'grub/ rang don bar chad kyis mi tshugs pas bzang ngo / /zhes gsungs/ kyu/ do lo dang thug shar na/ dung dkar lha mo dung sman mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ bkra shos dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil/ /bdud rtsi ro brgyas dung phur bkang / /snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur bskyod/ /mi khyod rtag tu snyan grags che ba 'ong / khyim phywa ni/khyim du klu sman bzang po 'go thab gzhob 'bon la 'dzem/ mi pho rgas khar skyid/ rta pho 'tshong khar rgyug skyid kyi nyi mas phyi ltas byed/ mthar bskyel yong bas blo bde bar gyis/ srog cha rta brdabs dang g.yang la shor nyen yod/ don phywa khrag ngo yod/ srid phywa bu mo 'byung / nad pa myur du 'tsho bas lto mi dgos/ sman gyis chog the'u brang gnod/ grogs phywa grogs kyi rked pa chad/ nor phywa sbyang mos zas la rngams/ dung sman mkha' 'gro bkra
shis pa'i mo yin pas gzhan don kho na bzang / zhes gsungs/ mya/ sug dang cig shar na/ shing rtse spre'u'i lha me'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni spre'u'i bya ba 'dra/ mi don mthar son rang don chad pa shor/ kha 'dar khong nas 'dar/ ngo srung gdong la blta/ rang gos rin med 'tshong / chung mas gyod kha bdas/ bza' 'thab slong / ngu 'bod rgyun mi chad/ khyim nas kha mchu 'ong / nor phywa nor snying dmar can nam/ dkar can god dogs yod de god na g.yang nyams/ nor phyir shor/ nad pa rim gro sman gyis phan na ma gtogs srog la sbar mo thebs pas 'tsho ba dka'/ gdon du rgyal bsen dang klu gnod/ don phywa ni/ mi ro thab tu bsregs kyang gsur mi yong / byes lam du mi dogs yod/ 'ong 'ong zer na'ang mer gyis bsdad 'dug pas snga ma pas phyi ma dbang che'o/ /gtor ba mi rnyed/ nang du sbas pa 'dra/ bros pa mi thar sbre'u shing gi lha mo yin pas phran tshegs tsam ma gtogs brtan po mi yong gsungs/ 7/ sug dang kha shar na/ gangs dkar lha'i sman mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ mi rabs kun gyi gtso kro ste/ gser gyi thang ma la/ lha shing ldems se ldem/ me tog si li li/dgos 'dod char pa 'bebs/ byed pa lha yis byas/ byams pa dgras kyang byams/ bkur ba lha 'dres bkur/ sngon bsags bsod nams red/ khyim phyur khyod rtag tu/ zas gos nor dang phrad/ bsam pa yid bzhin
༄tshi/ /'grub / khyod kyi chung ma de/ bsod nams ldan pa yin/ bsags tshad chos la thong / mi nor yar la 'phel/ srog phywa don phywa la/ srog ni lcags las sra/ don ni yid bzhin 'grub/ nor 'phel grogs phywa la/dmar ngo cung zad yod/ nad pa myur du 'tsho/ sman yon grabs kyis shig klu dang btsan gyis gnod/ 'ong dang mi 'ong ni/ bya spu rlung khyer 'dra/ gar 'gro'i cha yang med/ lha sman dkar mo'i mo/ zhi ba'i las la bzang /zhes gsungs/ mya/ sug dang thug shar na/ thogs med rgyal mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ nya chu klung chen po la btsal sha ma rnyed na btsal/ da lta dbul zhing phongs kyang mthar bde bar 'gyur/ 'phral du ma skyid tsam byung yang / phugs lhas skyid po ster/ srid phywa nad pa kun la bzang / don phywa phyi 'khon nang 'khon yong / dme 'dre 'khor 'dug pas gzabs/ nor phyur gser 'od thon/ sems can spu tshan can gyi rjes la g.yang shor bas nor lha sgrubs/ chu 'dre gnod/ thogs med rgyal mo the'u brang gi mo yin pas 'bring tsam yin no gsungs/ mya/ cig dang kha shar na/ bdud mo ra yon nag mo'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ las 'bras ngan pas dbang byas nas/ /nam yang mi bde gar phyin kyang / /'khon dang 'phrad pas ma byas par/ /gyod tshabs che zhing labs na'ang / /mi phan 'jal yang mi yong ngo / /khyim phywa ni/ yi dwags khyim du bse rags phyin/ rlung
dang chu yi longs spyod med/ cung zhig rnyed pa btsan pos 'phrog srog phywa ni/ srog rta rnga tsam de chad nyen gda'/ tshe chog dang 'chi blu spom thag gyis/ ming de spos la lus sgyur zhig grogs phywa ni/ grogs stong ha re 'dugnor phywa nor chags yod/ khyim du ro sbas yod na myur du phyir phyungs/ med na 'ongs dogs 'dug dgra ngo che/ bor ba rnyed nas shor/ bdud mo ra yon ma'i mo 'di gang la btab kyang ngan no gsungs/ lhe/ cig dang thug shar na/ dri med zla shel mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa zla ba 'dra/ /yar 'phel mar 'grib gnyis ka yong / /khyim phywa bu sring ngam mo mgron gyi rjes su 'dre 'brangs nas bsags tshad za/ yod tshad la gnod de khyi thod kyi nang du mnan pa gyis/ don phywa bsam pa kha ma gang tsam 'ong / grogs phywa tshur yong phar gtong gnyis ka dgos/ mgron phya mgron po lam zhugs mo la bzang / nad pa zla ba gza' yis zin pa 'dra/grib gdon gnod/ /srid phya srid phugs che/ blo bya blo de kha'i ngang la ma gtong / dang po bzang yang phugs ngan/ zla ba'i lha mo'i mo ni zla ba dang 'dra/ 'phel 'grib kyi mo yin pas 'bring smad yin gsungs/ mya/ kha dang thug shar na/ shes rab mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ dug gsum rtsad gcod shes rab ral gri 'dra/ /pha rol rgol ba thams cad pham par byed/ /bsam pa thams cad rtsol med ngang gis 'grub/ /
༄tshi/ /kun gyis mi thub kun las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /khyim phywa ni/ gzhan nor dbang du 'dus/ /'bru yis bang mdzod gang / kha thur gser las byed/ lus la dar gyis brgyan/ srog cha ni/ lcags kyi bum nang du/ mi yi 〈snag sbas pas/ tshe yi rgyas btab pa/ rdo rjes kha bcang pas/ bshas lug bshan pa yi/ lag nas phregar ro skad/ srid phywa la srid 'phel/ nad pa lug ltar 'khun kyang / sman pa daskyurdzod cig thekhor/ nad pa nad las 〈snal nas rta rgyugs byed par 'ong / klu dang sa bdag gnod pas/ de yi bcos kyis shig don phywa ni blo stag mo las dpag rtsal che/ yon tan gyi che ba dang bcas te don 'grub skad/ mgron po phar 'gro bzang / tshur 'ong ngan bor ba thengs gsum phrad kyang thengs gsum por/ dgra po tshur la mi 'ong / phar la brgyab na rang rgyal/ grogs phywa dmar ngo che/ shes rab ral gri'i mo 'di dmag dpon dang gtso bo'i mo la bzang / chos byas na rig pa'i phyosnags la mchog sgom gang 'dod kyi chos ni mi 'grub skad/ ces gsungs/ ma yos shel gyi mo rdo rje legs pas/ slob dpon chen por dngosasu phul ba las btusapa yirin no/ /rjesasu gag rag gi mchod bstod bgyisate sho la bstim/ za 'ogagi khugamar bcuganas mchan khung g.yon du bcang / dam tshigadang mi ldan par shin tu gsang ngo / /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /rngam zhal bzhaXd phyaX'i gad mo des/ /rdoX rjeX'i gsang tshigasgrogabyed pa'i/ /bcan rgod bdun gyi las mtha' spel/ /gter bdag 'bar ba spun bdun gyi las tshogs rdo rje'i gsang tshigagi le'u chan no/ /
༄tsho/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun gyi bsreg pa me'i las sbyor gyi cho ga reg 'joms me zhun zhes bya ba bzhugs//
ra༅thu dusagasum rgyal ba thamasacad kyi/ /rnam sprul mtsho 9skyesardo rje dang / /dbyer med ye shesamakha' 'gro mar/ /rtse gcigagusapa'i yind kyisa'adud/ /btsan rgod chen po 'bar ba spun bdun gyi 'phrinan las gang gi yang skabasasu mkho ba'i me mchod kyi rim pa lag tu blang ba la/ /spyir bsgrub pa dang bye brag tu bsgrub pa gnyiris/ dang po ni/ dregs pa spyi'i sregachogacigalogs su bri bar 'dod pas der shesapar bya'o/ /gnyirisapa la hom mchod rkyang pa la brten nas glo bur las bcol gyi tshul du bsgrub pa dang / /sprosabacas me mchod kyi rim pa g.yin dang khririgs mthun par bshad pa gnyiris/ /dang po la yang rgyas pa dang bsdusapa gnyiris/ dang po la sbyor dngosarjesagasum las/ dang po niri btsan rgod drag po gnas pa'i sa phyogs su migadamar sogs drag gza' la babasapa'i tshe stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar zangs gzhong gnang du phud phye ma nyams pa khrag chang girisasprusapa'i btsan bshosazur gsum mi rta khyi gsum gyi sha khrag dang ra'i dbang po sna lngas brgyan pa/ che ba gcigal 'khor rang 'dra drugagisabaskor ba grub na gsang rten gyi sroga'akhor man ngag bzhin brisapa pra tshil dang tshil bsresapas gtums pa'am/ smyugabugalta bur bcugapa gtor ma thams cad dam gtso rtsogator gyi nang du gzhug dar dmar po kha ma nyams shiring griri so
༄tshi/ /ma gtang pa las ma song zhing dris ma sbags par btsan rgod phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam 'gyur ba stong bskul nas 'byung ba bzhin brinasapa zangs dmar gyi mdung so bskyon pa'i mdung dmar gyi ngosal btags nas rab gnas dang ldan pa bgyisapa bcugs/ de las stegs dma' ba'i mdun ngosasu mi rta khyi gsum dang ra'i sha khrag gisaspags pa'i dpal gtor zur gsum che ba gcigagi nang du sha'i shun pa la dgra bo'i gzugs skye mched dod pa ming rusadang bcasapa brisapa'i mthar/ 6༷kho nā ga shushāmi tsa ra ra tri hā)ṅka ra yak+ṣa yak+ṣa sa ma ya hūX phaṭa/ gon /༷spya che ge 31 kā ya hab ling mugs thuX tsit+ta rbad/ 11ga sa ma ya hab le hab le mā ra ya dzaXdzaX nā ga shushā) sa ma ya khugrag rgyug breng breng sha truX tsit+ta dresag mā ra ya dzaXdzaXhūX phaṭa: cesapas bskor ba nyesalteb tu bgyisate/ tshone skud kyisab:rings pa bzhug dugashogamatho gang ba gcigal dgra po'i liṅga skye mched tshang bar miring rusabla dwags dang bcas man ngag bzhin brisapar/ zag rdzas ra khragagisabyugs pa ma lteb par mgo mjugaldogaste gtor ma la btsugs/sman raka phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ phyi nang gsang rten ci 'byor ba dang / phud ma nyams pa'i gser skyems gtsang ma miri rta khyi
gsum gyi khragaskyems phye mar sogs spyan gzigs dkor cha ci 'byor ba dang / skye mtshe/ shiring mche/ yungs gar nag /lcags zangs/ mi bsad kyi rbab rda'i phye la lcags slang du cher ma can gyi hom/ mar nagadagang blugs sogs 'ogatu dgosapa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyirisapa ni/ rang nyikod lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa sngon du 'gro bas zhe sdang giri sems dang ldan pas dgugagazhugalan gsum la sogs pa bgyisate/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas gnas yo thams cad dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i longs spyod las byung ba'i rang bzhin du byin gyisabarlabs/ sgrub gtor bsang sbyangs/ 3steng pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du ljon shing brag dmar gyis gtams pa'i ri po 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ mtsho rdzing dang lhing khas brgyan pa/ ce sbyang dang stag gzig mang po rgyug cing 'phyo ba/ ro langs ngang 'byung po du mas khus 'debs shing khrag zhag gis phyogs kun khyab pa/ dur bya nang khrol thogs te mi sdug pa'i skad 'byin cing bar snang gaphre/ga rlabs kyis bskyod pa/ sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang rgyu dang bkod pa phun sum lhanags shing / rab tu brjid pa'i nang du tri dmar po las byung ba'i mchims phu brag btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal/ g.yu lung gangs btsan rdo rje dbang btsan rtsal/ spa ri spa btsan rdo rje ye shes rtsal/ kong ma grib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal/ pu ri pu btsan rdo rje srung ma rtsal/ brag dmar rdzong btsan rdo rje dgra 'joms rtsal/ stag ma rong btsan rdo rje legs pa rtsal thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po shin tu khro zhing gtum pa/
༄༅/ /bzod par dka' ba'i mdangs myur mgyogs kyi shugs ldog par dka' ba'i stobs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dpung / zil gyis mi non pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ dar dmar gyi ral ga'i steng na bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon zhing / stag ral g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ btsan phug zhol can dmar po rgyab tu bsnams pa/ rta mchog dmar po rlung gi shugs can/ sga srab gong rmed kyis spras par bcibs te rgyug pa/ mdung dar dang zhags pa la rber+shags pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs te/ dgra bgegs 'joms par rings par chas pa/ sprul pa/ yang sprul/ nying sprul/ sum sprul la sogs pa gnam sa bar snang gang pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs srog gi dwangs ma tri yig dmar nag 'od du 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ mchims yul/ pu ri/ rtse chen mdo/ mchims phu dpal gyi dben gnas la sogs phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas pa rnams nas dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX hrīX ljon shing brag ris gtams pa'i pho brang nas/ /sogs gsol kha rgyas par phul la/ rang gi thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros/mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du mdzad par bsams la/ oX nā ga tsan+ti tsa ra ra tri giṅkar yak+ṣa yak+ṣa sa ma ya hūX phaṭaX cesartse gcigatu bzlas nas thun mthar mchod cing bstod la tshwarin
las gsol/ rbad bsad kyi mde'u khyad par can gdags par 'dod na sgrub yirigalas 'byung ba bzhin shesapar bya/ skyer hom la me spar bsang sbyangs/ hrīr+shang pa'i ngang las gnam lcags las grub pa'i drag po'i thab khung kha khyer dog cing gting zab pa'i nang na 31na lkaṃng brag dmar gyis gtams pa sogs gong giri bskyed tshigagisabaskyed pa'am bsdu na spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bod rkyang pasagasal 'debs pa yang rung ste/ mchod bstod bgyis/ lha lhanags 'khosar bcas zhal gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i ljags 〈sna rje rtse gcig pa la raX dang /gzar bu gnyis la tri yig dmar nag 'od 'bar bas mtshan par gyur/ tsheX/ asna ye swā hā/ lan bdun dang bcasate blugs gzar gyisadagang gzar bkang / rtsa sngags kyi mthar gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung mardzo sarba mā ra ya rbad/ ja la raX zhesaspel tshigdang bcas te byon skyems phul/ gser skyems sngon du 'gro bas/ hrīX bdag ni rnal 'otswa1ra dam tshig can/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhal tshab ste/ zhesapa nas/ sa ma ya rjertoX3)༷༷'i bar gyisa'akhor tshogs rnams drag tu bskul la mkhyen dgongs dmod bcol niri/ khu1༷༷ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par du yang mthu dang stobs kyi bdag po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srung ma/ rdo rje dra po rtsal/ rdo rje dbang btsan rtsal/ rdo rje ye shes rtsal rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal/ rdo rje srung ma rtsal/ rdo rje dgra 'joms rtsal/ rdo rje legs pa rtsal/ rgyud gsum dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ mi mngon bar snang gi dbyings su rgyu ba'i mig nag hrig ge ba/ mche ba skya
༄tshi/ /zing nge ba/ lte dmar yug ge ba khyed rnams thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes kyi sgo nas gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig khyed rnams pos pa'i tshe na snyam ma sra/ g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma btul/ bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / bsgrubs pa'i tshe nang gong ma g.yel/ bskul ba'i tshe na phrag ma dog rbad pa'i tshen mthu ma chung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid bshog par byed pa spyi'i dgra/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa/ rgyab nas khra ltar 'jab pa/ lkog nas 'bu ltar g.yeng ba/ gdong nas khyi ltar zug pa/mdun nas 'ordzog par lta ba/ g.yas nas bsam pa ngan pa/ g.yon nas sbyor ba rtsub pa/ mgo nas ri ltar mtho gnon byed pa/ 'og nas rlung ltar bskyod pa/ bar nas chu ltar 'brug pa/ za lam du dug g.yo ba/ 'gro lam du rtsangs 'dzugs pa/ stobs 'byor dang mnga' ris 'phrog pa/ 'thab cing rtsod par 'dod pa/ 'khrug cing 'dzing bar 'dod pa/ 'gras shing 'khon par 'dod pa/ lus la na tsha gtong ba/ sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba/ srog la bar chad gtong ba/ bsam pa mi 'grub par byed pa/ mdor na gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs 'di rnams kyis/ /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la
gnod par byas so/ /dkon mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten bshogs so/ /bla ma'i sku la bsdos so/ /dge 'dun gyi sde bcoms so/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid la 'tshe'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la bsnyad bcugs so/ /srung ma khyed rnams la zhe 'gras so/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyi za sgo bkags so/ /lha chos kyi dam tshig las nyams so/ /mi chos kyi mna' tho bzas so/ /blo gtad sa'i snying brkus so/ /gros dris sa'i mtshang brus so/ /phan btags pa la dgrar bltas so/ /bzang lan ngan gyis 'jal 81/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gis/ dang por khas ma nyes so/ /bar du lag gis ma nyes so/ /tha mar sbyong bas ma nyes so/ /ngas nya ltar bros kyang / khos sram ltar ded do/ /ngas byi'u ltar bros kyang / khos khra ltar nged do/ /ngas sha ba ltar bros kyang / khos khyi ltar ded do/ /ngas gangs ltar dkar kyang / khos rdza ltar gnags so/ /ngas mkha' ltar yangs kyang / /khos sprin ltar gtibs so/ /mi nga la lha med zer ro/ /lha khyod la mthu med zer ro/ /mdor na bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo bza' tshang pha bu dang bcas pa 'di rnams da lta nyid du dmigs rten gzugs kyi liṅga 'di nyid la 'gugs pa'i phrin las malnga(da cig cesarigapa'i ngar dang ldan zhing zhe sdang giri mdangasam 'gagasapa'i rtsal snang smre ngag gi ngu skad lta busashugs dang ldan par brjod/ gtor ma likoṅga dang bcas par rak+ta spran la/ bsang sbyangs/ 3steng pa'i ngang las rang gi
༄༅/ /thugs ka nas e mthing nag cig chad/ /mdun du zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las dug dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom me 'bar ba gru gsum bang rim dgu dang ldan pa kha khyer dog cing nang gting zab pa/ de'i nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa/ mtshon ma'i drag char 'bebs pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar du 'phyo ba/ khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ gshon rje'i skyes bu dpag tu med pa rgyug pa/ 'than dang ltas ngan gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis gang ba gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams ni/ seng ltar rngams pa/stag ltar mchong pa/ 'brong ltar 'gying ba/ khra ltar 'dzul ba/ sbrul ltar 'khyug pa/ 'dre srin ltar ngu ba/ 'gong po ltar smyo ba/ srin bya ltar dgod pa/ wa mo ltar brgyal ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/gsod gsod dang rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pas gang ba/ de'i nang du bskal pa stong gi mun pa 'khrig pa/ phyi nas bskal pa stong gi me 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub pa/ gshin rje'i zhing khams/ bshan pa'i pho brang /srog gcod kyi grong khyer/ srid pa las kyi gzhal yas khang chen po/ dgra bo byad ma lha dang 'bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ las ngan thams cad rnam par smin pa'i btson khang drag po de'i dbus su/ /sangs rgyas kyi
bstan dgra/ dkon mchog gi spyi dgra /bla ma'i sku dgra /rnal 'byor gyi sgos dgra/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo gang gi rnam par shes pa mṛ tri dud kha yongs su gyur pa las dam nyams kyi dgra bgegs de dag nyam chung ba/ skyid pa phra ba/ skra gzings ba/ mdog nag cing bam pa/ mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bu ga dgu nas khrag dang rnag 'dzag pa/ kha nas sid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ srung zhing skyob pa'i lha dang bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de'i 'og tu zhing chen gyi sa gzhi brdal ba/ mtshon cha sna tshogs gzings te 'dug pa/ drag po'i tshwa tshwa chil li li khol ba/ de'i 'og tu rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'khrugs shing zhing chen gyi rba nyil nyil 'phyo ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i rlung dmar nag 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i rlung spu gris so rgal chil li li 'khrug pa/ de'i 'og tu drag po chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dgra bo thams cad gtan nas brlag par byed pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ bden stobs brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas rtsa sngags kyi mthar gnod byed dgra bgegs a par+ṣa ya dzaXdzaX aṅku gon dzaX pā ro/ hūX/ hrīr+sha ṭa baX/ ghaṇ+ḍi khu1༷༷ pra be ro/ ya phaṭa/ /65 be ro/ ya yisaX zhesadagugagazhugadrag tu bgyisarjes/ dam nyams dgra bo bza' chang pha bu mi nor phyugs gsum/ mnga' 'bangasasrinod sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi gzugs phung bla tshe srogadabugs rnams bcan rgod dgra lha chen po sde brgyad kyi
༄/ /tshogs la dugagasum sha khrag mngon sbyod drag po'i gsang mchod 'bul zhing zas skal du gag pa yirin pas/ dgra bo 'di rnams pho lha dang phyes zhig pho 'dre dang sprod cig mo lha dang phyes zhig mo 'dre dang sprod cig zhad lta dang phyes zhig zhang 'dre dang sprod cig yul lha dang phyes zhig yul 'dre dang sprod cig las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas ded cig 'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun nas bsus shig dpal gyi chad pa chod cig dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shoggnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod cig sa'i rten phur drung nas phyungs shog bla me stag yal ba bzhin du thong zhig srog mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin du thong zhig dbugs pags pa med pa'i spung mchu'i rlung bzhin du thong zhig gzugs bye ma'i chang bu zhig pa bzhin du thong zhig ngag pi wang gi rgyud thag chad pa bzhin du thong zhig sems dha ru ra'i khu ba btungs pas myos pa bzhin du thong zhig yan lag shing skam gyi mgal pa rengs pa bzhin du thong zhig dbang po lha chu la snag tsha blugs pas mog pa bzhin du thong zhig steng gi mi rabs shing sdong rtsa ba bton pa bzhin du thong zhig pha tshan pho rgyud kyi rigs rnams shong tā la'i mgo bo bcad pa bzhin du thong zhig ma tshan zhang rgyud kyi rigs rnams rgyus pa thab la btab pa bzhin du thong zhig mna' ma dang tsha rigs lcug phran zor bas brngas pa bzhin du thong zhig bu dang bu mo sgo nga brag la brdabs pa bzhin du thong
zhig bu sring dang mag pa me la chu blugs pa bzhin du thong zhig bar gyi g.yog rabs ser bas lo tog bcoms pa bzhin du thong zhig 'og gi rta nor phyugs rabs rtsa phung la me brgyab pa bzhin du thong zhig yul dang mkhar gzhis pha bong la thog brgyab pa bzhin du thong zhig bsod nams dang longs spyod me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin du thong zhig zas skal dang dbang thang dgun gyi chu phran bskams pa bzhin du thong zhig kha rje dang klung rta 'dab chags gakhuwag pa chag pa bzhin du thong zhig stobs dang nus pa gzi brjid khang rul rdib pa bzhin du thong zhig mthun rkyen legs tshogs nam langs kyi skar ma bzhin du thong zhig mi 'dod pa'i nyes tshogs nyi rgas gyi grib so bzhin du thong zhig nad gdon dang chags che kha char bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin du thong zhig stod kyi tsha ba'i nad rigs nags me rlung gis sbar ba bzhin du thong zhig smad gyi grang ba'i nad rigs shwa 'od dang chu rgod rdol ba bzhin du thong zhig rlung mkhris bad gan ldan 'dus kyi nad rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa bzhin du thong zhig 'go ba'i rims nad dbyar gyi char sprin 'thibs pa bzhin du thong zhigphan byed kyi sman rnams gnod byed kyi dug zos pa bzhin du thong zhig gri mdung mtshon khar sbrang bu me la lcebs pa bzhin du thong zhig khang pa ro yis 'gengs ba gshin rje'i cog brdungs thong zhig rims nad khrag tu
༄tshi/ /'dzag pa ma mo'i cog brdungs thong zhig pha tshan gri khar 'chi ba bdud gyi cog brdungs thong zhig kha mig ltag par bskyel ba gza'i cog brdungs thong zhig dug gzer sbos grir 'chi ba btsan gyi cog brdungs thong zhig smyo 'bog rang snang 'khrul ba rgya la po'i cog brdungs thong zhig grong khyer khang pa rdib pa 'gong po'i cog brdungs thong zhig mdze nad phol mig yong ba klu'i cog brdungs thong zhig dmu chu rde nad yong ba sa bdag gi cog brdungs thod zhig gag lhog skrangs 'bur yong ba gnyan gyi cog brdungs thong zhig gzhang 'brum 'on long yong ba dgra lha'i cog brdungs thong zhig cir snang 'dre ru mthong ba mon pa'i cog brdungs thod zhig dpon g.yog bza' tshang dkrug pa rlung lha'i cog brdungs thong zhig thog dang ser ba 'bab pa sde brgyad kyi cog brdungs thong zhig mon pa sgo 'khur ba/ a tsa ra brang brdung ba/ dam sri'i 'o dod 'bod pa 'gong po spun dgu'i ltas ngan thong zhig spyang kis spud pa 'bud pa/ spre'us rang 'thag bskor ba/ wa mos mi lab shod pa klu dang srin mo'i ltas ngan thong zhig rta bong glu sad len pa/ khyim bya sgro gshog rtse zhing mi skad 'don pa legs ldan nag po'i ltas ngan thong zhig rang 'thag bshug pa brdeb pa/ skyed pos gleng mo lab pa/ khang pa 'od kyis 'geng ba be dkar spun dgu'i ltas ngan thong zhig wa la spre'u zhon pa/ khyim phug 'ug pas
'geng ba nag po khros pa'i ltas ngan thong zhig rang gshed rang la phob cig rang mtshon rang la rgyob cig rang srog rang gis chod cig rang sha rang gis zo zhig rang khrag rang gis 'thung zhig rang nus rang la smin cigmdor na nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyi skye 'chi la khungs ma 'byin/ las kyi dbang btsan zhes bsnyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla ba zhag dang za ma ma 'gyangs par mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phye/ gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar tsam gyi ljags 'khyongs la/ dgra bgegs 'di rnams kyi sha zo khrag 'thung / dbugs slong /rus choms/ lings thob/ las kyi bla dang tshe srog spar gyis thob la/ ming tsam brda tsam tha snyad tsam du'ang sgra mi grags par rjes med thal ba rlung la bskur ba'i phrin las mdzod cig rbad bsad kyi las sbyor dngosagazhi dang 'grel ba'i thun brab sogs sngon nas song zirin na ched du mi dgosal gag du/ dzaX gtum drag nyams brgyar 'bar ba'i btsan rgod bdun/ /drag por khrosapa'i sku las sprul pa'i gzugs/ /sbal sbrul sdom sdig nya lcong stag gzig dom/ 'phar sbyang dred dang dug mtshon char babs pas/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs gzugs la phog ma thag /sgo gsum myos rengs rmongs lkugs nad kyis gzir/ /sprul pa'i pho nyas srog 'phrog dbang po bsnubs/ /sha zos khrag 'thung pags
ra༅༅/ /pa gos su gyon/ /lhag med hab dir tsam du zos pa yis/ /ma lus rjes shul med par brlag par gyur/ /cesathun shed thon par brab :ring / rtsa sngags kyi gsham du sha truX che ge mo kā ya ya hab ling mugs thuX tsit+ta rbad/ srog sa ma ya hab le hab le mā ra ya dzaXdzaX nā ga tsan+ti sa ma ya rgyug rgyug /breng breng sha truX tsit+ta 11ga mā ra ya dzaXdzaXhūX phaṭaX cesadrag tu brjod/ spus rgyal 'khosar bcas gnam sa lta bu'i zhal/ /yangs por gdangs pa'i dpal gyi hom khung nang slar yang dgra bgegs gzugs phung bla tshe srog /rnam shes skye mched yul mkhar sde dang bcas/ /bstab pa tsam gyis rno ba'i tshems bar nas/ /dgyes dgu'i 'ordzongs spyod chen po'i dwangs mar sbyangs/ /mgur las bakhugrad de thugs gar bstim pa yis/ /dgyes 3)nga tshim ste lhag par mgu bar khugrar/ /rtsa sngags kyi sham bur mā ra ya rbad dz+wa la raX zhesagator ma likoṅga dang bcas pa hom la bsreg /rol mo'i cham rngams drag tu bya'o/ /gsum pa rjesakyi bya ba ni/ /sgrub gtor rten gtor du bzung ste bong pa'am/ /min na skabs 'dir hom nang giri ye shesapa dang dbyer med du bsresal gshegs/ /sroga'akhor phyung / gtor ror dgugagazhugadang drag sbyor gyi dmigs gnad kyisasha khrag rusapa'i longs spyod du byin gyisabarlabasal/ me nang gi gco 'khor rnams la sregardzas kyi tshul du dbul/ /gtang rag giri mchod bstod 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa bgyisate ye shesapa gshegs/ /dam tshigapa rang la bsdu ba 'am me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ thal ba bcan gyi rgyu srang ngam lam gyi bzhi mdor dor gru gsum du brusapar mnan/ bro brdungs/ las kyi rjesami mngon bar bya'o/ /bsdu na/ sgrub gtor gyi gshoms dang ngag 'don rnamasador te hom
mchod rkyang pa bgyisabs kyang rung ngo / /gnyirisapa ni/ mchod gtor yod pa'am med kyang rung ste drag shing giri hom brtsig /me sbar bud shing la dgugagazhuganan tan tu bgyisate byin gyisabarlabs/ ljon shiring brag ri mas me nang du btsan rgod 'khor bcas bskyed cing / spyan drangs par mchod cing bstod/ rtsa sngags kyi sham bur mā ra ya rbad dz+wa 95 raX zhesabatags te :ri rigs su phul/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la drag po'i 'phrin las bcol te gshegs su gsol ba yang rung / 'diri ni dgasnang bsregapa'i man ngag las byung ba yirin no/ /gnyirisapa ni/ kho bosabartsamasapa'i gnod sbyin chen po :ri'u dmar po me mchod la lha sngagasa'abyin 'jugabagyispas legs par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje thegapa'i bka' srung mchog /g.yo ba med pa'i dam tshigacan/ /gang giri bsregathabs 'phrin las kyi/ /'jugasgo don du gnyer ba las/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng man ngag bzhin/ rigartsal bzhud pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rjesabastan la phan phyir du/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa'i tshul gyisabashad/ /bka' srung 'bar ba spun bdun gyi me mchod kyi le'u tshan byerdzo// //
༄tshi/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po ya ba skya bdun gyi bskang gso chen mo 'dod dgu'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs//
༄tsho/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /gter bdag :ring pa blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde/ /lharing ga'i pad+mor bzhugs la dusakun tu/ /mchogadang thun mong dngosagrub stsal du gsol/ /de la 'dir gnod sbyin chen po ya ba skya bdun gyi thugs dam bskang bar 'dod pas yind mthun gyi gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar mazhi'i steng du bse phor raX rim po che'i snod du 'bru bzang gi phye rta dmar dang lugagro dmar gyi khragachang / dam rdzas bdud rtsi/ sman spod/ rin po che'i phye ma rnamasasbags pa las grub pa'i bzhosabu mkhar thabs dmar yo bad can/ steng du btsan bzhosabadun dang smad du sde brgyad kyi bzhosabu :ri rispas bskor ba'i rtse mor 'ugapa'i gzugs dang mda' 'ugasgro mar dar dmar btags pa gtsugs pa bkod/ mdun du bzhosabu mkhar thabs kyi steng du btsan bzhosazur gsum mtho gang las mi chung ba logs rer de bas chung ba'i btsan bzhosartse mo g.yas phyogs su cung zad gcusapa zur phyir bstan gnyisgnyisabakod/ rmang gi mtha' skor du mar mi'i rnam pa can bdun/ btsan bshosartse gcusabadun/ lugadang gla ba'i mgo can bdun bdun bar bar du bang ba mirigadagu ma bdun re la sogs pa 'god par/ bsam yas su mnga' bdag lha rnam rgyal grags pas bskul te sngags 'chang chen po ra ston gyisamadzad pa'i
༄tsho/ /gtor chogadagra lasarnam rgyal du bshad/ yang na mchod gtor btsan bzhosagru gsum bdun pa bya ste/ thams cad la sha khrag dang yungs gar gyisabargyan/ sman raka/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ mthun rdzas spyan gzigs phyi nang gsang rten la sogs pa :ri 'byor ba bkod pa mdzesapar bshams shiring / mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshoges par bgyisate bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'gror la gnasapa sngon du 'gro bas mthun rdzas rnams sngags drugadang phyag rgya drugagisabyin gyisabarlabs/ rten bsangs sbyangs/ hrīr+shang pa'i ngang las mngon rtogs 'di dag spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud dang / jag pa rtargyug gi bskul/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mchan gyis mjad pa'i khyi 'gyedasogs khungs rnam par dag pa du ma dang bstun pa las rang bzos bslad pa med do/ /rang gi mdun du btsan yul zangs thang dmar 21 khosar yug zangs ri'i 'phreng bas ba3glor ba'i dbus rda/ zangs brag gnam du bsnyeg pa/ rtse la rgod smug dang 'ug pa lding zhing 81gas la btsan skya rgyu ba/ rked par gcan gzan ngur zhing / rtsa bar dug chu 'khor+shal ba/ 'thor rlung dang me dpung 'tshub cing / steng gi nam mkhar sprin nag
lang long du 'khrigs pa las 'brug sgra drag po sgrog pa/ gnam lcags thog ser gyi bu yug 'tshub cing glog stong drag tu 'khyug pa'i brag ri'i nang du khrag mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi sgo dang g.yu'i bad can dur khrod rol pa'i rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du tri dmar po bdun yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi'u dmar po sku mdog dmar ljang khro zhing gtum la drag tu brngams pa srin po khros pa lta bu phyag g.yas zhags pa 'phangs te dgra bo'i ske nas btab par g.yon pa'i mdung dmar drag tu bsnun pa/ dar dmar gyi 'gying thod bcings pa'i 'og nas ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings shing me 'od 'brug pa/ zhal nas khrag zhag gi rgyun 'bab cing / spyan nas me'i skar mda' 'phro pa/ shangs nas mthor rlung 'tshub cing / snyan nas dug sbrul nag po lang long du 'phro ba/ dar dmar gyi zhabs skyems dang sha gos dmar po'i steng du zab ber dmar po za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol bar gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang zhing / rno ngar 'dzom pa'i ral gri glo la btags pa/ bse phub zhol can dmar po rgyab tu bsnams shing / /myur mgyogs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i rta mchog sngon po sgab nag dar stan dmar po/ rta sga khra bo/ dngul gyi gong thag /zangs kyi yob chen/ gser gyi
༄tshi/ /srab / g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyor/ sbrul nag gi rmed can chibs nas brgyug cing 'phyong ba'i phyi rol nas zangs kyi rlung 'tshub 'khrid cing / btsan gyi jag pa nyi zer gyi rdul phran lta bur 'gyed pa rus pa las skyes pa'i sku lta zhal gyi lta btsan sku mdog dkar ser za 'og dmar po ri mo sngon po che long du 'khyug pa'i ber dang / dar thod dmar po gsol ba/ phyag gnyis bse mda' bse gzhur bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha gdong myur mgyogs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i gyi ling la bcibs te rol tu khyi mo dung mdog mtshal mig ma glog sbyang 'bar ma 'khrid pa/ drod dang mdangs las skyes pa'i dro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rje dmar po me 'od 'bar ba g.yon pa zangs kyi zhags pa dgra la 'phangs nas thabs par/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rno ngar 'dzom pa'i shang lang 'phyar te bsnun pa/ dar le brgan gyi 'jol ber dang dar thod dmar po gsol ba/ mtshal lu rting dkar myur mgyogs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i gyi ling sga srab can bcibs shing khyi mo dmar mo mtshal mig ma kha gdangs shing / zangs kyi mche ba gzings pa/ zangs sbyang dmar mo rol du 'khrid pa/ chu ser las skyes pa ra ba gong gi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag chu dar sngon po'i ral ga dang dug sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dar sngon gyi thod gsol zhing / g.yas lcags mdung nag po 'phyar zhing /
g.yon pa sbrul zhags ring po thogs pa/ gyi ling ser po stag lag can sga srab kyis spras pa chibs shing / khyi mo dmar nag khrag mig ma kha nas dug rlangs sprin ltar gtibs shing lcags kyi mche sder can khrag sbyang dmar mo rol tu 'khrid pa/ sha las skyes pa rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan sku mdog dmar po be'u dmar pa'i slog pa gsol zhing dar thod dmar po bcings pa/ g.yas bse mdung dmar po 'phyar zhing / g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags ring po rdog cing 'phen pa/ gyi ling rkyang dmar sbo dang sna dkar sga srab kyis spras par chibs shing / khyi mo dmar mo mthing mig ma dmar mo khrag 'dzag rol du 'khrid pa/ dbu las skyes pa'i kaX ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang sngon dar nag gi ber dang thod bcings gsol ba g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar zhing g.yon 'breng zhags ring mo bla la btab ste 'khrid pa/ gyi ling rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la chibs shing khyi mo nag mo gzi mig ma lcags spyang 'bar ma nad rkyal ske la btags pa rol du 'khrid pa/ khrag las skyes pa'i rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan khrag mdog dmar po zangs khrab dmar po gsol zhing dar dmar gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyug cing / g.yon pa dar dmar gyi ru mtshon rlung ltar 'tshub pa/ btsan rta dmar zhur sga srab can la bcibs shing / khyi mo dmar mo gzi mig khrag ral can
༄tshi/ /dmar mo 'bar ma rol du 'khrid pa/ thams cad kyang stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'chang zhing / rno ngar gyi ral gri glo la btags pa/ btsan phub zhol can rgyab tu 'khur zhing ri bya pho rog steng nas lding ba/ ri khyi spyang k+ki phyi nas 'breng zhing bla gzugs 'ded pa khro zhing gtum la dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa srid gsum dregs pa'i dmag tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul phran 'khrigs pa lta bus bskor zhing sbrul pa cir yang 'gyed pa/la lar skyes pa gri phub thogs pa brgya/ bud med ral pa sprug pa brgya/ sngags pa phur pa thogs pa brgya/ dge slong mkhar bsil thogs pa brgya/ rjes nyul ban+de nag po brgya/ skyo bsangs 'bag dang seng ge /mon bu/ a tsa ra dang gar mkhan la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor zhing rnam 'gyur cing yang ston pa'i gtso 'khor thamasacad kyi spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āX thugs gar hūX gis mtshan par gyur/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas btsan yul zangs thang dmar po/ gnas mchog pad+mo bkod kyi byang gling zangs 'brog /pe har dkor mdzod gling la sogs pa gar bzhugs rdo rje'i pho brang rnams nas sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ ngag rtsoms hūX/ bzhengs shig bzhengs lhag chos sku'i klong yangs las/ /rab 'jigs drag por khros pa dgra bo'i gshed/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po gtum drag
yang le ber/ /mched 'khor 'bar ba'i dpung bcas da chur byon/ /dbang chen khro bo'i bka' sdod drag rtsal can/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor yongs kyi bsrung ma ste/ thogs med rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i pho nyar bcas/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /gsang ba'i yum can bka' sdod blon po dang / /sprul dang yang sprul snang srid dregs pa'i dpung / /sa dang bar snang gang ba'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas nas myur du byon/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /tshogs dang gtor ma mkho dgu'i mthun rdzas bshams/ /rtse gcig 'bod gdung snyan 'gyur rol mo 'khrol/ /dar dmar g.yab mo g.yabs tshe rings par byon/ /rngams brjid dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas su/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs brdzis pa'i rta mchog steng / /dgyes par bzhugs la 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i/ /dngos grub rin chen char du 'bebs par mdzod kye/ ngag brtsoms btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ /khrag mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /drag po'i pho brang yangs pa'i nang / /skyes bu btsan rgod mched mdun po/ /khro gtum mi bzad srin po'i gzugs/ /brngams pa'i gar stabs chems se chem/ /btsan 'khor dmag dpung 'bum sder bcas/ /de ring mgron du 'bod kyis byon/ /'chi med mdun sa rnam rgyal dang / /sham bha la dang rdo rje gdan/ /ri kro rtse lnga laṃ yi yul/ /
༄༅/ /bha ta hor gyi sgom gra sogs/ /rgyal po chags pa'i gnas rnams dang / /gzhan yang sa skya'i gtsug lag khang / /pe har gling sogs ma nges pa'i/ /gar bzhugs rdo rje'i pho brang nas/ /srog bdag gser gyi shang shang can/ /rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul/ /gcig las du ma'i gar bzhin du/ /rnam 'gyur rdzu 'phrul cir yang 'char/ /mngag gzhug pho nya sprul pa'i dmag /lha klu btsan dang ma bdud sogs/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyang 'u ru rtswa /ru mtshon sna tshogs zings se zing / /rta rgyug zhub can sha ra ra/ /kha cig mun pa'i lan bu gsig /gar 'chis 'phrul sgyur lings se ling / /la la than dang cho 'phrul 'gyed/ /ru 'dren 'bag seng glu gar mkhan spra sprel bya pho byi la sogs/ /grangs med sprul pa yang sprul kun/ /rnal 'byor las kyi ched du byon/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bskul ba'i las la bang ma bul/ /mthu dpung bskyed la dgyes bzhin du/ /mchod pa'i yul du gshegs su gsol/ /hwa la tri badz+ra sa ma ya dzaX dzaX hūX baX hoX gnyis su med par gyur/ shu la tri rā dza sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX nas shap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oX rak+ta rak+ta snying la hūX hūX hwa la gh+ri wa tri shu la hring hring dzaX dzaX i daX ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan bdun gyis gtso bo dang / ā kā ros
snyo 'khor spyir dbul/ sngar bzhin mchod/ sngags mthar oX āXhūX btagasapas nang mchod dbul/ gnod sbyin chen po srog bdag yang le ber sprul 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyedarnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams gyi gdong grogs mdzod sngags 'chang rnams kyi 'phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig cesabarjod cing me togador/ hūX/ ngag rtsoms dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag kun tu bzang / /snying rje'i dbang gyur mi bzad bdud kyi sder/ /gshe ba'i lang tsho gsar pa ngom byed pa'i/ /sprul pa'i gar mkhan bstan srung dbang por bstod/ /'gro la rjes chags ma bzod dbang gi mdangs/ /lhan skyes dga' bas myos pa'i 'od stong dang / /'grogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po chos sku'i khams/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pa shar la bstod/ /kun rtog srid gsum dregs pa sde brgyad kyi/ /rje bor mnga' gsol sems kyi rdo rje dang / /mi phyed 'chol pa'i khro rgyal tsi'u dmar/ /yang 'khor dam can
༄tshi/ /rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod/ /snyogs pa niri/ hūX/ ngag brtso.o pad+ma dbang dang gsal bdag he ru ka /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam chos srung dang / /khyad par sprul pa'i chos skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /rab tu brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs/ /gsang ba sngags dang so thar byang sems kyi/ /bcas mtshams las 'das sgo gsum 'khrul par gol/ /bag med le 'ordzo'i dbang gyur rnam par 'khyams/ /sdig ltung dri mas sbags pa mthol zhing bshags / / khyad par dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal bas nongs par gyur pa rnams/ /ma sbas bsam pa thag pas bshags byed na/ /byang zhing dag nas tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /bskang ba ni/ hūX/rab 'byams mkha' dbyings brdal ba'i khyon/ /dog por byed pa'am mchod sprin nam mkha'i mdzod/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas sbyong spel bsgyur byas pas/ /gnod sbyin thugs kyi dgyes pa skongs gyur cig /sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod yon kun tu 'khyil/ /phyi nang dbang po'i me tog phang phung g.yo/ /sha gsur sman spos dud pa mkha' lam khyab/ /rin chen til mar tshil chen snang gsal 'bar/ /ga bur gung gum mkhris pa'i dri chab 'brug / lha mi'i bza' bca' sha rus zhal zas spungs/ /zin dang ma zin snyan 'gyur sngam brjid sgra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mdzad med rnam pa lngas/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gsang yum blon
po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs/ /sprul 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs dam dgyes skongs las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /rta nag sga mdzes zhol chen 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ra lug khyi spyang spra sprel mtsha' lu'i bya/ /ban sngags mon bu dge slong a tsar+ya/ /bud med mdung dmar btsan zhags mda' ral gri/ /dar dmar gos thod sag lhag bse yi rmog /go mtshon rang skyob dgra 'joms khyad par sogs/ /rgyal po chags pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ /ma tshang med par bsags pa'i mthun rdzas kyis/ /gnod sbyin ci'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gsang yul blon po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs/ /sprul 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs dam dgyed skongs las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /gling bzhi ri rab bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ /rin chen ri po ma rmos lo tog dang / /khrus kyi rdzing bu dpag bsam shing la sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis spel ba'i mkho dgu'i rdzas/ /sgrub dang rtogs pa'i mchod pa bla na med/ /mi phyed gdung shugs drag po'i dad pa yis/ /rtsa gsum lha yi 'bor lo ma lus pa/ /rig rtsal rjen pa'i ngo bor yid ches pas gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gsang yum blon po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskags/ /sprul 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs dam dgyes skongs las bzhi'i dngos grub

gshegs snying po'i rtsal/ /gdod nas stong yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /snang bar 'byams klas dregs pa sde brgyad kyi/ /yang rje sprul 'khor blon por bcas la bstod/ /dmar nag khrag gi mdog can srin po'i gzugs gang dgu'i nyams rdzogs btsan zhags mdung dmar 'dzin/ /rta nag steng na 'bar ba'i btsan chas spras/ /gnod sbyin chen po yang le ber la bstod/ /mig sman mdangs 'dzin bdud phod lhab lhub g.yo/ /bhan phur thogs shing srid pa'i spyi zhwa gyon/ /bden pa'i dmod tshig drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog /gar stabs bsgyur ba'i sngags pa brgya la bstod/ /zhi dul bag ldan mthing gos snam sbyar mnab/ /rin chen 'khar gsil drang srong slong snod thogs/ /gser dpyang kyis mdzes sa gzhu dmar po gsol/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin dge slong brgya la bstod/ /re nag mi lpags dud 'gro'i g.yang shun gyon/ /kha gdengs mche gtsigs 'o rkyal ring du 'phyang / /ral pa sprug cing khros pa'i dul mo brdeb/ /mchong zhing rgyug pa'i bdud mo brgya la bstod/ /sra brtan khrab gyon dom ru ang zing gis/ /mtshan pa'i zhub can stag dong gri 'dzab btags/ /g.yas g.yon gri phub rngams pa'i bswo sgra ldir/ /g.yul du chas pa'i stag shar brgya la bstod/ /mched 'khor btsan rgod gtum drag gnod sbyin drug /gsang ba'i yum chen phyi nang blon po'i tshogs/ /'bag gseng bro shon mon bu a
༄༅/ /tsar+ya / / grangs med dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs la bstod/ /hūX/ rang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi 'di gnam lcags me 'bar gyis mjad/ gzhal yas na/ /gnod sbyin dmar po gtum brjid mthu bo che/ /sku mdog dmar po khrag ltar ya la la/ /khrag mdog mche ba dmar po gtsigs se gtsig /gnod sbyin gdug pa kun gyi stong dpon che/ /drag shul mthu ldan stobs chen rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rngams par rol/ /g.yas pa'i ba dan dgra bo'i snying la bsnun/ /g.yon pa'i zhags pas dgra po'i ske nas 'ching / /stag dog gzigs shubs btags shing bse phub khur/ /btsan rta dmar zhur zhon nas gling bzhir rgyu/ /dam nyams dgra po'i srog la rngams par rol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /byur dang ltas ngan thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /rtag tu 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen spel/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /hūX/ sngon tshe rgyal lha rnam rgyal grags pas mjad ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /las smon mthu las grub pa'i dam tshig can/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin rgyal po zhes grags pa'i/ /bka' sdod stobs ldan khyod la bdag bstod do/ /rab 'jigs bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /khro gnyer bzhin bsdus am gtsigs sdang mig bgrad/ /mdung dmar zhags pas ru dra 'ching zhing sgrol/ /dam nyams
gshed ma khyod la bdag bstod do/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma rje 'bangs spyan snga rtswa /ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam mi g.yel zhing / /dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur bar khang du/ /las smon gcig bsdus lha sras 'dus pa'i tshe bka' yi thugs dam gnyan po ji bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang rgyud par bcas pa yi/ /dam chos bsgrub la tshul bzhin skyong ba dang / /gtan gyi dgra lhar chos skyong khyod gsol na/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel/ /bar chad bgegs thul sdang ba'i dgra bo sod/ /chos 'khor gnyan skyong mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ngag brtsoms hūX/ sin+dha'i rgya mtshor 'dab ldan pad sdong rtser/ /snang ba mtha' yas ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin rang byung sprul pa'i sku/ /thod 'phreng rigs lnga'i sprin gyis shis pa stsol/ /kun khyab rgyal ba'i ye shes snying po'i khams/ /snang mdzad gangs chen ngo bor smin pa yi/ /rang snang 'od lnga'i zer 'phreng 'jig rten du/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon mched lnga'i rnam par shar/ /gcig pu'i rnam 'gyur du ma'i yo lang bzhin/ /rje 'bangs pho nya'i rol rtsed 'byams klas pas/ /srid gsum zil gnon 'dod dgu'i mchog ster ba'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po dbu 'phang bstod par bgyi/ /lha khyod kun rdzob thun mong gdul bya'i ngor/ /li yul dge slong yid dbang 'khrugs pa yi/ /
༄༅/ /log smon khrag gi sgo nga brdol ba las/ /gdug rtsub 'byung por smin pa'i tshul ston yang / /don dam chos sku'i dbyings las mi phyed phyir/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las rgya mtshor dbang 'byor mod/ /mthun 'jug dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal ngom pa'i slad/ /rgyal kun 'dus par slar yang mnga' gsol lo/ /zhi khro chags dang sgeg pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro zhing sdud mdzad pa'i/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo'i bla res phyogs kyi khyon/ /dog por mdzad pa'i snyan pas mnga' gsol lo/ /legs byas 'bras bu thams cad ngang gis 'grib/ /snyigs ma'i rang gzugs snod bcud 'byor pas phongs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal phung por spyod 'di'i dus skyabs gnas kun 'dus mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /stod smad kun gyi rgyal khrims sil bur zhig /dri med legs par bshad pa'i snying po nub/ /tshul 'di dgongs zhes thugs dam gnad nas bskul/ /chos srid khrims kyi bdag por mnga' gsol lo/ /bod skyong rje 'bangs dpal 'byor 'phrog pa yi/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung dbus su lhud bar phyogs/ /gdung ba'i snying rlung khong nas ldang byed na/ /dgra 'joms dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /sdom gsum bcas mtshams kun las rnam par 'das/ /log pa'i smon lam stobs kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /phung byed 'gong po'i gdug rtsub kyis gtses na/ /dam log srog gi
bshan par mngal gsol lo/ /rdo rje'i chos srung mtha' dag khyad du gsod/ /'byung pos rgyud dkrugs rgyal 'gong skyabs su bsten/ /snying nas re ba 'cha' ba 'di mthong tshe/ /gzhan sde rdul du rlog par mnga' gsol lo nyes med srong por spyod pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /sna tshogs g.yo sgyu'i thabs kyis klan ka 'tshol/ /kha smras mi kha gleng ba'i dgra 'dre'i tshogs/ /snying khrag thang la 'bo bar mnga' gsol lo/ /stod nas lcid kyis gnya' ba ri ltar gnon/ /'og nas skur 'debs zur gyis khyi ltar zug /thad nas bdo zhing gnod pa'i gdug can gyi/ /klad khrag zho ltar dkrug par mngal gsol lo/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i bya ba kun la 'tshe/ /byur dang god kha kun gyi phungs sna 'dren/ /srid la rku zhing rje 'bangs rgyud dkrug pa'i/ /rgyal 'gong 'joms pa'i dpa' bor mnga' gsol lo/ /than dang ltas ngan rmi ltas 'tshub 'gyur ston/ /tshe dang mdangs 'phrog phyogs rnams kun tu myul/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dam sri kun/ /bskrod pa'i ging chen rgya mtshor mngal gsol/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje 'jam mgon grub pa'i gtso/ /za hor sngags smyon chen po la sogs pa/ /dam pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa bdag sogs kyi/ /yab gcig dgra lha chen por mngal gsol lo/ /rtag tu 'jam rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las byams pa'i nu zhos skyong byed cing / /blang dang dor bya'i bgyi 'os slob pa
༄༅/ /yi / / drin can ma yi mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /brtse ba'i spyan dkyus ring por zur gyis gzigs/ /snying la 'bab pa'i dbugs dbyung lhug bar ston/ /gcugs shing dung ba'i 'ching ba mi lhod pa'i/ /mdza' ba'i sring mo mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /'jigs pa'i rgol ba mtha' dag ring du byed/ /bde ba'i gnas la ngal bso'i snang ba ster/ /mkho dgu'i re ba mtha' dag bskang mdzad pa'i/ /lha gcig rje bo'i mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /gang ltar bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med sgrub/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsrung zhing mel tshe byed/ /skyo ngal spangs te ci bgyir nyan pa yi/ /stobs ldan bran gyi thu bor mnga' gsol lo/ /rang snang yongs dag bde mchog pad+ma'i dbus/ /gsal stong bzhad pa'i rol mo 'dren byed pa'i/ /rol rtsed rdo rje'i gar mkhan 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /bsrung zhing skyong zhes mnga' gsol gzengs bstod do/ /snying nas re 'cha' gdung pa'i yid 'chang ba'i/ /yon sbyor slob ma mched lcam mi nor dang / /snod bcud kyis bsdus bdag 'byor ji snyed pa'i/ /gnyer kha gtad de mnga' gsol gzengs bstod do/ /dbang chen gsang bdag che mchog rig pa 'dzin/ /gsang ba ye shes bde skyong mkha' 'gro dang / tshangs pa'i rgyal po mchog gi g.yar dam bzhin/ /sgrubs zhes snying nas bskul te gzengs bstod do/ /mdor na deng nas rang snang mkha' spyod zhing / /rgya mtshor spyod min de
srid dus kun tu/ /'bral med 'grogs shing rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyis/ /skyong ba'i gzi byin phyogs bcur 'bar bar mdzod/ / hūX/ ngag rtsoms sngon tshe che mchog kun bzang he ru ka /bar du 'chi med grub pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha mar kun mkhyen za hor bzhad pa yis/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i ra bar rab tu bcug /khas blangs blo bor mna' chu lces myang ba'i/ /bstan srungs gnod sbyin bshan pa tsi dmar ba/ /'bangs 'khor dpung dang bcas pa'i dus la babs/ /mthu dpung bskyed la bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /dug lnga'i mdangs las t+pū rol lha srin 'khrugs/ /dam sris rgyud brlams skye po'i gdug rtsub g.yos/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshes rnam par gces pa'i dus thugs dam bcas pa'i tha tshig dran par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bder 'tshe/ /rnal 'byor chos kyi bar gcod mi mthun pa'i/ /dgra bgegs mthu dpung bsam sbyor ngan pa kun/ /zhi zhing dul bas byams dang ldan par mdzod/ /bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i rnam dkar yon tan tshogs/ /tshe dpal mnga' thang mkho dgu'i 'byor pa dang / /lhan cig 'dzad med 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /srid pa gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod dang / /lha mi klu dbang gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ /rang dbang gtan pa bral te 'gugs byed pa'i/ /dbang sdud 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /
༄༅/ /gnod cing 'tshe byed 'jam pos 'dul dka' ba/ /mtha' dag mngon par spyod pa drag po'i mthus/ /ming brda tsam yang grag par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul chen pos spa bkongs shog /khyad par smon lam log pas mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /rgyal 'gong dam sri sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'tshub/ /phyi nang nges med mi mthun phyogs kun las/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bsrung zhing skyob par mdzod/ /rtag tu mchod bstod gus pas lhur len pa'i/ /bdag sogs rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /ci bsam re ba gegs med mthar phyin cing / /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzod/ /bh+yoX gter byon nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na4༷༷btsan yul zangs thang dmar po na4༷༷ zangs brag gnam du zangs seng zang ltoX rtse la rgod smug lings se ling ltoX 'ordzogs la btsan skya sha ra raltoX rked na gcan gzan 'du ru 〈coX rtsa bar dug chu zu lu lugiX zangs brag dmar po'i nang shed na4༷༷ khrag mtsho 'khol ma me re regiX bse mkhar smug po ldems se ldemagiX zangs kyi sgo lcags khrigs se khrigagiX 'jigs pa'i btsan mkhar nang shed na4༷༷ klu btsan tshogs pa'i rol po nigiX sku mdog dmar ljang brjid pa la4༷༷ ral pa dmar po me 'od 'khrigs4༷༷ spyan nas me yi skar mda' 'khrugagiX zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'phebs4༷༷ sku la dar dmar bar chen gsol4༷༷ za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can4༷༷ dbu la dar dmar 'gyid
