༄tshi/ /gsol4༷༷ stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon4༷༷ chibs su smug po sha gdong bcibs4༷༷ phyag na bse mda' bse gzhu bsnams4༷༷ 'geng shing dgra bo'i snying la bsdigagiX gri 'thab cho 'phrul dgra la thong bh+yoXyang cig btsan gyi jag pa nigiX gro shod bod kyi sgang dmar rjegiX zangs brag dmar po'i mnga' bdag po4༷༷ sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'baraltoX sku la le brgan 'jol ber gsol4༷༷ chibs su mcha' lu rting dkar bcibs4༷༷g.yas na gsod pa'i shang lang thogs4༷༷ g.yon na zangs zhags dgra la 'debs4༷༷ gri 'thab cho 'phrul dgra la thong ltoX bh+yoX yang cig btsan gyi jag pa nigiX ra ba gong gi klu btsan nigiX sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa la sku la chu dar ral ga garber+shal4༷༷ gdug pa sbrul gyi ska rags bcings4༷༷ stag dong g.yas la gzigs shubs gaskurdzon4༷༷ chibs su ser po stag lag bcibs4༷༷ g.yas pa lcags mdung nag po bsnams4༷༷ gaskurdzon pa dug sbrul khrags pa thogs4༷༷ gri 'chab cho 'phrul dgra la thong ltoX bh+yoX yang cig btsan gyi jag pa nigiX rdo rengs dmar po'i grib btsan nigiX sku ni dmar po 'jigs pa la4༷༷ sku la be'u dmar slog pa gsol4༷༷ stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon4༷༷ g.yas na bse mdung dmar po bsnams4༷༷ g.yon na btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams4༷༷ chibs su rkyang dmar sbo dkar bcibs4༷༷ gri 'thab cho 'phrul dgra la thong ltoX bh+yo:༷༷ yang cig btsan gyi jag pa nigiX jaX ka thod nag
bdung btsan nigiX sku mdog ljang snyerdzon lhan tu 'jigs4༷༷ sku la dar nag ber chen gsol4༷༷ dbu la bdud dar nag po bcings4༷༷ chibs su rag pa gzhung nag bcibs4༷༷ g.yas na dar nag ru mtshon bsnams4༷༷ gaskurdzon na 'dreng zhags blo la 'debs4༷༷ gri 'thab cho 'phrul dgra la thong ltoX bh+yoX yang cig btsan gyi jag pa nigiX rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan nigiX sku ni khrag mdog dmar po la4༷༷ zangs khrab dmar po sku la gsol4༷༷ dbu la dar dmar 'gying thod bcings4༷༷ stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon4༷༷ bse phub dmar po me 'od ldan4༷༷ zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyugagiX dar dmar ru mtshon rlung ltar 'tshubaltoX btsan rta dmar zhur glog ltar khyugagiXri khyi spyang khri rol du khridagiX ri bya pho rog steng na lding ltoX gri rngams bla tshe steng nas 'dedagiX gri 'thab cho 'phrul dgra la thong ltoX btsan gyi jag pa skya bdun po4༷༷ nga rgyal khro gtum btsan gyi sdeltoX sdang ba'i dgra la btsan dmag drongs4༷༷ mtshon gri 'gags gri dgra la thong ltoX sdig gri chu gri dgra la thong ltoX sbos gri g.yang gri dgra la thong ltoX rbab gri thog gri ngag la thong ltoX lcebs gri drag po dgra la thong ltoX bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzodagiX bh+yoX khyi mo dung mdog mtshal mig ma/ /kha nas gza' yi dug rlung gtong / mi sha khrag gi dri tshor rgyug /tho rengs dgra bo'i dbugs len ma/ /dgra bo'i srog dbugs hub kyis 'debs/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mchan gyi gsung bzhin sngags 'go ra r+sā
༄/ /gyis mjad pa/ lha btsan dkar po'i rjes 'dred ma/ /rgyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra la smyo 'bog thong / /glog lcam 'bar ma'i dus la bab/ /bh+yoX khyi mo dmar mo mtshal mig ma/ /kha gdangs zangs kyi mche ba gcigs/ /kha nas nad kyi na bun 'tshub/ /dgra bo'i sngon bsu dbugs len ma/ /nyams pa'i klad khrag dron mo 'thung / /brag btsan dmar po'i rjes 'breng ma/ /rgyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra bo'i klad pa 'thung / /zangs spyangs dmar mo'i dus la bab/ /bh+yoX khyi mo dmar nag khrag mig ma/ /dug gi kha rlangs sprin ltar 'thibs/ /lcags kyi mche sder mtshon ltar gzings/ /nam phyed dgra po'i bla tshe brku/ /dam nyams bla tshe hub kyis 'debs/ /klu btsan dmar po'i rjes 'breng ma/ /rgyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /khrag gi sbyang mo da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod/ /khrag sbyang dmar po'i dus la bab/ /bh+yoX khyi mo dmar mo mthing mig ma/ /kha gdangs mche gtsigs khrag dron skyug /khrag gi dri tshor dpag tshad du/ /dgra bo'i rjes gcod dbugs len ma/ /snying khrag dron mo hub kyis 'debs/ /grib btsan dmar po'i rjes 'breng ma/ /rgyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /khrag 'dzag dmar mo da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra khrag dron mo 'thung / /dmar mo khrag 'dzag dus la bab/ /bh+yo:༷༷ khyi mo nag mo gzi mig ma/ /kha gdangs 'o dod phyogs bcur 'bod/ /nad kyi
skyal pa mgul du thogs/ /srod la dgra bo'i dbugs len ma/ /dam nyams dgra la rims nad thod/ /bdud btsan nag po'i rjes 'breng ma/ khyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /lcags spyang chen mo da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra la rims nad thong / /lcags spyang 'bar ma'i dus la bab/ /bh+yoX khyi mo dmar mo gzi mig ma/ /kha gdangs mche gtsigs khrag dri mnam/ /khrag gi ral pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /dgra bo'i gnya' bcog srog dbugs len / nyams pa'i snying khrag khul kyis 'debs/ /grib btsan dmar po'i rjes 'brang ma/ /rgyug cig rgyug cig da rgyug cig /'bar ma chen mo da rgyug cig /phyo phyo dgra bo'i snying la 'jus/ /dmar mo 'bar ma'i dus la bab cesagadung ba'i nga ro dang bcas phyo phyo nyi shu rtsa gcigabarjod cing / /thal mo gdab yo/ / kye/ sngags 'go nga ston gyis mjad phyogs phyogs dag kyang ma gi na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /g.ya' dang spang gi mtshams shed na/ /btsan yul ri thang phyed ma na zangs brag gnam du zangs se zang / /rtse la rgod smug lings se ling / /logs na sha rkyang sha ra ra/ /rtsa na dug chu zu lu lu/ /sku mkhar de yi nang she na/ /bse mkhar smug po ldems se ldem/ /gser gyi ba gam lams se lam/ /dung gi sgo mi khrigs se khrig /lcags kyi sgo lcags khro lo lo/ /mu men them skas sha ra ra/ /sku mkhar de yi nang shed na/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po bzhugs/ /mi gcig po la ming mang po/ /slob dpon
༄tsho/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bsam yas dbus su mtshan gsol ba/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po tsi'u dmar yin/ /bon po stag la me 'bar gyis/ /ra sa 'jigs su mtshan gsol ba/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po lags byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis/ /mnga' ris stong du mtshan gsol ba/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po yang le ber/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa la/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la bse rmog dmar po gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar dgra la 'debs/ /g.yon pa'i zhags pas dgra po 'ching / /gser sked rin chen sku la bcings/ /zhabs la sag lham khra bo gsol/ /mu men byu ru'i do shal can/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /chibs su gro bo g.yu sngon cibs/ /rta dmag 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /btsan khyi dmar po rol du khrid/ /bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yoX phyo phyo de ni dmag la phyo/ /dmag dpung bkye la ru mtshon phyor/ /btsan dmag dgra bo'i yul du drongs/ /sngar dgra dar ba rtsad nas chod/ /phyi dgra sems pa drung nas phyung / /sdang byed dgra bo dul du rlog /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /bdag la gnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dbang du bsdus la thal bar rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / dzaX ngag btsomadabang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /'jigs
gzugs bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /srog la rngams pa dregs pa'i rje/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i dus la bab/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung gsang ba'i bdag /dbang chen rgyal po he ru ka /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal sogs kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig dgongs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sgrub mchog skyong zhing bdud 'dul ba'i/ /thugs dam gnyan po bcas pa bzhin/ /las bzhi'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /rta mchog thugs kyi pho nya che/ /dam can 'bar ba spun bdun po/ /zag med bde chen ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /rtags chags dregs pa'i tshul bzung ste/ /gdug rtsub drag po'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /rnam 'gyur pha mtha' yas par ston/ /las rnams thogs med sgrub la dbang / /snang srid thams cad khyod gcig pu'i/ /zas skal longs spyod kho na ste/ /rdo rje'i ri mo spyi gtsug tu/ /bkod pa'i dam tshig ma g.yel zhig /dung chen snod gtams 'bru bcud kyis/ /'phyur por sbungs pa'i dam rdzas la/ /myos byed chang dang khrag gis sbags/ /sha rjen bza' bca'i tshogs kyis brgyan/ /srog yig gis mtshan dar dmar gyi/ /'phur lding g.yo ba'i mda' yis spras/ /sman raka rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /spyan gzigs dam rdzas bsam mi khyab/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te bstab/ /'phrin las gnyan po bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo yis/ /drag
༄༅/ /por bskul na mthu rtsal bskyed/ /grangs med dregs pa sde brgyad kyi/ /dpung tshogs rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /khro gtum rngams pa'i gad brgyangs kyis/ /log 'dren rtsa nas gcod par mdzod/ /log smon 'byung po'i gdub rtsub kyis/ /bskyed pa'i phyi nang nyer 'chi kun/ /dmigs med chos sku'i dbyings nyid du/ /zhi zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar du gcod pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /bzod par dka' ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /bsang bskrad dbye zhing rmongs par mdzod/ /srid gsum kun gsal me long gi /ngos su ri mor shar ba yi/ /snang cha'i ltad mo ji snyed pa/ /dmar zlum dpral ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /legs nyes shan thang gsal bar phye/ /tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin pa yis/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / /bdag sogs bu sdug bzhin du skyongs/ /gangs can bod kyi rgyal khab tu/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog pa dang / /nad yams sad ser than pa sogs/ /zhi bzlog bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed don sgrubs/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i chab srid skyongs/ /sngags 'chang yon mchod dgra lha mdzod/ /mi mthun phyogs kun cham la phob/ /yi dam lha yi las gzhung bsrangs/ /mchog gsum rgya mtsho dpang du btsugs/ /bsnyen sgrub zab mor gzhol ba yis/ /lha khyod drag tu skul byed na/ /mthu
rtsal ji tsam 'dug pa blta/ /bdag rber+shags tsam zhig lha nga ba yi/ /mthu rtsal nus pa ma mchis na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar bsrung / /rgyu 3)ra dam rdzas chud ma garber+shan/ /rnal 'phre( bdag gi snying ma rku/ /yal skurdzol le lo ma mdzad par/ /phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub par mdzod/ /drag shul rdo rje'i thog las che/ /glog ltar myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang / /bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /cesathugs dam bskul nas/ /bskang ba zhagasprel du byed na thun gtor zur du bshams pa dang / nyin chogarkyang par byed na mchod gtor dngosagazhir rak+ta sbran bden brjod sngon du 'gro bas dgugagazhuganan tan bgyisarjesasha khrag rusapa'i rang bzhin du byin gyisabarlabasate sngar bzhin gtor ma phul la 'phrinon las bcol/ /dpal 'bar bcugs te/ /rgyan bzang ma'am mchod g.yogagisazhwa lham gyon te gtor ma bteg sangs rgyas bstan dzo/nga ma btang / (1da garber+shal 69da bsten zhesapa'i tshigadang bstun te phyi 'grosasu dal busabateganas thogasteng du gshegs su gsol/ /shisabarjod sogs rjesakyi bya ba ni spyi ltar ro/ /de ltar dgra lha'i rgyal po gnod sbyin yang le ber sgya mchod 'phrinon 'dod dgu'i nyin byed cesabya ba 'diri ni rigapa 'dzin pa bzhuXd pūX'i rdoX rjeXsashiring pho stagagi lo khrums zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshesabazang por mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas thegamachogarnam grol :ring giri sgom khang du shar mar spel ba'o// //
༄༅/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i gsol kha rgyas pa mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i gter byon rtsa ba'i don rgya chen bkral ba dbang drag dus kyi pho nya bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /spros bral gzhi dbyings nāwang las snying rje'i nyams/ gsung gi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru kaX bzhengs dang rnam 'byed med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gtsug na 'bar/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis gter byon gnas rnamapa gnyis nas spyan drangs ba'i dmacan chen po gnodasbyin yang le ber gyi gsol mchodadus kyi pho nya bya bar 'dodapas rung mthun gyi gnas su/gtor mchodamathun rdzas spyan gzigs phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bcas pa'i rten bkram pa sogs rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bar ma ga pa dpe'u ris ltar bshams te sngags drug gis bzlas/ rang nyid gnyen po stobs kyi lha rta mchog he ru par gsal ba'i 4 nas/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun thad ngos cung zad dma' bar btsan yul zangs thang dmar po zangs brag gnam la snyeg pa/ rtse la 67da smug lding ba/'o1gas la btsan skya rgyu ba/ rked la gcan gzan ngur ba/ rtsa bar dug chu spusal ba/ brag ri dmar 27'i nang du khrag malham spusal zhing bse mkhar smug stu1 zangs kyi 〈sna lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su 〈cong ba'i
༄tshi/ /dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las/ lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi'u dmar ba sku mdog dmar ljang ral ba dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me yi skar mda' 'khrugs pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khro zhing 'jigs la rngams shing gtums pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol ba rin chen gser gyi ska rags bcings ba/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab tu 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pa dmar pos dgra bo 'ching zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyi ru mtshon can snying la bsnun pa/ rta bra bo sgab nag dar gdan dmar po/ sga khra bo dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob
chen / gser gyi srab/ g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs/ sbrul nag gi gong smed byas pa la chibs nas stong gsum bskor ba/ sku lha zhal gyi lha btsan sku mdog dkar ser khro gtum can/ sku la za 'og dmar khra'i gos dang / dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas su stag dong dang g.yon gzig shubs 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis bse mda' bse gzhu bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha gdong sga srab can la chibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rdze sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'bar ba rngams shing 'jigs pa sku la leb rgan gyi 'jol ber dang / dar dmar gyi thod bcings ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra bo bcings ste/ g.yas kyi shang lang brdeg pa/ mtshal lu rting dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ ra tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral ga la dug sbrul gyi sku rags bcings ba/ dar sngon gyi thod bcings ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang / g.yon sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can la chibs pa/ rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ ber dmar gyi slog pa dang / dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig
༄༅/ /shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang / g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ gang ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/ bdud dar nag po thod du bcings ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas 'bring zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la chibs pa/ rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan sku mdog khrag ltar dmar ba/ sku la zangs khrab dmar po dang / dbu la dar dmar gyi thod bcings ba/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du 'phyang ba/phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po me 'od 'phro ba gsor zhing / g.yon zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyug pa/ rta mchog rlung gi gshog pa sga srab can la chibs pa/ bdun ga'ang ri khyi spyang khri rol tu khrid pa/ ri bya pho rog steng du lding ba/ btsan dmag 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ ru 'dren sde bzhi'i pho nyar 'gyed pa/ sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs par gsal ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi smyi bor oX/ mgrin par āXthugs gar hūm̐X gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang sham bha la/ li yul lcang ra smug po/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po/ pe har dkor mdzod gling sogs rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas gnod sbyin
dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bya rgod sha la babs pa ltar spyan drangs bar gyur/ hūṃXltoX rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i gsung ltoX chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos4༷༷ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīXlas rngams pa'i skugiX rta mgrin rta skad bayid la phyag 'tshal bstodagiX kyaiX phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na4༷༷ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na4༷༷ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas4༷༷ pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pagiX che btsan rol ba skya bdun nigiX phal cher sku mdog dmar po la4༷༷ phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams4༷༷ sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas4༷༷ tshul byon tshur byon gnas 'dir byon4༷༷ shu la tri badz+ra sa ma ya dzaX go pa'i bar brjod rjes/ skyes bu'i g.yas kyi ru 'dren pagiX dpa' bo de ni stag chas brgya4༷༷ mda' sgra de ni sha ra raltoX gzhu sgra de ni sgrengs se sgreng ltoX kha nas bswo sgra di ri ri4༷༷ bswo sgra gnod pa'i bgegs la gziraltoX mda' sgra sdang ba'i dgra la rgyobaltoX g.yas kyi ru 'dren gshegs su gsol4༷༷ skyes bu'i g.yon gyi ru 'dren pagiX nyan thos de ni dgra bcom brgya4༷༷ phyag na gseg shang si li legiX zhal nas 'don pa sha ra raltoX ka li rgyab na khrigs se khrigagiX mdo 'don ngan sngags sha ra raltoXgseg shang sdang ba'i dgra la rgyobaltoX ngan sngags gnod pa'i bgegs la gziraltoX g.yon gyi ru 'dren gshegs su gsol4༷༷ skyes bu'i sngon gyi shul mtshon pagiX bud med de ni nag mo brgya4༷༷ dar nag g.yab mo lings se rlang ltoX
༄༅/ /kha nas dmod ngan sha ra raltoX dmod ngan sdang ba'i dgra la bshor/ g.yab mo gnod pa'i bgegs la rgyob/ sngon gyi shul mtshon gshegs su gsol/ skyes bu'i slad kyi rjes 'brang ba/ ban+de de ni sngags nag brgya/sngags nag phur pa hri li li/ rak+ta'i phreng ba na ra ra/ kha nas drag sngags sha ra ra/ drag sngags gnod pa'i bgegs la gzir/ phur nag gnod pa'i bgegs la rgyob/ slad kyi rjes 'brang gshegs su gsol/ skyes bu'i sku yi skyo bsangs ma/ na chung de ni mdzes ma brgya/ kha nas glu len gyu ru sa dngul dkar me long ta la la/ gser khri rgyu ma phyod de phyod/ gar 'bag sum brgya'i tshogs dang bcas/ cang te'u de ni khra la la/ gser gyi gdu bu si li li/ sku yi skyo grogs gshegs su gsol/ phyi blon nang blon gshegs su gsol/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ sa ma ya dzaX bh+yoX btsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na4༷༷ sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyabaltoX yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzes4༷༷ dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugs4༷༷ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan4༷༷ kyaiX skyes bu rol ba sde bdun nigiX phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyabaltoX pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pagiX dam tshig gnyer gtad khyod la bstodagiX gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul lo4༷༷ bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la4༷༷ thugs rje'i dbang gi nye bar mdzodagiX ar+ghaX bi shud+dhi swā hā:༷༷ gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs4༷༷ me tog snang
gsal dri chab dang ltoX zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul4༷༷ thugs rje'i dbang gi mnyes par mdzodagiX dhatre puspro a lo ke ghan+dhe nai waṃ du shap+ta puts+tsha ho:༷༷ kyaiX skyes bu srog gi bdag po nigiX 'jigs byed rol ba sde bdun tshogs4༷༷khyed la dgyes pa'i longs spyod nigiX sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs4༷༷ zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil4༷༷ rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing bur gtams4༷༷ spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkramagiX rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs4༷༷ glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcas4༷༷ dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskang ltoX btsan 'oshesar 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang ltoX sde brgyad sdong zla'i thugs dam bskang ltoX daskardzor srung dam can thugs dam bskang ltoX las byed pho nya'i thugs dam bskang ltoX bh+yoX bse mkhar dmar po ldems se ldemagiX dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ༄5༷༷ ba dan dmar po yangs se yang ltoX dregs pas mda' 'phen brengs se breng ltoX las byed shan pa rol lo loltoX bshugs pa'i 'bod sgra di ri ri4༷༷ che btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang ltoX slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ༄nyaX thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la4༷༷ khri srong lde'u btsan rje rigs dang ltoX sngags 'chang dam ldan brgyud par bcas4༷༷ dam tshig gcig tu skyong pa la4༷༷ sku la bsdo ba'i rigs brgyud chodagiX log lta'i sde dpung cham la phobaltoX sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma dbral4༷༷ bcol lo gnyer ro mthu rtsal bskyedagiX yal yol bri kol ma mdzad
༄tshi/ /cigagiX ngo srung zas phyir ma 'breng mdzodagiX thugs dang 'gal ba bskang gyur la4༷༷ bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongs4༷༷ zhes brjod/ de nas khyad par gyi skong ba ni/hrīX dbang drag pad+ma'i bka' sdod dregs pa'i rjegiX myur mgyogs shugs ldan rol ba skya bdun tshogs4༷༷ thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas nigiX gser skyems g.yu skyems phud rgod mtsho ltar bskyil4༷༷ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying khrag rgyun4༷༷ myos ldan chang gis bran pa'i btung ba dang ltoX dbang lnga'i me tog sha gsur dud sprin 'thul4༷༷ dgra tshil drod mor gzhus pa'i snang byed bkragaX mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas brjidagiX sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag 'byams klas shing ltoX myos byed khrag mtsho sbrus pa'i brtsodas bu chegiX btsan mkhar 'bar ba'i dbyibs can mkha' la snyogs4༷༷ gro dmar bhe ta'i sha khrag snying gis brgyan4༷༷ pho brang dog por byed pa'i mchod rdzas dang ltoX nam mkha'i gza' skar la yang co 'dra'i lta'igiXsha ru zangs yag mtshal gyis byugs pa'i dbyibs4༷༷ srin phyogs mkhar gyi rtse ltar bsgrengs ba sogs4༷༷ dam can sprin ltar 'du ba phyi yi rten4༷༷ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis4༷༷ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang ltoX btsan rgod rol ba skya bdun thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i thugs dam bskang ltoX bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang ltoX sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam
bskang ltoX las mkhan khyi spyang 'bag seng thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs dam bskang la las bzhi'i dngos grub stsolaltoX mtshan sprin zhun ma'i mdangs kyi dar zab la4༷༷ ha ri btsan dan dri yis chus bskus te4༷༷ skyes dar gri ru bkum pa'i snying khrag gis4༷༷ bla rten srog gi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcos4༷༷ pha wang long bu tri yig snying po can4༷༷ sba lcags tshigs pa bdun nam gsum pa'i nang ltoX bltams pa dar sna'i cod pan 'phur lding can4༷༷ ting 'dzin rdo rje gar gyis byin rlabs te4༷༷ lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral bcings ba sogs4༷༷ dam can khyi ltar 'brang ba nang gi rten4༷༷ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis4༷༷ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang ltoXbtsan rgod rol ba skya bdun thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i thugs dam bskang ltoX bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang ltoX sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang ltoX las mkhan khyi spyang 'bag seng thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs dam bskang la las bzhi'i dngos grub stsolaltoX rnal 'byor gar bzhugs rdo rje'i pho brang chegiX de yi nub phyogs tha gru yangs ba'i gzhiraltoX khyod kyi yid gzugs chags pa'i rten mkhar sa4༷༷ gshin rjer phyogs pa'i klu yi mig chus sbrus4༷༷ rin chen lnga dang sman spos phabs kyis bran4༷༷ brdzis shing 'thams pa'i sku mkhar dmar po'i srogagiX drag po'i shing la brten pa'i rtse mo rtsaX ru mtshon dmar po
༄༅/ /'jigs rung g.yo ba'i nyams4༷༷ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i srog gi tsakra'i bcudagiX nam mkha' chags dang sa gzhi ral ba'i dumagiX lha 'dre'i bla rdo gru bzhi tri yig can4༷༷ dar snas gril ba mkhar gyi snying por byas4༷༷ ting 'dzin rdo rje'i gar gyis byin rlabs pas4༷༷ dam can 'phru ltar chags pa gsang ba'i rten4༷༷ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis4༷༷ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang ltoX btsan rgod rol ba skya bdun thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i thugs dam bskang ltoX bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang ltoX sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang ltoX las mkhan khyi spyang 'bag seng thugs dam bskang ltoXthugs dam bskang la las bzhi'i dngos grub stsolaltoX shin tu gsang ba dgra bo'i srog gi gshedagiX mdung zhags dmar po g.yul las rnam rgyal rten4༷༷ se ba'i gnam ru skyer ba'i nyag phran mda'agreX dug khrag ngar ma'i sbags pa'i mthun rdzas dang ltoX mda' mo stong dmar bya rgod sgro ldan la4༷༷ gro dmar g.yang mo lug gi sug brang gdags4༷༷ leb rgan dar gyi cod pan pu ru rlabaX za 'og dmar khra'i khug mar gser g.yu dang / rin chen 'bru sman rgya spos yungs dkar blugs4༷༷ stag gzig ras ma'i 'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba dang ltoX mi rta gri ru shi ba'i snying khrag gis4༷༷ 'bod rbad bsad pa'i ling ga gta' ru gzugs4༷༷ nyi ma dmar thag chod pa'i dus gnyan la4༷༷ jag pa rta
rgyug rbad pa'i mthun rdzas rnams4༷༷ drag po'i phrin las dus la babs pa'i tshegiX ngan sngags cog brdungs nag po'i rten du 'dzugs4༷༷ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis4༷༷ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang ltoX btsan rbesnad rol ba skya bdun thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs kyi dgyes sde btsun mo'i thugs dam bskang ltoX bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang ltoX sprul 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang ltoX las mkhan khyi spyang 'bag seng thugs dam bskang ltoX thugs dam bskang la las bzhi'i dngos grub stsolaltoX de nas mnga' gsol ni/hrīX gzhi grol ka dag dri med sin+dha'i mtshor/ lhun grub 'dab stong bkra ba'i chu skyes sbubs/ sku lnga ye shes dgyes pa'i rnam rol can/ thod phreng rigs lnga'i brjod don lci bar mdzod/ ma bcos 'od gsal rig stong gnyug ma'i gshis/ lta sgom bya rtsol zhig pa gdod ma'i ngang / phan gnod lha 'dre'i kun rtog rnam dag kyang / rol rtsal thugs rje'i rnam rol cir yang ston/ snang char 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel shar ba las/ 'khor 'das bar lag bral ba srid pa'i mtshor/ dmu btsan gnyis med bshos pa'i sgong nga las/ gnod sbyin rgyal po tsi'u dmar po byung / chags sdang gdug sems che ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ rang gi lus las gdug pa'i btsan drug byung / kun kyang gri thang dmar por gnas bcas nas/ srid gsum phung bar byed pa'i gshed du che/ de tshe
༄༅/ /dbang drag gdod ma'i he ru gas/ rang snang rig pa don gyi 'og min du/ chags sdang rang gar shor ba'i btsan rgod bdun/ dam la btag te bstan pa'i bsrung mar bskos/ dang po 'dul khrims bsrungs ba'i dge slong che/ bar du smon lam stobs kyis gdug pa can/ tha ma srid gsum phung ba srog gi gshed/ da lta bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ khyod ni sngon gyi las dang bag chags mthus/ rgyal rigs bstan bshig yongs kyi bdud du che/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon skyabs dgra lhar che/ de phyir dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod par bgyi/ rtogs na gdod ma'i mgon dang ro gcig kyang / ma rtogs snang ngor rang rgyud dregs pa'i chul/ nga bdag gzung 'dzin bral ba'i dbyings chen por/ las rlung rnam rtog 'joms par mnga' gsol lo/ rmad byung lung rtogs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthus/ thar med srid mtshor dub pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ rnam mkhyen rin chen gling du khrid nus pa'i/ ded dpon thams cad mkhyen par mnga' gsol lo/ kun brtags snang ba'i grong khyer chen po'i gzhir/ dag pa ye shes rtsal gyis dbang bsgyur nas/ gdod ma'i rgyal thabs sbyin pa'i cho ga mkhan/rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'bor lor mnga' gsol lo/ 'bad rtsol rgyu 'bras chos la ltos min par/ ma bcos lhug par bzhag pa'i thugs rje'i rgyun/ dgos 'dod char du 'bebs pa'i dpal yon can/ yid bzhin nor bu
mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ stong nyid lang tsho bdo ba'i bzhin bzang ma/ mthong bas srid pa'i rnam rtog 'joms nus shing / bde stong ye shes ster ba'i mdza' na mo/ nyams rtogs sbar ba'i btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/shes byar srid tshad mkhyen pa'i blo gros kyis/ gzhung lugs nye mkhon med par skyong mkhas shing / phyi nang grub mtha' 'byed pa'i nor nyams can/ shes rab gsum gyi blon por mnga' gsol lo/ nyal tshe sde snod bslab pas shin tu dul/ ldangs tshe rgyud sde rgya mtsho theg pa che/ 'khor ba'i g.yul ngor phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i glang bor mnga' gsol lo/ rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i brtags pa'i lang tshos mdzes/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'i bang 'gros mgyogs/ sa bcu cig char bgrod pa'i rlung gshog can/ rta mchog rin chen mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ rtag chad phyogs su ma lhung mngon sum gnad/ 'od gsal rdzogs chen bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ sna tshogs g.yo rgyu'i rgol ba'i log rtog bdud/ 'joms pa'i dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi mthu chen pos/ kha na ma thor g.yeng ba'i rgyal phran rnams/ rang dbang brtan pa 'phrog ste spa bkong ba'i/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por mnga' gsol lo/ snyigs ma'i rang stobs bdo ba'i mun gling du/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi khur bos nyam thag tshe/ bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar
༄tshi/ /ba'i khri gdugs can/ mgron du 'bod pa'i pho nyar mnga' gsol lo/ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul mes dpon rnam gsum gyi/ chos srid khrims kyi nyi ma chu lhar phyogs/ snod bcud kun gyi bkrag mdangs nyams pa'i tshe/ mang pos bkur ba'i rje bor mnga' gsol lo/ srid pa'i phun tshogs dri za'i grong khyer la/ bden zhen a 'thas chags sdang rmongs ba'i mdas/ dge bcu'i snying ga 'bugs pa'i sems can gyi/ snang ba dge la bsgyur bar mnga' gsol lo/ stobs 'byor dregs pa'i ma dā nas myos te/ bag yod dran pa nyams pa'i sde dpon rnams/ ngan song sdug bsngal dran de spa bkong ba'i/ dge bcu'i khrims kyi bdag por mnga' gsol lo/tha snyad rtog pa'i drwa bar gnas bcas te/ rtag chad grub mtha'i rgyang glu len bzhin du/ rnam dag rgyud lung man ngag khyad gsod pa'i/ 'gong bo'i klad khrag 'gems par mnga' gsol lo/ 'dod lha bshad sgrub bstan pa'i dgrar mchis nas/ phyogs cha'i sde ris 'byed dang chab gcig par/ bstan sel sde 'khrugs slong ba'i rnga bong mgo/ skrod pa'i ging chen sde bzhir mnga' gsol lo/ che dgu du ma'i snying la gnas bcas nas/ mdzad spyod log par bsgyur dang chab gcig par/ nad mtshon mu go'i sna 'dren byed pa yi/ rgyal 'gong 'joms pa'i gshed por mnga' gsol lo/ rnam dag smon pa'i ri mor bris min par/ log spyod bsod nams dpung ba'i she

rung chogapas 'khu ldogashin tu che bas miri bya'o/ /de nas phrin yol bya ba ni/ hūṃX hrīX sngon tshe kun bzang rta mchog he ru gas/ /'og min cho 'phrul bstan pa'i zhing khams su/ /dam la btags shing bka' yi rtsis rgyar bzhag /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i gnyer du bskos/ 1 /bar du dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas/ /btsan brag dmar po srin mo langs 'dra rtswa /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i phyag rgyar bzhugs pa las/ 2 /nam gung mun pa'i smag la babs pa'i tshe/ /spyang gi khrag gi ral can bdun brdzus nas/ /ngu zhing bar gcod drag po'i glags bltas tshe/ /bka' rtags phyag rgyas zil 'og bcug min nam/ 3 /tha mar mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen la/ /dbu tshal shar sgor dngos su gzugs bstan nas/ /rang rtags srog snying phul zhing bros bor te/ /bstan dang der 'dzin skyong bar ma chad dam/ 4 /sngon dus khri srong lde'u btsan dgra lha che/ /da lta chos 'khor skyong ba'i mnga' bdag po/ /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug na brjid/ /che btsan 'gran zla bral ba khyed las su/ 5 /bdag ni rig 'dzin pad+ma'i brgyud pa 'dzin/ /bdud 'dul dbang chen grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang / /do nub mgu ba'i zas shog khyod la 'dren/ /bcol ba'i tha tshig gnyan po gnyer du longs/ 6 /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po lung rtogs chos/ /bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pa'i lang tsho can/ /dkon
༄༅/ /mchog rin chen gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad phrin spel/ 7 /sde snod rgya mtsho'i grong la gnas bcas shing / /sbyangs ba'i yon tan bcu gnyis khyad nor can/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bslab pas rgyud dul ba'i/ /dge 'dun sde tshogs gang na 'dug pa skyongs/ 8 /gnas lnga shes bya srid pa'i chos so cog /thugs kyi dpal ber 'khyil dang chabs gcig par/ /snang ba sgyu mar rtogs pa'i mkhas grub rnams/ /mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i pha mthar brdol/ 9 /tha snyad shes bya'i gos kyi bklubs min yang / /zab don bskyed rdzogs lang tsho gsar ba'i gzi/ /ri sul dben par ngom pa'i grub thob rnams/ /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i them skas tshugs/ 10 /gzhan don rlabs chen spyod pa'i mthu chung yang / /rang don chos bzhin spyod pa'i ku su lu/ /nyam chung gyi nas 'tsho ba'i chos ldan rnams/ /'tsho skyong yon gyi bdag po khyod kyi gyis/ 11 /bskal bar las nyon sa bon btab pa'i mthus/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'bras bur smin pa'i ro/ /myong ba'i sems can gaṅgā'i rdul rnyed grangs/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod pa'i sgo 'phar phyes/ 12 /khyad par rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /sems bskyed smon pa'i rang gzugs smin pa las/ /gzhan phan phar phyin drug gi lam po cher/ /'jug pa'i phrin las gsar ba'i rgyal rnga rdungs/ 13 /don rgyud 'pho
ba thob pa'i rten 'brel gshis/ brgyud 'dzin bu slob yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i ri sul gang nas kyang / /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam srol tshugs/ 14 /snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis pho rgyud rang dbang med par brtan pa 'phrogs/ /sde dpon dregs pa'i rngam sems zil gyis gnon/ /ban btsun wo mo'i snang blo g.yeng du chug 15 /rtsa rlung las su rung ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ /mo rgyud bde skyong 'khor lo'i rtsa 'bor dkrugs/ /mjangs dang g.yo rgyu'i rdzun phug rang sar rdib/ /'brel tshad dge la sbyor ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs/ 16 bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i bden mthu yis/ shugs sgrol dmod pa'i las la ma ltos par/ /do bsdo phod du 'dzugs pa'i dgra bo rnams/ gri 'thab dmar bshal drag pos dus mtha' stungs/ 17 /sku gsung thugs rten mchod cha man chad nas/ /brgyud 'dzin bu slordzob yon bdag yan chad du/ /dgongs pa'i rgyud la 'byor ba'i brtan g.yo kun/ /khyed la gnyer du gtad do mel tshe gyis/ 18 /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs mgron du khug /rtsod dang don gnyer kun las rgyal kha longs/ /snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor sgrengs/ /grags pa'i mu khyud gling bzhi'i mtha' la bskor/ 29 /mdor na bsam pa'i don dang gnyer ba'i las/ /the tshom rnam nur med par khyed kyis sgrubs/ /gzhi byes lam gsum kun tu sdong grogs mdzod/ /
da༅༅/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod/ 20 /dung dung snying nas mi brjed garber+shal 'debs shing / /yang yang mchod kyang bstod na bdag rbedugs kun/ /'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal hāskong / / 9〈〈ma 'dzosam dgyes pa'i lhag nas dalnga(sa khru/ba ༄6ro// 21 zhes brjod cing mchod gtor gcang sar gshegs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/bemapa'i rang bzhin rdos bos sgyu ma'i lus//rin wo srog gi zung dang bral ba'i gshis//bsam tshe dkon mchag rin wo rnamagasumalas//dregs pa'i skyabs gnas namtsho'i pad+mor mtshungs//de lta na yang 'khor ba mtha' medakyi/ /bag chags chang ching stug pa'i nags klung nas//phun tshogs spu grir gas pa'i sder gas tshogs//nga ro'i sgra dang stobs dpung srid par 'tshol//kyai ho 'di ni de lta malags te/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang der 'dzin skyong ba dang / /ris medagadul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad/ /yin phyir lhag bsam dkar pa'i cho rigs bcun/ /des mthong gdams pa rku ba'i gya tshomapa'i/ /moyin brgyud ldan bla mas drag sngags srog /sbyin tshe yidagazugs bstan cing dus gsumagyi/ /lkog gyur ri mor bris la rang gnas byas/ /zhes pa'ang pur rgyal bodakyi mnga' ris su srid pa'i myu gu phud bsring ba'i rnal 'byor pa pad+ma dbang ོ gyis chu khas bā la ge bsgrang bya gsar du tshes pa'i g.yin yodamachodapa'i dus skyon gyi thun mchams su rta mchog rol ba'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/dge'o/bkra shis par gyur cig/
༄7/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po las brtsams te lha'i zla bas dris pa'i lan gsang ba'i gter mdzod ces bya ba mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /rang rig rang gsal rang shes kun tu bzang / /gdod ma'i mgon po de la bdag nyid dad/ /sna tshogs rtog pa'i dra bas dkris pa yi/ /mkhas 'dod mkhas pa dag gis dris pa'i don/ /sum cu rtsa lnga tshig dang rgyan dang bcas/ /a ti yo ga'i don las legs brtsams pa'i/ /'byams yig gsang ba sgrog pa'i lde mig dag /mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i mngon du 'byor ba la brten nas/ /don med rnam g.yeng gzigs pa'i khur khyer zhing / /don gsum gsang ba gnad kyi gtam 'di bris/ /ka dag khro mo dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma g.yel thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod la/ /gsang ba zab mo sngags kyi gsang sgo rnams/ /yod dang gzhan gyis 'chal bar gyur pa gang / /brtse ldan thugs rjes ngang du bzod par gsol/ /de yang dri ba dang rtsod pa la brten
༄tsho/ /nas bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ring du spangs par dam bcas pa smos pa dang gcig /de dag gi sngon du mkhas grub kyi brgyud pa la brten nas bshad sgrub kyi lag len tshul bzhin du nod de brdar sha bcad pa'i tshul dang gnyis/ khyad par gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos thams cad gsang ba bcu'i rgyas gdab pa las mi 'da' zhing 'bag sbog gi las spangs te skal ldan gyi slob ma la snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i tshul gyis gdams shong / dpe brgyud rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyas btab cing yang mdzod gsang pa'i gter du yang nas yang du sba bar gsungs ba'i don tshul bzhin du khong du chud par byas shong / zhar la dri ba pos lan lkog yig tu bsdebs tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su yang / /rig drug 'khor ba'i bag chags rgyun bcas pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di kun gcig nas gcig brgyud de/ /
pha mar ma gyur sems can 'ga' yang med/ 1 /de nyid mdo rgyud lung dang man ngag gi /lung dang rigs pa zhib mos rnams brtags pas/ /ma nor don gyi bde ba dang bral bar/ /yang yang mthong thos dran pas yid gdung zhing / 2 /mtho ris tsam gyi bde ba la brten yang / /skad cig rer yang rtag pa'i skabs med cing / /zag bcas bde la spyod cing mthar thug gi /bde ba 'joms pa'i me chen nyid du mthong / 3 /de phyir rgyal bas gsungs shing 'phags yul gyi/ /grub brnyes rnams dang mkhas pa'i rjes zhugs nas/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba don med sdug bsngal du/ /shes nas tshul gnas thos bsam sgom sems bskyed/ 4 /de rgyun chu dang sa yi ri mo ltar / / yal bar mi bgyid dam bca' mthar 'don phyir/ /gang dben gnas su sdom gsum nyams med pa'i/ /lag len 'di la skad cig g.yel snyam med/ 5 /lus can dag gi dge dang mi dge'i las/ /lus ngag sems kyis byas pa gang yin pa'i/ /'bras bu gang yin bskal brgyar son yang ni/ /bslu med yin par thub pa'i gsung las shes/6 /de phyir rnam g.yeng tshe 'di'i che thabs dang / /snyan dang grags dang bstod bkur la sogs pa/ /rmi lam dus kyi longs spyod bzhin rtogs nas/ /khyad du gsod pa kho bo'i g.yar dam yin/ 7 /de bzhin khrims ni kun gyi rten yin te/ /'jig rten 'di na tshul bzhin nyes byas kyis/ /gos pa med pa nyin
༄tsho/ /mo'i skar ma ltar/ /mthong bas bdag nyid gcig pur dben la dga'/ 8 /phyogs brgyar dri dang rtsod dang brtsams pa dang / /lan 'debs bgyid la blo gros mi dman yang / /rtsod pa'i dus su las dang nyon mongs kyi/ /bud shing cher gyur las rgyun ngan pa'i gnas/ 9 /de phyir bdag gis tshe 'di'i che thabs dang / /snyan grags rnam g.yeng bar chad bdud kyi las/ /ring du por nas lkugs pa'i ngag bzhin du/ /dam bcar gnas nas zla gcig song ba lags/ 10 /ri gzar rbab dang chu bo'i rgyun bzhin dang / /myur 'gro'i 'bor lo lta bu'i tshe srog 'di/ /skad cig res kyang 'chi bdag drung du bsnyeg /de phyir bdag ni rnam g.yeng long ma mchis 11 /chos kyi don po rang rgyud ma thul na/ /thos mang mnyan dang zab mo'i gter lon dang / /yi dam lha yi gzugs mthong gsung thos yang / /bslu med byang chub nyid du 'gyur bar dka'/ 12 /de lta bas na dal 'byor ldan pa kun/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba kun spangs nas/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i thabs brten mdo rgyud kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod na mi 'thad dam/ 13 /le'u dang po/ bdag ni sngon gyi las kyi 'bras bu zhig dus 'dir smin dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /thugs rje 'dzoms pas dal 'byor lus rten thob/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs can tsam la yang / 14 /dad pa dang ni mos pa skye ba dang / /dam chos glegs bam rgyal
ba'i sku gzugs la/ /snying nas dad pas che mgro'i sa spangs te/ /gtsang nas gtsang ma'i lugs la brten pa lags/ 15 /tshul khrims spangs pa'i thos pa rgya mtsho yang / /dug chus sbag pa'i dngos por gyur pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas gsung la dad pa'i mos thob nas/ /nyes byas phra mo tsam yang spangs pa lags/ 16 /thos pa med na mngon sum rjes dpag dang/ /la zla shan dbye spyi dang bye brag gi /blang dor gnas la rmongs par gyur mthong nas sgra tshad gso sman tha snyad rnams la'ang nyan/ 17 /phyi rol pa dang ston pa'i bstan pa yi/ /rnams dbye ma nor dkon mchog gsum bsten zhing / /bka' rtags phyag rgya bzhi yi sgor zhugs nas/ /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya tshul bzhin bslab pa lags/ 18 /ston pa'i rtags 'chang ngur smig 'dzin pa'i khur/ /chud par ma gyur khyim gyi nyes mthong nas/ /dgra bcom dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad la/ /spyi bos bsten nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa lags/ 19 /gos tsam gyon pa'i rab byung dge slong dang / /chung ma'i tshogs bsten chos gos 'chang la sogs/ /bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyes dang sdig mthong nas/ /'dul ba'i lung ltar bslab pa mnyan pa lags 20 /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ /byang chub sems zhes thub pa'i lung las gsungs/ /de phyir mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don ched du/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems kyang blangs pa lags/ 21 /
༄༅/ /blangs pa'i bslab bya blangs dor ma shes na/ /bdud rtsi'i chu dang ko mo'i chu bzhin du/ /nor bar shes nas byang chub spyod pa'i sa/ /mdo sde'i tshogs la nyan bsam byas pa lags/ 22 /rgyal ba'i bka' ni dgongs dang ji bzhin pa/ /so so'i skye bos nus dang bya min phyir/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i bstan bcos la/ /nan chags kyis ni yang yang mnyan zhing bltas/ 23 /mkhas pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi thig pa'i rgyun/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud man ngag zab me'i chos/ /len zhing zhib mor gtan la phab pa rnams/ /sla chos spangs pas nyams myong sgom pa lags/ 24 /mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas mal rtsub mo nas/ /bde 'dod thar ba'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i gtan la gnas bya'i phyir/ /myur lam rdo rje theg pa bzung ba lags/ 25 /rtsod dus zol zog khram pa bslu brid mkhan/ /skye 'gro'i gshed ma rdzun gyi ston pa ste/ /mi tshangs spyod kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku yi/ /bdud kyi slob dpon brtags shing spangs pa lags/ 26 /bde gshegs bka' babs mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /man ngag gnyer 'chang gsang bcu'i thabs la mkhas/ /lta spyod dbang dam sgom sgrub ting 'dzin gsal/ /sangs rgyas dang mtshungs bla ma brgya rtsa bsnyen/ 27 /lus dang longs spyod bsgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / /bka' stsal gnyer blangs dam tshig srog bzhin bsrungs/ /thun drug
bskyed rdzogs rgyun gyi rnam 'byor byas/ /rgyud sde bzhi la nang byan chud pa lags/ 28 /kha cig rang lugs phra mo'i yid tshim nas/ /gzhan lugs ma mthong gshe dang sgro skur 'debs/ /nyes spyod chen po de dag ring dor nas gsar rnying bka' gter rgyud 'grel bsten pa lags/ 29 /khyad par yang gsang bla med snying po'i chos/ /pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud dang ni/ /ma hā a nu a ti la sogs pa/ /zab mo'i bskyed rdzogs thams cad mnyan pa lags/ 30 /kun kyi bcud bsdus rdzogs pa chen po la/ /sems sde ma bu bco brgyad dbang khrid dang / /rgyud dang sems 'grel snyan rgyud sbugs mchur bcas/ /chos sde sum brgya'i tshogs la mnyan sgom byas/ 31 /klong dgu bam po nyis khri'i don dril ba/ /bcu gsum rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnam dgu dang / /theg chen rnal 'byor a ro skor gsum dang / snyan rgyud thugs snying sogs la'ang mnyan sgom byas/ 32 /ye shes gsang ba rdzogs pa'i dbang rgyud dang / /gsal byed 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs/ /rgya gar mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /gzhung 'grel sa bcad kun la'ang sbyangs pa lags/ 33 /gdams gtad so gnyis snyan rgyud skor gsum dang / /rdo rje zam pa'i dbang rgyud khrid rnams dang / /lkog yig dmar byang sdeb skor la sogs pa/ /klong sde'i chos ni dkar nag khra gsum sbyangs/ 34 /bcu bdun rgyud sogs zab
༄tsho/ /mo'i rgyud bdun dang / /bu rgyud nyer gcig brgya dang bcu dgu'i chos/ /snying thig gsang skor ma bu cha lag dang / /yongs rdzogs skor la zab khrid lag len byas/ 35 /klong chen rab 'byams mdzod bdun gsang snying dang / /thor bu'i khrid dang yang tig rnam gsum dang / /kha 'thor bstod tshogs mnyan zhing bshad pa dang / /bka' brgyud yi ge'i tshogs kyang mang du bris/ 36 /a ti'i rgyud dang spyi ti nyer lnga dang / /yang tig mnyam sbyor spros bral don gsal dang / /klong yangs pha ma hūm̐X skor la sogs pa/ /zab mo'i dbang rgyud man ngag mnyan sgom bris/ 37 /btang drug rgyud drug rdor sems snying tig dang / /sku gsum bstan pa'i rgyud sogs snying tig gi /chos sde kun la mnyan bsam bsgom pa dang / /rat+na'i klong gsal skor la'ang legs par sbyangs/ 38 /kun bzang dgongs 'dus dgongs 'dus khrid chen bzhi/ /thor bu'i khrid ni bcu gcig ka dag dang / /zang thal rgyud drug snyan rgyud drug la sogs/ /ming tsam brjod dka'i gdams pa mang du mnyan/ 39 /chig chod kun grol pad+ma snying thig dang / /snying thig bcu gsum klong gsal lugs bzhi dang / /ye shes 'od mchog srong btsan bka' 'bum dang / /'gro 'dul yang 'dus ngan song kun skyobs dang / 40 /rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor lo gsum pa dang / /bla ma dmar khrid bla ma gsang 'dus dang / /bka' brgyad lugs srol chen
po rnams pa dgu/ /de dag rnams kyi rdzogs rim skor rnams thob/ 41 /lung chen a nu yo ga'i rgyud sde dang / /de yi gzhung 'grel rgya bod mkhas pa'i lugs/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyud sde bcu gnyis dang / /rnam 'grel lnga dang man ngag brgya tsam thob/ 42 /de sogs bka' rgyud bshad sgrub ma chad cing / /khungs ma'i gter chos drug cu rtsa bdun mnyan/ /kun gyi dpe bris bskyed rdzogs nyams len byas/ /gsang sngags khrom bshad khrag mtsho byar mi khom/ 43 /da lta'i dus kyi sngags pa ras chod can/ /chang nag gnyid dbang tho co rnyed grags 'dod/ /gsang sngags khrom glur len par nga mi dga'/ /de phyir gsang sngags min yang gsang sngags yin/ 44 /gsang bcu gnyer gtad gsang bar 'os pa kun/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub pa mi byed par/ /zang zing longs spyod 'khor tshogs sgrub pa yi/ /sngags pa'i snying ni bdud kyis zin ta re/ 45 /le'u gnyis pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mtshan gyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /rdorje gsang ba'i rgya yis gtab/ 46 /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnas rnams su/ /gsang gsum rdo rje theg pa'i bka'/ /gsang ba'i rgya btab mkha' 'gror gtad/ 47 /de bzhin lha klu mi yul gyi/ /rig 'dzin grub pa thob rnams kyi/ /zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i chos/ /gcig nas gcig
༄tsho/ /brgyud gsang zhing gdams/ 48 /rgya gar mkhas pa nyi shu gcig /dga' rab rdo rje hūm̐X kā ra/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa/ /dngos grub brnyes rnams gsang mod na/ 49 /da lta'i sdig can gsang sngags la / / brten nas rdo rje dmyal ba dag /bsgrub la brtson pa gang dag kun/ /bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par nges/ 50 /ci phyir sngon gyi mkhas rnams kyis/ /gsang sngags zong du ma mdzad pas/ /gsang sngags mkhyen pa min nam ci/ /zong du 'tshong ba ma mkhyen mang / 51 /kye ma pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /dus gsum gzigs nas snyigs ma yi/ /sems can don du zab mo'i chos/ /gter du sbas pa thams cad mkhyen/ 52 /gdams ngag re re'i mtha' rten yang / /gab rgya gsang rgya sbas rgya dang / /gces rgya gnyan rgya la sogs par/ /'di dag don med byas gyur te/ 53 /rje btsun de yi bka' lung las/ /seng ge'i khog pa rang 'jig ltar/ /nga min nga 'drar brdzus pa yis/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig par byed/ 54 /zhes gsungs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes kyang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /phyi gsang bzhi dang bar gsang bzhi/ /gsang 'os gnyer gtad bcu ru gsungs / 55 /de bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' las kyang / /gsang bar gdams dang ma gsang pa'i/ /nyes dmigs rdo rjes dmyal ba rtswa /mda' 'phang bzhin du ltung gi gsungs/ 56 /de dag ming du mi brjod de/ /snyigs
ma'i sems can las la spyod/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /bsam na khong khrag skyug par mchi/ 57 /de yang lung la yid ches phyir/ /rgyud sde re re'i dam tshig gi /gnas skabs dag la blta bar mdzod/ /des ni skyon bral yon tan thob/ 58 /ngas ni rnam pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di'i khe grags longs spyod la/ /cung zad tsam yang ma bsam kyi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen mdzod/ 59 /yul dus kun tu mi nyams shing / /phyogs dus kun du gnas bya'i phyir/ /thos bsam sgom dang dri ba dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom zhing rgya yis btab/ 60 /'bags 'bog las kyi nyes mthong nas/ /dam med dam las 'das pa'i sar/ /gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad pa/ /phra mo tsam yang ma bsgrags so/ 61 /dpe rgyud bris shing zhu dag byas/ /bla khebs na bza' glegs thag gis/ /bsdams shing rdo rje'i rgyas btab nas/ /kha yan nam du'ang ma byas so/ 62 /de yang rang bzo yin snyam na/ /mtshungs med mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid can/ /chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi srol/ /bka' stsal ji bzhin bdag gis bsgrubs/ 63 /de bzhin rgya chen lung rnams la/ /brten nas bdag la mi khro zhing / /rgyud pa la yang skur mi gdab/ /bka' dang mthun la yi rang 'tshal/ 64 /bdag ni brgyud pa rin po che/ /gsang sngags bka' bzhin sgrub pa rnams/ /dang po dam pa'i chos ngos bzung / /bar du gdams pa rgyud la
༄༅/ /blan / 65 /tha ma dam tshig legs par phog /bka' rgyas btab ste nyams myong dang / /dpe rgyud rgya yis 'debs par mdzod/ /de bzhin bdag kyang rjes su 'jug 66 /zhor la dris lan lkog yig tu/ /zur tsam smos pa 'di lta ste/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po la/ /'byams yig dri ba ngo mtshar che/ 67 /thun mong theg par grags pa yi/ /nyan thos lugs la'ang kun dga' bos/ /bud med rab tu byung ba yi/ /bcom ldan 'das la gsol btab pas/ 68 /bstan pa lo mang 'grib 'gyur zhes/ /yongs su grags pa yin mod la/ /yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po la/ /'byams yig bya bar ga la rigs/ 69 /'dra 'bags chen po rbesnags la yang rgya gar 'phags yul chos grwa rtswa /dngos grub brnyes pa'i dge slong ma/ /rdzogs chen don rtogs bdag nyid ma/ 70 /kun dga' mo dang bcas pa yis/ /rdzogs pa chen po las brtsams ste/ /chos kyi rtsod dri byas pa yis/ /mkhas pa shrī sing ha sogs/ 71 /paṇa chen rnams kyi mtshan ltas dang / /rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i ltas log nas/ /gang gis lan zhes pra la sogs/ 72 /mo dang rtsis kyis gtan la phab/ /de dus rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /chos la rtsod pa byas pa yi/ /de yi nyes par rtogs nas ni/ 73 /dam chos rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dpe rnams ma lus kun bsdus nas/ /paṇ+ḍita dang rgyal po yis/ /nam
gung rdo rje gdan gyi sar/ 74 /sbas nas ming yang mi grags pa'i/ /dpang por mkha' 'gro chos skyong bskos/ /mna' tho gal du bcad nas ni/ /gang gis rdzogs pa chen po'i ming / 75 /glegs bam sho lo ka gcig kyang bsgrags sam bstan nam mthong ba na/ /bstan pa'i snying po bsnubs pa'i rigs/ /rgyal po'i khrims la sbyar dam bcas/ 76 /de sogs gsang sngags mtha' dag gi /chos la phyug po'i sdig lta bur/ /sba bar gsungs pa'i lo rgyus dang / /lung rnams khyad du ma gsod cig / 77 zhog yig tu lan 'debs tshul la gnyis te/ dri ba rgyas par bkod pa dang / lan mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ na mo gu ru we/ chos dbyings bde chen klong yangs nas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'gyur med dang / /zab zhi spros bral gdod ma'i mgon/ /bla ma kun bzang la btud nas/ /rdzogs pa chen po las brtsams pa'i/ /dri yig ngo mtshar 'phreng ba 'di bdag blo lhag bsam dag pas dri/ /chos bdag srung mas gnang du gsol/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mchod par brjod cing dri bar dam bca' ba dang / bka'i srung ma la gnang ba zhu bar rtogs so/ /de dag gi skabs kyi mchod brjod ni/ tshig tsam du ma sbas shing snyan rgyud lag len gyis gtan la phabs pa'i nyams myong dang ldan pa yin na ni/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig gi spros par ma shor ba zhig yong ngo / /de ltar ma yin pa la ni 'di lta
༄༅/ /bu'i tshig tshon pos srang mdo thams cad du khyab ste dngos grub 'jig pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ kho bo ni zab mo'i tshig srang mdor mi brjod pa'i dam tshig go /de nas dri ba sum cu rtsa drug rim pa bzhin brjod par bya ste/ lan kyang rim gyis gdab par bya'o/ /gang gis theg pa thams cad kyi/ /yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /don la smra bsam brjod bral yang / /shes brjod tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshe/ /skal ldan rnams la yongs grags shing / /blo mchog rnams kyis rtogs mod kyang / /bdag nyid blo gros rtsal zhan pas/ /mos blo tsam las spyod ma nus/ /des na the tshom 'ga' mchis pa/ /a ti'i grub mtha' smra ba yi/ /mkhas grub mkhyen brtse ldan rnams kyis/ /bdag blo'i 'chang ba bsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod pa ni/ de nas rang gi 'dod pa'i don mdor bsdus te bstan pa yin no/ /bye brag tu dri ba dang po ni/ de yang / ston pa shākya thub pa yan/ /rdzogs chen chos ni dar ma dar/ /zhes pa la/ 'di la spyir btang dmigs bsal te/ /spyir ni chos rnams thams cad kyang / /rdzogs pa chen po nyid du gsungs/ /de bzhin gsang sngags theg pa yang / /thog ma med pa'i mtha' can yin/ /bye brag shākya thub pa nas/ /ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po sogs/ /gong du bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyis/ /bstan pa rdzogs pa chen por gnas/ /de bzhin bstod pa glur blangs rgyud/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rtsa
ba ste/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsungs 'gyur la/ /da ltar 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes dang rdzogs pa chen po sogs/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag po rtswa /rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /zhes gsungs thal 'gyur rtsa rgyud du/ /rang rang rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las/ /gsungs pa rnams la mkhas pa dang / /klong gsal rgyud kyi khog dbub sogs/ /dam pa'i gsungs la 'dres par bya/ /des ni nges shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin dri ba gnyis pa ni/ /shākya thub pa nyid kyis kyang / /gsungs pa'i rdzogs chen bdog gam med/ /ces dris lan 'di gdab par bya/ /'di la'ang spyir btang migs bsal gnyis/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa ni/ /spyir btang nyid du bstan pas te/ /de yang dpal ldan 'bras spungs sogs/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams su/ /skad cig nyid la chos phung ni brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa las/ /de yang gsung gcig nyid du gsungs/ /gsung gcig zhes pa don dam de/ /gnyis med rdzogs pa chen po'o/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis du mar yang / /go bar 'gyur gyi de yang ni theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la ston pa po/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis gang 'tshams pa'i/ /dam chos nyid du so sor go /ji srid 'du shes zad kyi
༄tsho/ /bar / / theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du/ /sems can rnams la ston par mdzad/ /khyad par shākya thub pa nyid/ /rnam snang gang chen mtsho dang ni/ /'og min stug po bkod la sogs sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams na/ /sprul pa bsam 'das brjod med kyis/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chos gsungs pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /de phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i chos/ /shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /rnams pa sku yi bkod pa yang / /rigs lnga zhi khro bka' brgyad dang / /gsang 'dus bde mchog kyai rdor dang / /ma hā ma ya dus 'khor lo/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ /de dang de yi skur snang nas gtso 'bor 'od kyi cho 'phrul dang / /sgra dang brda' dang rnam 'gyur dang / /ljags dbang las kyang dam chos 'byung / /rdzogs chen gsungs pa lta ci smos/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba gsum pa la/ /thang yig la ni shāka thub kyis/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa ni/ /tshig gcig ma gsungs zhes pa'ang snang / /de yi dgongs don ji ltar yin/ /zhes dris de yi lan bshad pa/ /pad+ma bka' yi thang yig la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du grags mod kyang / /dngos su snang ba gsum mam bzhi/ /de dag zhib mor dpyad pa na/ /rtsa ba gter ma nyid yin kyang / /dper na pha rabs chad 'dod na/ /bu rul skye bar mtshungs pa ltar/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i o rgyan gyis/ /ma 'ongs
dus mtha'i sems can la/ /phan par dgongs nas zab mo'i gter/ /rnam grangs bye ba sa ya sbas/ /de nyid 'don pa'i dus babs tshe/ /chos la dbang ba'i gter ston dang / /las la dbang ba'i gter ston sogs/ /'byung bar gsungs shing de dus su/ /gter du ma sbas ma nyams pa'i/ /bka' brgyad chu bo'i gzhung bzung nas/ /gter rgyud byin rlabs dam rdzas dang / /dpe rgyud bstan pa'i rgyab brten du/ /'byung ba dang 'phrad ma nor ba yin gyi de las log pa yi/ /bka' brgyud chu bo'i rgyun chad nas/ /dpe rgyud gter gyi therdzog dril tsam/ /'don par dbang ba la la yis/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag bstan/ /o rgyan dngos dang zhal mjal zhes mi chos bla ma'i rdzun la brten/ /grub pa'i rtags med kha ltas bslus/ /zhe sdang me 'bar dug mtsho khol/ /'dod chags chu khol bsrung sdom phre(ra/ /'dod pa'i dbang byas dam chos 'tshong / /gsang ba sgrogs shong dam bca' stor/ /gter min gter 'drar brdzu zhing bslad/ /lung bstan mchog brnyes dngos grub dang / /'gro mgon nyang ral chos dbang dang / /las 'brel rtsal dang rgod ldem dang / /rin chen gling dang rat+na gling / /sangs rgyas gling dang pad gling sogs/ /tshad ma'i gter ston rjes 'brangs 'gas/ /tshul min tshul 'chos 'khor tshogs slad/ /bka' min bka' bslu bsre slad byed/ /de 'dra dus kyi mtha' la mang / /de yi dbang gis
༄༅/ /thang yig la'ang / /bsre slad rtsodar dang ma rtsodar ba'i/ /rnam dbye so sor 'byed pa 'tshal/ /shākya thub pas bla med kyi/ /theg pa ma gsungs zhes pa yang / /thun mong lugs la grags mod kyi/ /de yang rdo rje'i gdan dang ni/ /chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa dang / /dbang brgyur lha yi gnas dag dang / /ri rab chen pe'i rtse rnams su/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang bya spyod gsum/ /gsungs zhes thun mong grags pa yin/ /thun mong ma yin lugs la ni/ /37 rgyan in+t+ra bho dhi la/ /bla med gsang ba 'dus pa gsungs/ /gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya trasga /thub pas chos rnams gsungs gyur zhing / /'dzam gling gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde thams cad gsungs par smra/ /des na 'od rgyus tha dad kyi/ /dbye ba gdul bya'i dbang gis yin/ /dper na lhun po gcig nyid la/ /mngon pa nyid dang dus 'khor sogs/ /bzhed pa tha dad smra ba yin/ /rjes su 'jug par byed dang mtshungs/ /de bzhin dri ba bzhi pa ni/ /rgya gar yul du rdzogs chen gyi/ /dam chos dar lugs ji ltar yin/ /zhes dris de yi lan btab pa/ 7/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten cher/ /nag pa zla ba'i yo lnga la/ /chosadabyings gsung giri dbang phyugadang / / spyir na gong du bstan pa yi/ /chos rnams ji ltar dar ba bzhin/ /rdzogs pa chen po'ang stobs shugs kyis/ /dar ba nyid la smos ci dgos/ /'on kyang de mtshan dngos ma grags/ /de phyir
dngos mtshan grags pa'i chos/ /dar tshul ston pa shāka thub kyis/ /rgyal po dharmā a sho ga'i/ /lha lcam la ni sprul ba'i sku/ /dga' rab rdo rje nyid la gdams/ /kha cig du ni shāka thub de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i skur snang nas dngos su dbang dang gdams pa dang / /rjes su gdams pa thams cad gnang / /'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rgyud/ /sems klong man ngag sde la sogs/ /so so'i 'khor la brgyud tshul ni/ /mthar thug rtsa ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /de bzhin bang mdzod lde mig dang / /be+e ro'i 'dra 'bag chen mo dang / /rdzogs chen stong thun so so la/ /rgyas par shes kyi 'dir mi spro/ /rnam thar mthun dang mi mthun pa/ /phra mo snang yang grub thob kyi/ /rnam thar yin par sna tshogs snang / /de la the tshom za mi 'tshal/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /gdul bya'i snang ba sna tshogs la/ /sku dang mdzad pa cir yang snang / /de ltar du ni shes par byos/ /de bzhin dri ba lnga pa ni/ /rdzogs chen bod du bsgyur ba ni/ /sgyur byed lo paṇa gang dang gang / /zhes dris de yi lan btab pa/ /dang po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /sprul ba srong btsan sgam po te/ /thugs rje chen po dngos yin phyir/ /de yis gsungs pa lo paṇa dang / /sdebs nas bsgyur ba yin mod kyang / /sam bho ṭa dang a lo kes/ /bka' yi bsdu ba byas pa yin/ /de dag shes par 'dod pas ni/ /thugs rje chen pe'i bka' 'bum dang / /rdzogs pa
༄tsho/ /chen po'i lo rgyus dang / /thugs rgyud rnams pa lnga la sogs/ /de yi nang na rdzogs chen gyi/ /thugs rgyud dag las shes par 'gyur/ /de dus rgya nag ha shang gi /ston pa ma hā ya nas kyang / /rdzogs chen bsgyur zhes ming tsam thos/ /de rjes 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /sar gnas sems dpa' mi gzugs can/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /thugs bskyed rgya gar paṇ+ḍita/ /spyan drangs sa btul gtsug lag mdzad/ /de dus paṇa chen zhi ba 'tsho/ /pad+ma sam bha la sogs pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa thob pa yi/ /slob dpon rnams la phyag btsal zhing / /tshogs mchod yon gyis mnyes byas te/ /gangs can yul du bzhugs pa dang / /chos 'khor bskor bar gsol ba btab/ /de dus slob dpon pad+ma yis/ /gsang ba sngags kyi rgyud sde dang / /theg chen thun mong pa yang gsungs/ /'on kyang rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /ston pa'i dus la ma babs pas/ /lkog yig tsam du rgyal po la/ /dam chos sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / /chig chod kun grol la sogs pa/ /gsungs nas sbas zhes bya ba'ang yod/ /slob dpon de yi lung bstan dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong zhing / /thugs kyis bsam yas btags pa la/ /sna tshogs dam pa'i chos 'gyur yang / /bya rtsol bral ba med mthong nas/ /slar yang rgya gar 'phags yul du/ /sa brgyad non pa'i lo tsā pa/ /skad rigs drug cu shes pa dang / /rdzu
'phrul ya ma zung ston pa/ /be+e ro tsa na nyid dang ni/ /legs grub gnyis kyis phyin pa las/ /gu ru shrī sidha te/ /'jigs byed 'byung gnas sbas pa yi/ /paṇa chen zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /spyi bos brgyud de gser mchod phul/ /gu ru shrī sing ha yis/ /rdo rje gdan gyi rgya bkrol nas/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud/ /sems sde klong sde man ngag sde/ /thams cad phyung ste de la gtad/ /kun byed stag dong khra mo rtswa /rgyud sde bdun cu thams cad blugs spyi chings bzhi yi dom shams btags/ /man ngag phra mos kha brgyan nas/ /bod du brdzangs nas chos rgyal la/ /bsam yas par khang ka gdong du/ /sems sde ma bu chos rnams gsungs/ /be rtsa gling du dar dkar gyi/ /glegs bam la ni bsgyur bar mdzad/ /de nas bī ma mi tra dang / /rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po yis/ /rna ba sho bsgrag zung 'brel nas/ /lo chen ye shes gzhon nus nyan/ /bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phabs lo chen be+e ro tsa na yis/ /a ro ye shes 'byung gnas sogs/ /rim par brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud dang / /rdo rje zam pa la sogs pa/ /skal ldan g.yu sgra snying po dang / /mi pham mgon po sogs la gnang / /be+e ro tsha rong spyugs pa yis/ /snying thig gsang ba'i gdams pa rnams/ /zur tsam bstan nas gter du sbas/ /'on kyang klong gsal pha ma'i chos/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i dben gnas su/ /paṇa zhu'i rtse nas phyung nas ni/ /3rdzo rgyan pad+mas
༄tshi/ /bka' stsal bzhin/ /phyag tu phul zhing slar zhus nas/ /o rgyan rje dang be+e ro dang / /chos rgyal bud med bdun la sogs/ /rje 'bangs rnams kyis gter kha ni/ /gnam lcags brag dang bum thang dang / /gung thang mkhar sogs rnams su sbas/ /gzho stod te gro brag dkar dang / /shel brag zab lung mchims phu sogs/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnas rnams su/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i snying thig dang / /ka dag dgongs pa zang thal dang / /kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus dang / /snying po gser gyi yang zhun dang / /don tig 'gro ba kun grol dang / /zab tig dgongs pa rang grol dang / /rdor sems snying gi thig le dang / /pad+ma snying tig la sogs pa/ /mtsho rgyal lha sras lha lcam dang / /be+e ro a tsar sa le sogs/ /skal ldan snying gi bu rnams la/ /legs par gsungs shing gter du sbas/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gnyer du bskos/ /slob dpon chen pos bka' stsal ba/ /snying thig bstan pa bī ma las/ /skyongs shig ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus/ /ma hā yo ga nyams pa'i rtags/ /gsang sngags ma hā a nu dang / /a ti'i lha dang dkyil 'khor rnams/ /srang mdor bzhengs pa'i dus byung nas/ /a nu'i bstan pa nyams rtags su/ /rtsa rlung thig le gsang ba'i chos/ /srang mdor ston zhing tho co dang / /drod med rus rgyan kha ṭ+wāX 'chang / /ngo mtshar che bar gus byed cing / /khrom la dbang bskur byed pa
'byung a ti'i bstan pa nyams rtags su/ /kha lta stong skad rbad khams che/ /dge med sdig med yin zhes gleng / /khrims spangs tha mal spyod pa skyong / /tshogs 'bor yin zhes srog chags gsod/ /zab mo rgyang glur len zhing rtsod/ /sgom bsgrub dor nas srang mdor 'khyams/ /de dus nga yi snying tig rnams/ /gter nas rim gyis 'byung ba'i tshe/ /bī ma la yi bka' rgyun gyi/ /rjes zhugs nga yi snying thig rnams/ /gsang ba'i gnas su sbas te sgom/ /zhes sogs zab me'i rgyas gdab mdzad/ /de nas paṇa chen bī ma las/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang / /myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po rnams/ /bcu bdun rgyud dang spyi rgyud dang / /zab mo'i rgyud lnga la sogs pa/ /snying tig ma bu zab mo yi/ /gser yig can dang dung yig can/ /zangs yig can dang phra yig can/ /de sogs gdams pa thams cad kyang / /dpal gyi dbu rtse rigs gsum dang / /bu tshal gser khang gling rnams su/ /mtshan gung nyid la legs par bsgyur/ /gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma dang / /lo tsa dka' ba dpal brtsegs kyis/ /spyi ti nyer lnga'i rgyud dang ni/ /bcu bdun rgyud dang bcas la sogs/ /mang du bsgyur zhing mang du sbas/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas sprul pa yis/ /gsungs shing bsgyur ba bsam mi khyab/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba drug pa ni/ /bsgyur ba'i rdzogs chen ji lta bu/ /zhes dris de yi lan gsol ba/ /bsgyur ba'i
༄tsho/ /rdzogs pa chen po la/ /rnam grangs phra mo bsam yang kyang / /mdor bsdus gong du bstan rnams te/ /bye brag rgyas par blta 'dod na/ /bka' gter gnyis kyi rgyud 'bum las/ /a ti'i skabs kyi dkar chag gi 'gyur byang logs su shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bdun pa ni/ /ye shes 'od dang zhi ba 'od/ /khyad par 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyi/ /de dag rtsod lan zur du zhu/ /zhes dris de yi lan gsol ba/ /rgyal bas lung bstan zhi ba 'od/ /de yi thugs bskyed mdzad pa ni/ /'gro ba'i don las gzhan min phyir/ /bdag gis bsam kyang nus ma lags/ /de bzhin skad gnyis smra ba yi/ /lo chen rin chen bzang po pas/ /rū ṭa thar pa nag po dang / /da lta'i dus kyi sngags pa rtswa /khas len byed pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /dgongs dang dgongs min ma byed par/ /bla ma mkhas par ma bsten zhing / /des gsungs legs par ma nyan zhing / /rnam par dpyad pa'ang ma byas par/ /skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom med kyang / /gzhan la dbang bzhi'i sdom 'bogs dang / /smon 'jug byang sems mi ldan par/ /sngags par khas 'che phal che bas/ /sbyor sgrol yin zhes srog chags kyi srog bcad sha khrag zas su za/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i lam spangs nas/ /srid pa'i khyim thabs nying 'khor byed/ /ma rig 'ching bar ma shes pas/ /chos tshogs zhing dang khang las brtson/ /rigs rgyud ngom zhing phrag
dog gis/ /drag sngags mthu gtad dug sbyor byed/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa'i nyes dmigs kyis/ /rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye ba yi/ /nges pa'i lung la yid ma ches/ /khrom du 'chams dbyangs gar sogs ngom/ /dgongs dang dgongs min don la rmongs/ /de 'dra'i rigs la mngon gsum dang / /ma 'ongs dus kyi rjes dpag la/ /dgongs nas sngags log sun 'byin mod/ /des ni phan par dgongs pa las/ /rgyud ni 'di dang 'di zhes pa/ /bcos ma yin zhes gsungs pa med/ /sman dang dug shā ca'adi gsang sngags spyi la yirin mchan/ tu nor ba yi/ /sngags 'o(ga de dag ngan song gi /sdug bsngal dag las skyob mdzad pa/ /de la gus pas thal sbyar te/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi rjes yi rang / /da dung de 'dra'i bshes gnyen ni/ /chos mig ldan pa 'byung gyur cig /lha btsun zhi ba 'od ces pas/ /pho brang btsun pa'i bka' shog ces/ /'byung mod de ni sems dge yang / /rgya chen chos kyi mig bral bas/ /sgra don phyogs tsam dgongs pa yis/ /thams cad med par 'gyur snyam te/ /kun byed phur pa gsang rgyud dang / /dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa sogs/ /bod ma yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ /sngags pa rlang por spyod pa yis/ /las 'bras khyad du gsod rnams kyis/ /spyod pa dag gis thugs sun zhing / /ha shang 'bar ba'i skad dang ni/ /rgya nag dang ni o rgyan skad/ /saX kṛ ta yi skad dang ni/ /'jang ka ra na grangs pa'i skad/ /
༄༅/ /kha che'i skad dang sing ha'i skad/ /rgya gar phral skad la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs skad las bsgyur ba'i skad/ /legs sbyar skad dang ma mthun pas/ /cung zad the tshom zos gyur zhing / /rgyud min rgyud du sems pa yi/ /rmongs pa lam dang bral dgos pas/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gsungs so snyam/ /sems bskyed pa la nyes pa med/ /'on kyang snga 'gyur 'dzin pa yi/ /sngags pas gtan tshig btsal bar rigs/ /de bzhin bla ma 'gos los kyang/ /snga 'gyur pa dang phyi 'gyur gyi/ /rgyud sde 'ga' dang 'ga' zhig las/ /bcos ma'i rgyud ces gsungs pa dang / /khyad par gsang ba snying po'i rgyud/ /rin chen mchog gis byas so zhes/ /smra mod gsang ba snying po yi/ /rgya dpe kha che'i shākya shrīs/ /gzigs shing khung ma'i rgyud yin zhes/ /rjes su gdams par mdzad pa dang / /bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri yis/ /dang po rgyud la dri ba dang / /mthar ni gsang snying bsgrub pa'i chos rgyan gyi me tog ces pa mdzad/ /de bzhin dpal 'byor thar ba yis/ /dam tshig rgyud sde yin zhes gsungs/ /'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis kyang / /rgyud sde gsang ba snying po yis/ /dbang dang gdams pa thams cad la/ /ched du bsngags pa rab tu mdzad/ /bdag kyang gsang ba snying po la/ /mi 'phrog pa yi dad pa yis/ /gsang ba snying po'i rgya dpe yang / /kho bo'i smyi bor 'byor bas dge /de phyir kha cig phrag dog gis/ /kha cig
gti mug rmongs pa'i blos/ /dam chos smod pa'i nyes bsam te/ /de yi rnam smin cir 'gyur ram/ /snying las chen por gyur pa lags/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can rnams kyis/ /sdig can 'di dag bskyab tu gsol/ /de bzhin mkhas pa rngog gis kyang / /gsar rnying bka' dang bstan bcos kyi/ /chos tshul phal zhig chos min zhes/ /khyad par gnyis med rnam rgyal dang / /lam 'bras tshig rkang man ngag dang / /ra l+li nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs/ /rgya gar gser 'dod chos su smras/ /rnying ma'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi/ /rgyud rnams slob dpon pad+ma yis/ /de dag so so'i skad mthun par/ /brtsams kyang byin rlabs 'byung ngo gsungs/ /kha cig chag los byas pa yis/ /sngags log dang ni 'gos lo yis/ /sngags log de dag de gnyis la/ /kha g.yar yin gyi dngos min zer/ /lo rgyus zhib tu smra ba'ang snang / /de lta na ni rmongs pa yi/ /mig gis mthong dang smras pa la/ /lan du bya ba rigs ma yin/ /sog po'i yul na rang gi ma/ /bag mar gtong ba'i lugs yod pa/ /de yang 'jig rten chos mi mthun/ /de la smra rgyu'ang ma mchis so/ /khyad par 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyis/ /rdzogs chen log pa'i chos su smras/ /snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa yi/ /'chad byed paṇa chen mang po dang / /bsgyur byed lo tsā mkhas pa yis/ /bsgyur ba'i chos rnams thams cad la/ /ma byung ma bsgyur zhes smra ba'i/ /lo rgyus gtan tshigs bkod nus na/ /
༄tsho/ /sgyu 'phrul yang phur rta mgrin dang / /bdud rtsi ma mo rdzogs pa che/ /bka' gter bka' brgyad thams cad la/ /chos min zhes pa'i gtan tshigs kyi/ /yi ge gsal bar bkod pa'i tshe/ /mkha' la rdo rje'i 'brug bsgrags shing / /bar snang 'jigs pa'i glog chen 'khyug /sprin nag 'khrugs pa'i gur khyim nas/ /rdo rje dmyal bar a la la/ /zhes pa khrag gis bris pa'i rdo/ /char bzhin babs nas 'dzin ma'i sa/ /rab tu gas pa'i nang tshud de/ /lte rtsa sdig pas za ba dang / /spyi bo tshugs su byas nas ni/ /dbur stod byang gis sa der dim/ /da ltar tshad bzung med pa yi/ /sdug bsngal drag po myong ba la/ /zhe 'gras med pa'i bzod pa yis/ /ngan song dong sprug cho ga dang / /yi ge drug ma'i sngags rgyun dang / /mi 'khrug rgyal po'i gzungs chog dang / /ngan song sbyong ba gtsug tor gyi/ /cho ga bzang po nyid dang ni/ /sbyong byed kun gyi rigs pa dang / /sman bla mched bdun mdo chog sogs/ /kun nas thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /de dag so so'i rtsod lan ni/ /kho bos mang du byas zin gyi/ /slar yang bgyid par dam bca' 'o/ /de dag rnams la tshad mar bgyis pa yi/ /mkhas par rab grags shākya mchog ldan gyis/ /don med sdig pa'i las rgyun spel ba'i phyir/ /legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba/ /ming bzang bdud kyi las stobs chen po yi/ /'jug tu bris shing par du bskos pa la/ /slob
ma'i tshogs la yang yang gdams pa yis/ /sdig pa'i phung po de yang byang gyur cig /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba brgyad pa ni/ /mkhas pa chen po bu ston gyis/ /snying ma'i rgyud sde mtha' dag la/ /mi dpyad btang snyoms bzhag go gsungs/ /de yang ji ltar 'thad pa yin/ /zhes dris lan du 'di ltar brjod/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad dang / /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshig gi rgyan/ /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa dang / /bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor rgyud de bzhin pha ma gnyis med rgyud/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /phyis 'gyur bstan pa phal mo che'i/ /phyogs la gzigs shing sbyangs pa dang / /mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid can de yis/ /snga 'gyur rgyud sde mtha' dag dang / /de yi dbang dang gdams ngag la/ /gzigs shing sbyangs pa ma mdzad kyang / /dpal ldan sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / /rdo rje phur pa rtsa dum dang / /khro bo zla gsang thig le dang / /ye shes thig le nyid dang ni dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang / /de yi dgongs 'grel rgya gzhung rnams/ /legs par gzigs shing legs par sbyangs/ /de bzhin ye shes zhabs lugs kyi/ /'grel bshad la yang legs par sbyangs/ /de las g.yin du ma gzigs par/ /bdag gi bla ma thar lo dang / /bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri sogs/ /snga 'gyur chos la bsngags mdzad kyang / /bdag gis legs par ma sbyangs pas/ /chos min pa la chos yin
༄༅/ /dang / / yin la min zhes smra byed pa/ /gnyis ka chos spongs las yin phyir/ /gzhan gyis brtags dpyad mdzod cig ces/ /rang sar bzhag la skyon mi mnga'/ /de bzhin mkhas pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ /mkhas pa ba sos dris lan las/ /snying ma'i rgyud gzhung ma mthong zhing / /phra thig rnal 'byor gang yin pa/ /zab mo rgyud kyi dgongs par 'dod/ /zhes gsungs phyis nas gsang snying las/ /tshad mar gzigs nas 'grel ba mdzad/ /de bzhin mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /bzang pos kyang ni gsang snying la/ /rnam dag rgyud sde yin no zhes/ /de nyid bsgrub pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ /de ltar sa skya mkhon gyi rgyud mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan gyis/ /yongs su brgyan pa'i dam pa mchog /bla ma dam pa bsod rgyal gyis/ /yang phur sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa/ /bla ma gzhan pa las gsan nas/ /ched du bsngags pa yang dag mdzad de bzhin 'phags pa rin po che/ /glo bo lo tsā shes rin la/ /sgyu 'phrul yang phur la sogs pa/ /bka' ma'i dbang rgyud gdams pa nod/ /rdo n+de phag mo khros nag sogs/ /rtsod med myang gi gter chos gsan/ /rje btsun sa skya pan+ti tas/ /yang phur gnyis kyi dbang rgyun spel/ /de bzhin rje btsun grags rgyal dang / /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yis/ /bka' dang bstan bcos glegs bam gyi/ /rim pa khrigs su mdzad pa'i
tshe sgyu 'phrul zla gsang thig le dang / /yang phur gsang 'dus dpal mchog dang / /tan+t+ra bco brgyad tshad mar mdzad/ /de lta bas na kha cig tu/ /gzigs pa rgya chen grub ma grub/ /de bzhin sku tshe 'khyol ma 'khyol/ /yul dang dus kyis bskal ma bskal/ /de phyir btang snyoms bzhag ma bzhag /legs par brtags te smra ba la/ /mu cor smra ba gang su dag /rang dang gzhan gyi phyogs gang du/ /cung zad rigs pa ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba gangs chen mtsho/ /de bzhin theg pa chen po'i gzhung / /pha rol phyin dang sngags kyi lung / /grangs tshad yod dam med pa yi/ /rnam dpyod du mar gsungs pas na/ /'di mtha' 'di tsam yin no zhes/ /de mtha' de tsam rjes dpag na/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong dag dang de las gzhan/ /tshod tsam dpag yas las gzhan pa/ /mkhas pa tsam gyis dpag mi nus/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul dang / /nyan thos dag gi spyod yul du/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma yin phyir/ /sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul lo/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba dgu ba ni/ /'gos lo chag lo dpon slob kyis/ /rgya gar yul du byon pa'i dus/ /bla ma mkhas grub mang bsten yang / /rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i chos/ /de rnams la ni ma grags pas/ /rnam dag min no zhes pa smra/ /lo tsā de gnyis rgya gar du/ /byon dus rgya gar shar nub tu/ /
༄༅/ /rdzogs chen chos ni bdog gam med/ /ces pa'i dris lan 'di lta ste/ /'gos lo chen po de nyid kyis/ /zur chung shes rab grags pa la/ /gsang snying slob tu phyin pa'i tshe/ /re zhig snod du ma gzigs pas/ /ba glang skyong du bcug pa'i tshe/ /gsang ba snying po'i gzhung de nyid/ /thugs su chud kyang de dag gi /dbang dang gdams pa ma thob par/ /'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi/ /drung du phyin nas sgra rnams bslabs/ /brtags pa gnyis pa'i rgyud mnyan nas/ /zur chung shes rab grags pa dang / /'brog mi shākya ye shes la/ /khyad par 'don par bya ba'i phyir/ /rgya gar yul du phyin nas kyang / /mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /bla ma mdun cu bsten na yang / /gsang ba snying po'i dris pa las/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba/ /yod kyi gsang ba snying po zhes/ /rgya gar yul na med do zhes/ /de dag rnams las thos nas kyang / /gsang ba phra mo'i gdams pa las/ /gdams ngag rdzogs par ma thob cing / /gsang ba 'dus pa nyan pa'i phyir/ /nag po pa dang btsun mo can/ /de sogs bla ma bzhi bsten nas/ /gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi/ /dbang rgyud gdams ngag mkhas par bslabs/ /de bzhin 'brog mi bla ma las/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang / /ma hā ma ya la sogs pa/ /ma rgyud gdams pa rdzogs par bslabs/ /'brog mi'i rgyud la 'gyur bcos nas/ /zur chung shes rab
grags pa dang / /rnying ma'i rgyud dang slob dpon la/ /phrag dog rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad/ /zur chung sher grags de dus kyi/ /kun gyi tshogs kyis rtsod mod kyang / /'khor la bka' bsgos gdan stabs dang / /ldang ba la sogs dgag par mdzad/ /mngon du phyogs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /sngon du rang gis phyag byas pas/ /dbang med dad pa'i shugs thob nas/ /'khor gyis dris pas lan gdab pa/ /sngags 'chang 'ban po yin snyam nas/ /phyag mi 'tshal ba'i dam bcas pas/ /mthong ba tsam gyis de nyid la/ /ma hā shrī dngos yin snyams/ /dran med ngang nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor gyis dris pa'i lan du smras/ /de ni rgya gar yul phyin yang / /dbus 'gyur ma ga ta la sogs/ /dbus mtha'i yul 'gar phyin mod kyi/ /gsang ba sgyu 'phrul la sogs khungs/ /o rgyan yul dang za hor yul/ /phyin pa'i gtam yang ma thos so/ /de lta bas na rgya gar gyi/ /chos dang man ngag btsun pa dang gsang sgo shin tu dam pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnyed dka' zhing / /gal te dus kyis nub gyur pas/ /da lta bod du mngon gyur pa'i/ /mdo rgyud man ngag phal cher yang / /rgya gar yul du mngon mi snang / /de bzhin gangs can yul rnams su/ /yod pa'i spyi dang bye brag gi /chos kun gcig na gnas mi srid/ /de ltar phrag dog gis gdams pa'i/ /smra ba dag la khungs mi 'tshal/ /de bzhin chos rje chag lo ni/ /khu bo dgra
༄tshi/ /bcom zhes bya ba/ /de yi tsha bo chos rje dpal/ /gnyis ka rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan/ /bgrod mod chos rje dpal ba yis/ /'phags yul bal bor lo brgyad dang / /rdo rje gdan du ra wan+t+ra'i/ /zhabs la brgyud de bcu gnyis lor/ /bzhugs kyang rgya gar phyogs mtha' rtswa /khyab par byon zhes ma grags shing / /paṇ+ḍi ta ni gsum bzhi las/ /sbyong rgyud gshed mar gsang 'dus dang / /bde mchog sdom 'byung la sogs pa/ /ci rigs pa la sbyangs mod kyi/ /gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gros rgyas btab pa/ /sngon du brjod pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /rgya gar grags pa'i dbang med kyi/ /be+e ro tsa na byon pa'i tshe/ /rgya gar chos la phrag dog pas kun gyis mtshan ltas log gyur pas/ /bod kyi ban de gsod pa dang / /phra ma 'byed 'dzud phyir du yang / /skang mgyogs pho nya brdzangs pa yi/ /lo rgyus 'dra 'bag nang na gsal/ /dper na phyug po'i khyim gyi nor snying por gyur pa gang yin pa/ /thun mong gsang ba'i lugs yin na/ /de las kyang ni gsang sngags kyi/ /snying po rdzogs chen cis mi gsang / /da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i tshe/ /yi dam kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad dang / /theg pa kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /dam chos rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /ras snam shog shog sha mar nas /bu ram sgrub pa'i zong du 'tshong / /gser dang sbang phye 'tshong byed pa'i/ /bdud
khyer sngags pas sa steng khyab/ /kye ma kye stod sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa nub ri'i rtse la thegs/ /mkhas grub nam mkha'i na bun yal/ /thugs rjes zung zhig gu ru rje/ /chos min pa la chos yin dang / /brgyud pa ldan pa'i chos sbong zhing / /gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /lus can dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las gsungs/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shong / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /mnyan pa la sogs brtson pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /de skad gsang ba snying por gsungs/ /'dus pa skor dgu'i rim pa las/ /sngon du sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'bor du/ /bka' ma'i dbang bskur thob byas nas/ /de nas bde gshegs 'dus pa yis/ /bsnyen sgrub bdag 'jug bya bar gsungs/ /bka' gter zung gcig chu rgyun gyi/ /brgyud pa dag las ma mchis so/ /de bzhin chos drug sras mkhar ma'i/ /chos drug gter nas lon pa'i tshe/ /dbang ni rngog pa'i lugs su byas/ /chos drug bka' ma'i lugs su bskyangs/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang gi dbang / /gter ma'i lugs su dbang bya zhing / /mi re'i lag tu chos drug re/ /'dra min byung dus gter ma yis/ /zhus dag bya bar gsungs pa yin/ /'gro mgon mnga' bdag nyang ral dang / /gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem sgro can/ /de bzhin rdo rje gling pa dang / /o rgyan gling pa la sogs
༄༅/ /pa / / gter ston tshad ldan mang po yis/ /dang po sgyu 'phrul yang phur dang / /ma gshin bdud rtsi pad+ma dang / /'dus pa mdo dang sems sde dang / /man ngag sde yi skor zhus nas/ /de nas rang gi gter chos kyi/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i snyan rgyud spel/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud drod ma yal/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'dzin de dag yin/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i tha ma la/ /bka' gter zung ldan mi 'dod pas/ /gter chos kha 'dzin bka' ma'i chos/ /ma dag byin rlabs yal lo zhes/ /smra zhing gter ston t+pū ma yis/ /snga ma snga ma'i bstan ba snubs/ /de 'dra'i dus ngan shar ba'i tshe/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa yis chos dang chos min lta ba gces/ /gzhan yang lo tsā de gnyis po/ /rgya gar yul du gnas pa'i tshe/ /ye shes zhabs kyis gsang 'dus kyi/ /dbang rgyud de yi 'grel pa dang / /'jam dpal gyis ni zhal lung dang / /de bzhin sgrub thabs kun bzang dang / /sgrub thabs kun tu bzang mo ru/ /kun tu bzang mo zhes pa dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa chen po zhes/ /gsal bar gsungs kyang rgya gar pa/ /rang rang chos la bka' dog phyir/ /rtsod pa med par grags na yang / /de yang gnyis gas ma mkhyen pa/ /kho nas rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /med pa'i grub mtha' 'cha' nus sam/ /de bzhin legs par chos kyi mig /mnga' bar gyur na gshin rje gshed/ /dgra
gdong 'jigs byed gshed dmar rgyud/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang / /de bzhin rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhir/ /gsungs pa'i tha ma gang yin pa/ /de bzhin rdzogs chen rnal 'byor ram/ /a ti bkod pa zhes pa'i rgyud/ /la brten bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /sgrubs pa'i lugs su byed pa yang / /a ti zhes bya rdzogs pa'am/ /mthar thug yin phyir de nyid kyi/ /rnal 'byor bcas pa de dag la/ /a ti yo gar 'dogs dgos so/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu pa ni/ /rdo rje gdan na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs chen rgya dpe gang yod rnams/ /be+e ro dang ni bī ma las/ /lhag ma med par gdan drangs bas/ /phyin chad rgya na med do zhes/ /de yi dgongs don ji ltar yin/ /dris pa'i lan du 'di ltar brjod/ /pad+ma ka chems lo rgyus 'gar/ /rgya gar yul gyi rdo rje'i gdan/ /de na bzhugs pa'i rgya dpe rnams/ /slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha was/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni spyan drangs nas bsam yas dpal gyi dbu rtse yi/ /dkor mdzod nang na bzhugs so zhes/ /de nas rgya dpe rgya gar du/ /med do zhes pa mang du snang / /de bzhin dbu rtse rigs gsum kyis/ /stong 'og bar gyi spu tshang gi /snying po kun na ta la dang / /gro ga shing shun la bris pa'i/ /rgya dpe tshang dang ma tshang pa/ /khur long bdun tsam yong pa yang / /kho bos dngos su mthong ba dang / /sngon dus jo bo a ti shas/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /
