༄tsho/ /rtogs pa'i rgyud dang gnyis pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud dang bdun/ /de las phye ba bya ba'i rgyud/ /stong phrag bzhi dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /stong phrag brgyad dang rtogs pa'i rgyud/ /stong phrag bzhi dang gnyis pa'i rgyud/ /stong phrag drug dang rnal 'byor rgyud/ /grangs med dang ni chen po'i rgyud/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis rnams dang ni/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /rgyas par phye na grangs med pa/ /mkhyen zhing gzigs par gyur na yang / /de rgyu ma gtogs rgyud sde'i tshogs/ /grangs dang rtsis las 'das pa dag /bsam yas bkor mdzod nang bzhugs pa/ /mngon du gzigs pas jo bo yang / /gzigs shing mkhyen pa'i bcom skyungs nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha was/ /o rgyan gnas nas rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rgyud sde 'di dag spyan drangs par/ /sngon gyi lo paṇa mang po yis/ /rgya dpe mang po rgya gar nas/ /bod du bsnams nas byon pa'i gtam/ /rgan rabs dag las ma byung zhing / /rgyud kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu/ /rgya gar yul du ma grags gsungs/ /de phyir paṇa chen shākya shrīs/ /thang po che yi dpe mdzod nas gsang snying dra ba sdom pa dang / rtsa ltung rgya cher 'grel la sogs/ /mang du gzigs shing kha yar bsgyur/ /de dag sngon dus bsam yas nas/ /rim gyis 'phyugs pa'i rgya dper snang / /de bzhin sa skya paṇa chen
gyis bsam yas dag du byon pa'i tshe/ /dpe gar dkor mdzod gling nyid kyi/ /dkor gnyer dag gis phur ba'i rgyud/ /rtsa ba dum bu phul ba'i dus/ /rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /sku la snam sbyar gsol nas kyang / /dkor gnyer dag la bkyed cig gsungs/ /'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa yis/ /dar gdugs spos kyis spyan drangs nas/ /rgya dpe dbu yi gtsug tu bzhag /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /phyag dpe 'di 'dra dngos mjal ba/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthu yin gsungs/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /shangs kyi sreg shing dgon par bsgyur/ /zur pa rnams la spel bar mdzad/ /da lta rgyud 'bum nang na bzhugs/ /de bzhin bsam yas nas brgyud pa'i/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /rgya dpe'i bye brag mang po yang / /dbus kyi sne'u gdong rtse na bzhugs/ /de ltar rdzogs pa chen po yang / /de bzhin gzhan yang bsam yas sam/ /bod du byon par the tshom med/ /de yi dgongs don gangs can du/ /bstan pa'i sgron me nyid la dgongs/ /rdzogs chen rgya dpe gang dag rnams/ /be+e ro dang ni bī ma las/ /lhag ma med par gdan drangs pas/ /phyin chad med ces smra ba'i gtam/ /gtan tshig med pa'i mu cor yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di lta ste/ /kā ma shwe la'i gtsug lag du/ /slob dpon be+e ro tsa na yis/ /shrī sing ha'i spyan snga rtswa /rdzogs pa chen po'i chos zhu dus/ /nyi grib mtshams
༄tsho/ /su dar dkar la/ /rgyud rnams ra yi 'o mas bris/ /rtse ring zhwa yi nang du brdzangs/ /rgya dpe rdo rje gdan du btabs/ /zhes sogs lo rgyus zhib mo rnams/ /'dra 'bag chen mo nyid na gsal/ /de bzhin paṇa chen bī ma la/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /bod du gdan 'dren brdzangs pa'i tshe/ /mi la bskur la mchod gnas ni/ /paṇa chen lnga brgya bzhugs pa las/ /sgra don tshig la mkhas pa gcig /bod du rdzongs shog zhus pa'i don/ /yar mar nyis brgya lnga bcu yis/ /dbus na bī ma mi tra la/ /kun gyis bskul bar mdzad nas ni/ /mi brjed gzungs thob sho lo ka/ /'bum phrag sum cu so bdun mkhyen/ /gzigs pa'i spyan yangs bsam mi khyab/ /de nyid 'byon par chas pa na/ /rgya dpe dgos pa med mod kyang / /dam tshig gleg bam mi spang pa'i/ /mtshon byed sho lo ka gcig la/ /sor mo bzhi pa'i ka pa laṃ/ /tshad dang bcas pa bsnams nas byon/ /zhes pa'i lo rgyus zhib par snang / /de las gzhan gyi rgya dpe ni/ /de ltar slob dpon rnams gnyis las/ /the tshom yod pa srid mod kyang / /rgya dpe thams cad spyan drangs pa'i/ /lo rgyus gtan tshig ma rnyed do/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu gcig pa/ /theg pa rim dgu'i tha snyad ni/ /theg brgyad man las gsungs ma gsungs/ /de dag re rer gsum/ /zhes dris lan du 'di lta ste/ /theg pa rim dgu zhes bya ba/ /gang zag blo gros rab
'bring gsum/ /de dag re rer gsum gsum ste/ /rim par phye ba'i blo mtha' yis/ /mas rim nas ni nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal dbu sems theg pa bstan/ /'bring gi mas rim nas brtsams te/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum dang / /rab kyang mas rim nas brtsams te/ /ma hā a nu a ti'o/ /des na a ti yo ga la/ /dgu ba nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /gal te theg pa bcur 'dod na/ /grub mtha' blo bsgyur theg pa ni/ /mu stegs phyi rol theg pa dang / /khyad par nang pa'i theg pa dgu/ /bgrangs thabs bcu ru rgyud las gsungs/ /gzhan yang rnam grangs gsum dang bdun/ /thug pa med pa'i bar gsungs pa/ /ji srid 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /de bzhin gsang ba snying po las/ /sems can rtogs pa ji snyed pa/ /rtogs 'dul dam tshig de nyid spro/ /zhes sogs lung las shes par bya/ /'dir ni brjod par ga la lang / /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu gnyis pa/ /theg mchog a ti yo ga dang / /theg brgyad man chad khyad par ni/ /spyir btang gang gi sgo nas 'byed/ /bye brag lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi/ /khyad par 'byed lugs ji ltar yin/ /'di dag dgos byed med dam ci/ /de skad lan du 'bru gnyer nas/ /don gyi migs bsal rim par phye/ /theg mchog a ti yo ga dang/ /theg brgyad man chad khyad par ni/ /spyir btang gong mas 'og ma yi/ /lta sgom spyod pa zil mnan
༄tshi/ /nas / / gnas 'gyur thabs shes khyad par 'phags/ /bye brag theg pa re re la'ang / /'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig dang / /lta sgom spyod 'bras bdun gyis dbye/ /de dag theg pa'i bkol mdo dang / /de bzhin g.yu thang them skas dang / /bang mdzod 'phrul gyi lde mig dang / /rgyud sde rnams na mang du bzhugs/ /rgyas par 'dir ni ma bkod mod/ /mdor bsdus theg pa 'og ma yi/ /lam gyi skas gdangs la 'dzegs nas/ /gong ma'i mthong gsal de dang der/ /las rim 'jug pa khyadapar yin/ /sa dang lam la ma ltos par/ /ye sangs rgyas pas phye ba'o/ /zhes pa sems can thams cad la/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs zhes sam/ /gzhi yi sangs rgyas nyid la 'dod/ /rang gis dogs pa khong slong gi /bskyar nas dri ba byas pa la/ /a ti yo ga'i theg pa la/ /sa lam rnam bzhag med zer na/ /de lta na ni a ti la/ /rdzogs pa chen po sa gcig dang / /de nyid bcu drug phyed phyed kyi/ /thig le can zhes bcu drug pa/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /kun bzang che mchog he ru ka /dbu ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /sa mchog nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ /rim par rdzogs pa'i brda' don du/ /slob pa'i lam gyi sa bcu las/ /thig le gcig po'i che ba la/ /mi slob lam gyi bcu gcig pa/ /zhes gsungs 'gal bas rgyud gzhung sogs/ /thos pa bral ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/ /gal te rang gis dris pa'i tshig /sa
lam rnam bzhag ma gsungs shing / /zhes pa'i don du dris nas ni/ /rang gis dris pa'i tshig dag tu/ /rang gis 'dod pa brjod pa na/ /khyad par snang ba bzhi po ni/ /'jug tshul lam gyi rim pa yin/ /zhes pa dag gis rtogs mod kyi/ /zlos pa'i tshig gis ci zhig bya/ /theg pa rim dgu'i rnam bzhag kyang / /lam gyi 'jug tshul min nam ci/ /khyad par rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /theg pa yin phyir 'jug tshul la/ /brten par mi dgos su yis smra de lta na ni sngon rabs kyis/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i chos 'tshol ba'i/ /rtsol ba de yang don med yin/ /des na lta sgom spyod pa yi/ /la bzla ba dang shan dbye ba/ /de dag kun la'ang byang dgos so/ /thad ga'i rnam dbye ma phyed pa'i/ /dri dang lan 'debs ci zhig bya/ /'di dag dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ /spyir na theg pa so so la/ /dkri lugs so so gsungs pa dang / /bye brag rdzogs pa chen po la/ /sems klong man ngag sde re la/ /dbang dam lta sgom so so la/ /rim dang gcig char la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid dang / /mngon par byang chub dgos pa bdog /de tsam la brten bla ma yi/ /snyan rgyud gdams pas ma bkrol na/ /mi rtag 'chi ba ma dran zhing / /skad cig re res 'gyur ba yi/ /rnam 'gyur rim pa ma rtogs par/ /'du 'dzi g.yengs ba khe grags phyir/ /mang po mang po smra ba dang / /tab tab mang po byed pa dang / /mang po mang po dri ba dang / /don
༄tsho/ /med bya bas rang gzhan bslu/ /de bas dgos med dran byas te/ /zab don bsgoms na mi 'thad dam/ /sngon du tshogs gnyis ma bsags shing / /bla mas dus thabs ma bstan pa'i/ /bkra ye shes rab che na yang don gyi snying po cang 'gyur ram/ /phaṭaXces so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu gsum pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa la/ /'khor 'das chos kun rdzogs ma rdzogs/ /zhes dris lan du 'di gdab po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni yongs dag pa'i/ /ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po la/ /'khor 'das chos su gang gis btags/ /rdzogs dang ma rdzogs su yis brjod/ /ma bcos spros bral nyid kyi skur/ /de la gzung gzhi dpyad du med/ /lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po la/ /ma 'gag ye shes rol pa'i rtsal/ /'khor 'das chos kun snang rung pa'i/ /rten 'brel 'gag med sgyu mar snang / /snang yang thams cad de yin phyir/ /ma rdzogs zhes ni su zhig smra/ /'khor ba sgyu mar snang ba dang / /bde gshegs sku dang 'od zer dang / /cho 'phrul sgyu mar snang ba kun/ /thams cad ye shes rol pa'i rtsal/ /de bzhin theg pa thams cad kyang / /lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /che ba'i yon tan khyad par ro/ /rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu bzhi pa/ /sems klong man ngag sde gsum gyi/ /lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu la/ /khyad par dbye ba bdog gam med/ /ces dris lan du 'di skad do/ /
chos kun khyad par sde gsum po/ /gsung gcig nyid du gsungs mod kyi/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis so sor rtogs/ /de phyir theg pa sna tshogs la/ /'jug sgo thun mong khyad par la/ /snang phyir sde gsum lta sgom dang / /spyod pa rnams la spyi mthun du/ /sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /bskul ba mdo sde gsang sngags kyi/ /lta sgom spyod pa thun mong dang / /drod thob dang ni ma thob pa'i/ /rim pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / /de bzhin rang byung lta ba dang / /sgom pa zhi gnas rten can dang / /rten med dbang gi ye shes dang / /spyod pa thun mong thun min rnams/ /rang rang gzhung du gsal mod kyi/ /'bras bu sku lnga'i bdag nyid la/ /'byor pa myur bul tsam zhig las/ /bla med rgyud kyi 'bras bu ni/ /khyad par dbye ba mi 'dod kyang / /nyan thos la sogs so so yi/ /'bras bu'i dbye ba bkol mdor gsungs/ /ma nor sgom pa las byung gi /de yi spyod pa'ang spyad pa las/ /'bras thob myong ba'i stobs kyis yin/ /des na rnal 'byor g.yeng pa spongs/ /cog bzhag lta ba'i sgro 'dogs chod/ /bsal bzhag med pa'i don la sgoms/ /mnyam rjes lung mthun spyod pa skyongs/ /de yis 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /kha bshad tho co'i 'di lta min/ /zhes so/ /de nas dri ba bco lnga pa/ /gzhi la ka dag lhun grub dang / /lam la khreg chod thod rgal dang / /'bras bu sku dang ye shes sogs/ /zhes pa'i rang gzhung smra ba'i
༄tsho/ /tshe / / ka dag lhun grub mtshungs mi mtshungs/ /mi mtshungs de yi shes byed gang / /mtshungs na gzhi lam 'bras gsum ga'i/ /ka dag ces pa'i dgongs don la/ /kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rnams/ /med nas dag gam yod kyang dag /rim gyis dag gam gcig char dag /ka dag rang snang yin nam min/ /de dag rgyu mtshan ji lta bu/ /zhes dris lan du 'di gdab po/ /mdor bsdus pa ni bsnyad par bya/ /'khor 'das lam gyi chos rnams kun/ /chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur mod/ /dbyings kyi ye shes rig pa'i rtsal/ /rang yang ye shes glo bur gyi/ /rtog pas sgribs te 'bor ba las/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal ba'i thugs rje yis/ /smon lam stobs kyis theg pa'i chos/ /ma 'gag chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul cir yang snang / /de phyir lung rigs sna tshogs la/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis so sor snang / /rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya ba/ /gzhi la 'khrul pa med par gsungs/ /de bzhin gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig las/ /gzhi la gnas lugs 'khrul lugs dang / /lam la thun mong khyad par gnyis/ /de bzhin theg pa rim dgu'i chos/ /'bras bu dgra bcom nyid dang ni/ /rigs gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /rigs lnga kha sbyor yan lag bdun/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ni/ /sku lnga gsung lnga thugs lnga dang / /yon tan 'phrin las nyer lnga'i chos/ /de bzhin sa yi rim pa yang / /dgra
bcom pa dang kun du 'od/ /bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /bcu bzhi ye shes bla ma dang / /bco lnga bcu drug nyer gcig sogs/ /sa yi rnam bzhag du ma gsungs/ /thob byed lam yang bden bzhi dang / /kun rdzob don dam byang sems dang / /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /dag pa gsum dang ting 'dzin gsum/ /mngon byang lnga dang rnal 'byor bzhi/ /rim lnga dbyibs bzhi rim pa lnga/ /sbyor ba drug dang chos drug dang / /dbang bzhi lam gyi rim pa dang / /ka dag lhun grub mngon sum gyi/ /rim pa du ma gsungs pa yang / /don gcig ma rmongs thabs kyi lam/ /mang zhing skal ba med pas ste/ /zhi gnas ldan pa'i lhag mthong gi /zhing khams sbyong shing 'khrul snang spongs/ /'gal 'du'i skyon med nyid du bstan/ /khyad par rdzogs pa chen po la/ /gzhi yi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ /dngos med ka dag lhun gyis grub/ /ye nas sangs rgyas nyid yin kyang / /glo bur dri ma bsal ba'i phyir/ /khyi'us khyi'u 'byin pa ltar/ /'bras bu lam du byed pa'o/ /dpe dang don gyi ye shes kyi/ /dngos med ka dag lhun grub dang / /ye sangs rgyas pa'i ngo sprod dag /bla mas dus thabs la brten nas/ /thabs lam rim pas dbye ba yi/ /zhi gnas ldan pa'i lhag mthong sgrubs/ /rim gyis drod sogs thob nas ni/ /de nas rim gyis glo bur gyi/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags
༄༅/ /rnams / / byang bas mthong lam ye shes nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob 'gyur/ /de yang dngos med ka dag dang / /lhun grub ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i/ /don de bstan par gyur pa las/ /'bras bu ming du btags pa'o des na khyeg chod ces pa'i lam/ /ma bcos so mar bzhag pa las/ /dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar ltar/ /lhun grub mngon gyur thod brgal te/ /de nyid la ni goms pa yis/ /'bras bu rten sku brten pa ni/ /ye shes lnga ru rgyas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yin/ /de nas lam dang 'bras bu la/ /ka dag lhun grub kun du mtshungs/ /lta ba'i sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mthar/ /de yi don la mnyam 'jog pa/ /lhun grub lam gyi rnal 'byor yin/ /goms pas 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur/ /ka dag ces pa'i dgongs don ni/ /thog ma ma 'khrul dus nyid nas/ /mtha' la 'khrul sangs 'bras bu'i mthar/ /'od gsal dri med chos skur gnas/ /de phyir a don skye med la/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul ka sogs kyang / /rang bzhin dngos med mkha' dang mtshungs/ /de phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mnyam sbyor dang / /snying po rnams dang dgongs 'dus las/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar smad kyi
chos skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid nas skye ba med/ /zhes sogs don gyis bstan pa'o/ /'gro ba ming dang gzugs kyis bslus/ /bstod smad brag cha'i sgra dang mtshungs/ /gnas lugs 'od gsal 'gyur ba med/ /des na gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rnams/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /dus gsum mi 'gyur dag pa la/ /yod dang med pa'i sgro bskur spangs/ /rim dang cha gcig dus gsum med/ /de ltar yin lugs gzhir bzhag na/ /de yi don la mnyam 'jog pa/ /ka dag gnas lugs lam khyer yin/ /ka dag rang bzhin snang ba la/ /kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral/ /med nas dag pa'ang yod min te/ /gzung 'dzin yod na ka dag min/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid la/ /ka dag ces su brjod pa yin/ /ka dag gnas lugs brjod bral la/ /rang snang yin shes bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /de las rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /rang snang yin min 'dzin las 'khrul/ /de bzhin bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /lhun grub rang ngo shes par bya/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /de dag dgyes pa rdo rje las/ /gang gis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang / /rang gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs rang gar 'jug pa dang / /yi ge tsam gyis
༄tshi/ /shes mi nus/ /bla ma bsten la mnyes par bya/ /de nas phyi nang dbang bskur blangs/ /de nas lam gyi gnad la sbyangs/ /stong ba nyid la rung pa dang / /de la thams cad rung pa nyid/ /de phyir rten 'brel sgrigs mkhas pa/ /dngos grub mchog la sbyor bar 'gyur/ /de dag zab mo'i gnad yin phyir/ /bris la mkha' 'gro'i bzod par gsol/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu drug pa/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i lhun grub la/ /kun rdzob grub bam don dam grub/ /rang snang gzhan snang gang du grub/ /yod par grub bam med par grub/ /ces dris lan du 'di ltar ro/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zung 'jug la/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /'byung rung nyid du lhun gyis grub/ /gdod nas gnas pa'i chos nyid la/ /ye shes lnga po lhun grub kyi/ /smin grol lam gyi chos rnams la/ /'byung rung yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /gnas 'gyur 'bras bu lhun grub la/ /sku dang ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /des na kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /tshig mang brjod pas ci zhig bya/ /rang byung ye shes nyid yin phyir/ /rang rang snang bar lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' las kyang / /snang ba gsum gyi ngo bo la/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba rnal par bzhag /gzhan yang 'di ltar shes par bya/ /rang bzhin gyis ni snang ba dang / /log rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang / /rnal 'byor lam gyi snang ba dang / /'bras bu dag pa'i snang ba
ste thams cad rang bzhin snang bar 'dus/ /bdag med tha snyad grub ma grub/ /sgro 'dogs de yis chod par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu bdun pa/ /ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi /go don de yang skyar dgos so/ /zhes dris de yi lan brjod pa/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus kun/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ /gnyis su byar med so so dang stong pa tha dad gang gis kyang / /gdod nas dbyer med zung 'jug tu/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /rang rang ngo bos stong pa dang / /'od gsal bri gang med pa gnyis/ /brjod bya'i dbang gis tha dad kyang / /don la khyad par med pa ltar/ /de bzhin ngo rbo stong pa dang / /rang bzhin kun tu snang ba'i dbyings/ /thugs rje kun tu khyab pa yang / /brjod bya'i dbang gis gsum snang yang / /zung 'jug tu ni shes par bya/ /'khor 'das lam kyi chos rnams kun/ /mtshan nyid rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin cir yang snang / /nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /snang stong gnyis su mi phyed cing / /mi shigs pa dang bden pa dang / /sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ /ngo bo zung 'jug nyid yin par/ /sgro 'dogs legs par chod dgos so/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bco brgyad pa/ /da
༄tshi/ /rung gzhi la cung zad dpyad/ /gdod ma'i spyi gzhi zhes pa dang / /'khrul gzhi grol gzhi zhes bshad pa/ /de dag khyad par bdog gam med/ /'dod na khyad par ji lta bu/ /zhes dris de yi lan brjod pa/ /gzhi gsum rim pa gsungs pa ni/ /khyad par bdog pa'i phyir yin te/ /gdod ma'i spyi gzhi zhes bya ba/ /tshogs ma bsags pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /gdod nas dag pa'i chos sku yin/ /de la sgrib gnyis spangs bya'ang med/ /brjod bral de la brjod med kyang / /ming du brjod na kun du bzang / /bla dwags tsam du btags pa yin/ /de yang ming du ma btags na/ /sgra tshig rgyud rnams mi 'byung zhing / /lam pa thams cad rmongs gyur pa'i/ /de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /rgyal bas ming du brjod par mdzad/ /de bas sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /yi ge sgra btags ming tshig la/ /brten nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /zhes gsungs 'od gsal de bzhin nyid/ /bde gshegs kun gyi thugs su chud/ /'khrul pa'i gzhi ni lhan skyes kyis/ /gti mug ma rig chen po ste/ /rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas/ /mun ni thom me bying nge ba/ /byis pa shed ma bye ba dang / /sbrum ma'i lto ba la gnas pa'i/ /bar de'i dri za dang mtshungs pa'i/ /dug lnga'i rkyen dbang kun brtags pas/ /gang 'phrad de yi stobs su 'gyur/ /rigs drug lus blangs sdug bsngal myong / /grol gzhi rang
gi shes rig la/ /smin grol byin rlabs mthus bskrun pas/ /tshogs bsag pa las bde ba 'byung / /khams dgu 'dus pas ting 'dzin skye/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pas bag chags sbyangs/ /glo bur las nyon shes bya'i sgrib zad pas rgyal 'gyur sangs rgyas so/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba bcu dgu pa/ /rdzogs chen gzhi nas grol zer na/ /gdod ma'i spyi gzhi grol lam ci/ /zhes pa'i lan du 'di brjod do/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba'i/ /bde gshegs snying po byang chub khams/ /bsags sbyangs lam la ma ltos par/ /thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /de la bcings dang grol ba med/ /bri dang gang ba yod ma yin/ /de la skye dang 'gag pa'ang med/ /gnas med dmigs pa'ang yod ma yin/ /phyogs med ris med dpyad pa'ang med/ /glo bur lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /ma rig pa dang kun brtags kyi/ /bag chags las kyis bskrun pa yi/ /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa'i skyabs/ /mchog gi dam pa sku gsum yin/ /de yang gdod ma'i sangs rgyas te/ /khyab brdal chen po chos kyi sku/ /gsal dngas ma 'dres longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs rang grol sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid/ /de nyid rgyal ba thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje'i bdag /dpal mchog dang pe'i skyes bu che/ /thog mtha' med
༄tshi/ /pa'i sems dpa' 'dod/ /bcings med rnal par grol ba med/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /bstan phyir spro ba sna tshogs mdzad/ /de ni kun byed rgyal po ste/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag pas/ /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ltar/ /de las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung / /de las gnas gsum po yang 'byung / /de yis kun la khyab pa ste/ /de nyid ston pa chen po ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin dpe byad pa/ /'chad pa po dang chos kyang dang / /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /nga yis de kun khyab pa ste/ /thams cad chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin ngas ma mthong / /'od gsal ba la rtag par gnas/ /bar de'i grong khyer des mi mthong / /mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin ni/ /kun bzang zag pa med pas ste/ /spros med yang dag de bzhin nyid/ /mnyam yangs phyogs bral kun tu brdal/ /ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gsal/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub de phyir rdo rje'i rang bzhin te/ /stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje dang / /kun tu snang ba'i rdo rje dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje dang / /snang stong sku yi rdo rje dang / /grag stong gsung gi rdo rje dang / /rig stong thugs kyi rdo rje
dang longs spyod mchod pa'i rdo rje dang / /rjes chags bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /zag med bdud rtsi'i rdo rje dang / /yon tan bstod pa'i rdo rje dang / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa thig le chen po 'gyur ba med/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /bcings grol med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sangs rgyas yang dag rgyud rigs pa'o/ /de ltar du ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba nyi shu la/ /grol gzhi dang ni grol ba la/ /khyad par dbye ba bdog gam med/ /ces smras de yi lan brjod pa/ /rgyal po khab kyi grong khyer gyi/ /bdag po khab du 'jug pa ltar/ /rang gi ye shes de nyid la/ /rang shes rig pa'i rgyal po ru/ /rang ngo shes na grol ba yin/ /de bzhin sbrul gyi bdud pa yang / /sbrul las byung te sbrul du grol/ /de bzhin rang rig ye shes te/ /rang ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis grol/ /de la phy-i nang gsang ba dang / /de kho na yi dbye ba yi/ /'bras bu'i sa ni mang po zhig /bcu drug nyid du shes par bya/ /mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dper na mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad/ /thal mo gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus/ /de na gnas pa'i nam mkha' de/ /thal mo phye bas slar yang ni/ /nam mkha' nyid du gnas pa las/ /gcig dang du ma'i dbye ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs so/ /zhes so/ de bzhin dri ba nyer gcig pa/ /gzhi la bdun du bshad pa
༄tsho/ /ni / / dngos btags khyad par ji lta bu/ /zhes dris lan ni mdor bsdu na/ /gzhi la spyi gzhi 'khrul gzhi dang / /grol gzhi gsum du bshad pa dang / /de las dbye ba bsam yas kyang / /thams cad blo yi khyad par te/ /dngos btags rang stobs shugs la gsal/ /bsdu na gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ /gcig pa nyid du brjod pa'ang yod/ /de dag rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gzhung lugs la/ /'dzangs pa'i blo yis dpyad las shes/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba nyer gnyis pa/ /lam la khregs chod thod rgal bzhi/ /bshad pa'i khrigs chod go don lags/ /zhes dris khregs chod thod rgal gnyis/ /de las brtsams pa'i bzhi zhes pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung rnams su/ /bdag gis mthong dang thos pa med/ /khregs chod dang ni snang bzhi la/ /thod rgal smra na lnga ru 'gyur/ /gnyis pa tshig mthar lags zhes pa/ /dri ba'i gzhi ru 'god rgyu la/ /bshad pa'i don du song ltar snang / /'on kyang kho bos legs brtags na/ /dri ba po yi don 'di la/ /kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rnams/ /rim gyis chod dam gcig char chod/ /med nas chod dam yod kyang chod/ /spang bya sbong byed yin nam min/ /khregs chod dang ni thod rgal la/ /khyad par dbye ba yod dam med/ /zhes dris lan du 'di ltar brjod/ /khregs chod ces pa sor bzhag te/ /ma bcos so ma rang dngas su/ /mnyam par bzhag
pa'i don yin la/ /thod rgal 'od gsal dri ma med/ /de nyid bla ma'i man ngag las/ /gnad kyis gcun nas rang byung gi /ye shes rang mdangs blta ba yin/ /kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rnams/ /mnyam bzhag dus su gcig char chod/ /skad cig gcig gis bye brag byed/ /ces sogs rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs/ /rjes thob rim gyis chod par 'dod/ /snang ba sgyu mar sbyangs pa'i tshe/ /rang bzhin don gyi chos sku la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang med mod kyang / /blangs dor 'khrul rtog gzung 'dzin rnams/ /lam pa'i blo la snang ba'i phyir/ /gzung 'dzin med na chod pa dang / /ma chod ces pa'i gdang gzhi bral/ /spang bya glo bur dri ma dang / /spong byed zhi lhag ting nge 'dzin/ /yin par rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs/ /khregs chod dang ni thod rgal la/ /lam skabs yin phyir dbye ba yod/ /de dag cung zad bshad pa na/ /rtog pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /mnyam bzhag chos bdun ngang du klod/ /de tshe gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes stong gsal 'dzin med 'char/ /de la sgom skyon dang bral na/ khregs chod lam gyi dam par 'dod/ /drod sogs ma thob bar du ni/ /rim can pa yi tshul du 'byung / /drod sogs thob nas cig char pa/ /'gyur pa nyid la the tshom med/ /thod rgal lhag mthong gtso che ste/ /lhag mthong chos nyid mngon sum yin/ /de nyid dang po'i sa pas ste/ /mnyam bzhag
༄tshi/ /sangs rgyas 'dra bar gnas/ /rjes thob snang ba sgyu mar 'char/ /de nas sgom lam mthong spang gi /rim pa brgyad cu brgyad la sogs/ /yon tan gcig mthong skyon gcig spangs/ /de lta'i rim pa rab phye ba/ /so so'i gzhung dang slob dpon gyi/ /dgongs pa du mas legs par bstan/ /de dag shes par 'dod pa yis/ /mngon pa rgyan sogs byams pa'i gzhung / /rgyas 'bring bsdus sogs mdo yi sde/ /khyad par rgyud sde bsam yas las/ /gsungs pa drang nges rab phye la/ /lung tshad mngon rjes sgro btags dang / /ming tshig sogs la shes par bya/ /gzhan yang gang zag dbang po yis/ /tshogs gnyis bsags dang ma bsags dang / /sgrub gnyis spang dang ma spangs kyis/ /dbye bas rim dang cig char du/ /nyams myong rgyud la skye ba dang / /myur bul brtan dang ma brtan dang / /rtags rim nyid du shes par bya/ /zhib tu dpyad par mi nus te/ /sems can grangs dang logs rtog grangs/ /theg pa'i grangs kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba nyer gsum pa/ /de nyid zung 'jug ji lta bu/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod do/ /de nyid ces bya don gcig de/ /tshig gi zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i skabs/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis dang / /de bzhin rtag dang chad pa gnyis/ /yul dang shes pa rnam gnyis dang / /spang bya gnyen po rnam gnyis dang / /snang dang stong pa rnams gnyis dang / /
de bzhin bde stong bden gnyis dang / /shes dang shes bya skye 'gags dang / /rang bzhin gnas rigs rgyas 'gyur gnyis/ /lam la theg pa che chung dang / /chos can chos nyid gzhal bya dang / /'jal byed lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gnyis/ /de sogs rnam grangs bsam yas pa/ /gnyis kyi zlas phyed gnyis med du/ /gnas lugs zung 'jug bsgrub pa yin/ /gcig nyid la ni zung ming bral/ /zung 'jug gnas lugs gang yin pa/ /gong gi dri ba nyid kyi skabs/ /legs par bshad mod smyon pa ltar/ /yang yang smra bas ñtsu zhig bya/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang dri ba nyer bzhi ni/ /khregs chod thod brgal go don ni/ /ma hā a nur gsungs ma gsungs/ /de dag shes byed ji ltar yin/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod kyi/ /dbang po rab la mtshan ldan pas/ /sman pa mkhas pas lag gi rtsa/ /legs par bltas pas lus kun gyi/ /spang gnyen nges par shes pa dang / /'bring la sman pa'i sman snod kyi/ /kha byang bltas pas sman shes ltar/ /don rnams legs par rtogs pa dang / /tha mas tshig re 'bru re la/ /brten nas rtogs pa'i thabs su bstan/ /de ni 'dir yang dri ba rnams/ /yang yang bskyar la dgos pa ci/ /don yod phyir na bcom ldan 'das/ /de la 'bor gyi sems dpa' yis/ /yang dang yang du zhu ba yin/ /'on kyang cung zad brjod pa na/ /khregs chod thod brgal go don ni/ /ma hā a nu las
༄ga/ /gzhan pa/ /rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kun las gsungs/ /de yang chos kyi ming ldan pa'i/ /ma hā a nu las gzhan pa'i/ /nges don ston pa'i mdo rnams su/ /yang yang gsungs pa ma gzigs kyang / /shes rab snying po'i mdo las kyang / /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos/ /ming tsam brda ru brtan nas kyang / /khregs chod la bzla nyid du gsungs/ /zab mo snang ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i don de ni/ /'od gsal mngon sum don du 'dod/ /des na theg pa bsam yas kyi/ /don kun de kho na nyid du/ /gsungs shing de yi don du 'bab/ /de ltar gsungs kyang so so yi/ /theg pa'i rim par rtogs pa ni/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis so/ /ston pa yang dag sangs rgyas kyis/ /rnam grol lam las phyir gyur pa'i/ /chos ni gsungs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags yul gyi/ /slob dpon pad+ma sam bha dang / /rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung las rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang dri ba nyer lnga pa/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes las/ /sems can 'gro don ji ltar 'byung / /zhes dris lan du 'di ltar brjod/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba zab mo yi/ /gtso bo'i tshul gyi sems dpa' 'khor/ /rgyal dang dgongs pa'i brda' yis
kyang sar gnas sems can grol bar mdzad/ /sprul sku ston pa bcu gnyis sogs/ /bsam yas zhing gi ston pas kyang / /bltams dang rab tu byung ba dang / /bdud kyi dpung 'joms chos 'khor bskor/ /mya ngan 'da' ba la sogs pa/ /gang brtsams 'gro ba'i don rnams 'byung / /de bzhin sngon gyi smon lam kyis/ /bden pa'i stobs las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje ri bo sman dang ni/ /bshes gnyen chu dang nyi ma dang / /'gro ba bzang ngan lam po che/ /sprin dang nor bu bkod ma'i chus/ /'gro ba'i don rnams byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba nyer drug pa/ ji snyed chos rnams sangs rgyas la/ /snang ngam mi snang ji ltar yin/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod do/ /bshad ma thag pa ji bzhin du/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ji snyed pa'i/ /snang ba cho 'phrul 'gyed tshul ni/ /theg dgu zhi khro bka' brgyad dang / /dus 'khor bde mchog dgyes rdor dang / /gsang 'dus ma hā ma ya dang / /'jigs byed dgra nag gdong drug dang / /gshed dmar 'khor chen gdan bzhi dang / /rdor dbyings rtse mo dpal mchog dang / /gtsug dgu chos dbyings gsung dbang dang / /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang rnam snang sgyu drwa mngon byang dang / /mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs/ /ji snyed sku dang 'khor tshogs dang / /'od dang chos 'phrul du ma snang / /de ltar theg pa chen po dang / /theg dman 'dul ba lung las
༄༅/ /kyang / / sprul sku sangs rgyas thub dbang gis/ /sprul pa'i nyan thos 'khor tshogs la/ /brda dang gsungs las byung ba yis/ /'od zer gtsug tor nas byung ste/ /'jig rten khams kun bkang nas kyang / /slar yang smyi gtsug mdzod spu dang / /thugs ka dpung mgo phyag zhabs mthil/ /bu ga gdan la thim pa sogs/ /sku yi cho 'phrul sna tshogs dang / /gsung gis gdul bya sna tshogs kyi/ /bsam pa cig char bskang ba dang / /thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo ni/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa ste/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa/ /thams cad thams cad lhun gyis grub/ 'di la rgyal ba'i ye shes ni/ /mnga' dang mi mnga' spyi 'dod pa/ /mthun dang mi mthun ji snyed pa/ mdo rgyud 'phags pa'i gang zag gi /lugs la sna tshogs snang mod kyang / /thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rgyal/ /o rgyan pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /'bras bu'i rnams bzhag mang gsungs pa/ /nyes pa gnyis zad sku ru smin/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa rgyas/ /rten can rten med ngo bo nyid/ /gcig dang du mar grags pa bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i gsungs la brten bya yi/ / smra ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba nyer bdun pa/ /gdul bya'i mig shes la snang ba'i/ /gzugs sku sangs rgyas yin ma min/ /zhes dris lan du 'di skad smra/ /gdul bya rab 'bring tha ma yi/ /so so'i skye bo'i mig shes dang / /ngo sprad gdams pa ma thob
pa'i sa rdo shing therdzog sku gzugs rnams/ /sangs rgyas yon tan phung po yi/ /gtsug tor mtshan dpe la sogs pa/ /dad pa'i rten gyi sangs rgyas tsam/ /yin gyi sangs rgyas dngos ma yin/ /'on kyang sman pa'i sprul sku ru re zhig brjod par byed pa yin/ /de dag smad par mi bya bar/ /skyabs su 'dzin pa'i sdom rten yin/ /de bzhin bshes gnyen dul ba dang / nyer zhi yon tan lhag bcas brtson/ /lung gis phyug pa'i dge 'dun yang rang gi slob dpon gyur pa na/ /bla ma mkhas pa zhes bya ste/ /tshogs lam pa yi sangs rgyas yin/ /drod dang rtse mo sbyor ba dang / /chos mchog thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi nyams myong ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /mthong lam dang po'i sa pa yi/ /sprul sku'i sangs rgyas tshogs mthong nas/ /de la chos rnams nyan par nus/ /de ni rang rig ye shes te/ /rang snang nyid la rang snang spyod/ /de bzhin sa bcu'i sems dpa' yis/ /rang snang longs spyod rdzogs sku la/ /sangs rgya sa nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /bcu gcig nas bzung bcu gnyis pa'i/ /phyed kyi bar ram bcu bzhi dang / /bco lnga bcu drug nyer gcig gi /mthar ma son gyi phyed yan la/ /gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po yis/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi sku nyid la/ /gnyis med tshul gyi chos rnams dang / /'od zer chen pe'i dbang bskur len/ /rtse mo sa phyed mthar son tshe/ /skyabs dang skyobs
༄tshi/ /pa gnyis med pa/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid yin/ /de la chos kyi sku zhes sam/ /de bzhin ngo bo nyid sku'o/ /mngon par byang chub sku ru 'dod/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu nyid du mngon byas pa'o/ /de ltar don gyi sangs rgyas la/ /dgongs nas rdo rje gcod pa las/ /gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yis/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid blta/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi/ /lung la brten te shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /slar yang dri ba nyer brgyad pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum po/ /lam snang yin nam 'bras snang yin/ /zhes dris lan du 'di ltar brjod/ /'di la spyir btang dmigs gsal gnyis/ /btags pa ba yi sku gsum dang / /yin tshul don gyi sku gsum mo/ /btags pa ba ni 'di lta ste/ /mthar thugs 'bras bu ma thob kyi/ /bar du gang zag blo ngo rtswa /byas pa'i chos sku longs sku dang / /sprul sku'i rnam pa ñtsu shar yang / /thad ka thad ga'i lam sgom pa'i/ /de yi 'bras bu snang ba yin/ /des na sangs rgyas sku gsum po/ /lam snang 'bras snang gnyis mthun par/ /smras kyang 'gal ba yod ma yin/ /ci phyir slob lam snang ba kun/ /lam gyi mthu las snang ba'i phyir/ /lam snang yin
gyi de dag kyang / /thad ka thad ga'i lam rim la/ /rnal 'byor byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /dmigs bsal pha rol phyin pa la/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa/ /thob tshe 'bras bu'i snang bar 'dod/ /rdo rdze theg pa'i lam la ni bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa/ /de bzhin bco lnga bcu drug dang / /nyer gcig pa rnams 'bras snang ste/ /lhag ma lam gyi snang bar 'dod/ /de bzhin snang ba gsum la yang / /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can las kyi snang ba dang / /rnal 'byor lam gyi snang ba dang / /'bras bu bde gsal snang ba dang / /dang po rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /lam la zhugs pa lam snang yin/ /dbye ba bya ru med pa ste/ /rnal 'byor gnyis kyi snang ba las/ /slob lam sku gsum lam snang yin/ /mi slob lam gyi snang ba ni/ /'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /slar yang dri ba nyer dgu pa/ /kun tu bzang po mu bzhi ka /kun tu bzang po yin nam min/ /zhes dris de lan 'di gdab po/ /mu bzhi la ni rnam pa mang / /de phyir skabs su gang bab pa'am/ /dri ba dmigs kyis bsal dgos kyang / /rdzas spyi'i dri ba byas pa la/ /lan du gang 'debs shes dka' yang / /spyir btang tsam zhig 'dir bshad kyi/ /rang rig kun tu bzang po dang / /mtshan gzhi kun tu bzang po dang / /mtshon byed kun tu bzang po dang / /chos sku kun tu bzang po ste/ /rnam
༄༅/ /grangs bzhi ru bshad pa'ang yod/ /de bzhin chos sku longs sku dang / /sprul sku ngo bo nyid sku ste/ /kun bzang bzhi ru dbye ba'ang yod/ /khyab gdal gzhi yi kun bzang dang / /smin byed dbang gi kun bzang dang / /grol byed thabs kyi kun bzang dang / /mthar thug 'bras bu'i kun bzang ste/ /rnam pa bzhi ru dbye ba'ang yod/ / phyi dbyings lha sku'i kun bzang dang / /nang rtsa yi ge'i kun bzang dang / / gsang ba byang sems kun bzang dang / /mthar thug ye shes kun bzang dang / /rnam pa bzhi ru dbye ba'ang yod/ /sku bzhir dbye ba'i kun bzang la/ /chos sku yin la lhag ma gsum/ /ma yin pa yi kun bzang dang / /de bzhin longs sku yin pa la sprul dang chos sogs ma yin dang / /sprul sku yin la gzhan min dang / /thams cad thams cad yin pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid kyi kun bzang dang / /mu bzhir dbye ba mang mod kyi/ /gnas lugs kun tu bzang po dang / /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po dang / /grol lugs kun tu bzang po dang / /'chi lugs kun tu bzang po'ang 'dod/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas kun bzang dang / /byang sems kun tu bzang po dang / /mthar thug dang ni thad ka yi kun tu bzang po yin pa las/ /gzhan du brjod pas : zhig bya/ /sa man bha tra'i sgra las kyang / /spyod yul kun tu bzang por bstan/ /des na kun tu bzang po zhes/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang shes par 'gyur/ /yin
lugs gshis kyi kun bzang ni/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun la/ /khyab gdal chen por bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba snying po'i rgyud las kyang / /spyod yul kun tu maṇ+ḍa la/ /zhes pa gsang ba dam pa'i lung / /du ma las kyang rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba sum cu pa/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs gnyis kyis bskyed pa'i/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas yod dam med/ /ces dris lan du 'di skad brjod/ /sngon du brjod pa ñtsu bzhin du/ /tshogs gnyis la ni ma brten zhing / /sgrib gnyis spang bya dang bral ba'i/ /sangs rgyas yod ces smra ba ni/ /gdod nas dag pa'i 'od gsal la/ /smras kyi rnam pa thams cad du/ /tshogs gnyis bsags dang sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags sa bon ma spangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ga la srid / /de dag rgyas par smra ci 'tshal/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung pa'i/ /dam pa gnyis sku thob par shog /ces gsungs pa dang rgyud sde las/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs bsod nams tshogs las ni/ /thub pa'i gzugs sku 'byung ba dang / /ye shes tshogs las chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin rgyud las lhun grub kyang / /mtha' yas yon tan du ma'i tshogs/ /gnas 'gyur du ni 'byung ba ste/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs sangs rgyas kyi/ /sa pon yin phyir mtshungs 'dra las/ /
༄tshi/ /gzhi 'bras dbyer med ces smra yi/ /sa pon 'dra ba gzhir bzhag na/ /'bras bu yon tan bsam yas pa/ /sgrib spangs tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /yin pa blo gros ldan pas rtogs/ /zhes so/ /slar yang dri ba so gcig pa/ /rang gi chos nyid mngon sum sogs/ /snang ba bzhi po nyams blangs pas/ /thob bya'i sku gsum yod dam med/ /yod na rang gzhan gang la yod/ /yang dag sangs rgyas yin nam min/ /med na nyams blangs dgos pa ci/ /de dag rgyu mtshan ci lta bu/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod do/ /rdzogs chen rang byung khas len pas/ /mkhas pa chen por 'dod pa 'gas/ /sngon yang 'di la dri mkhan mang / /kho bo dogs pa 'di ltar skyes/ /khyed sogs rdzogs pa chen po yis/ /grub mtha' 'dzin pa rnams la yang / /khas len tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /nyams len gzhan zhig yod dam med/ /min na de nyid dri mi rigs/ /'on kyang nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zab mo'i gnad 'di bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su ma bsags pa'i/ /don de rtogs pa nyid du dka'/ /thos bsam lta ba dug can dang / /cog bzhag dbu ma'i nyams len yang / /zab mor rgyal bas bsngags na yang / /thun min theg pa'i nyams len dang / /skal ldan bsod nams mchog rab la/ /rdo rje theg pa'i skal ba yod/ /dug med rang byung ye shes kyi/ /bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug dang / /ka
dag spros bral ro mnyam pa'i/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid/ /e waX zung 'jug gdams pa'i gnad/ /dngos grub len pa'i skal ba yod/ /de ltar bla med smin grol gyi/ /snying po las kyang snying po 'di/ /sor sdud bsam gtan srog stsol dang / /ting 'dzin rjes dran lam dang ni/ /dngos grub len pa'i skal ba yod/ /bsod nams yang rab gyur pa la/ /theg pa kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /skad cig gcig gis rtogs pa dang / /mthong zhing goms nas grol ba yi/ /snang ba bzhi yi nyams len yod/ /gdams pa'i gnad kyis gcun pa las/ /thob bya'i sku dang ye shes rnams/ /snang bzhi tshad du 'khyol ba'i tshe/ /lam nyid 'bras bur sangs rgyas so de yang thob bya'i 'bras bu ni/ /bla ma bsten zhing gdams pa'i gnad/ /gang gis nyams su blangs pa las/ /yod kyis gzhan la de ltar min/ /dper na 'jig rten zhing pa yin/ /las kyi bgos skal so so la/ /brten nas rang rang 'bras bu 'byung / /so nam ma byas zhing pa la/ /zhing yod gyur kyang 'bras bu med/ /de bzhin thob bya'i 'bras bu ni/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i ye shes la/ /nan tan byed pa rgyu mtshan yin/ /bden bzhi'i ming btags la sogs pa/ /bdag med phyed dang gnyis bsgoms pas/ /ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs bcom nas/ /dgra bcom thob par lung las gsungs/ /des na dbu ma sgro
༄tsho/ /'dogs bcad/ /mtha' bral nyid du mnyam bzhag pas/ /sangs rgyas thob pa cis mi bzang / /de nas kyang ni gsang sngags kyi/ /smin grol lam la goms byas pas/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes sku/ /'di 'am 'chi kha bar do dang / /brtson pa lhod par gyur na yang / /dam tshig dag la skyon med na/ /skyes ba gcig gsum bdun dag la/ /'grub par rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /byang chub 'grub pa'i mngon rtogs ni/ /nyi ma phyed la mthong bar 'gyur/ /de la mngon rtogs ma mthong na/ /rdzun tshig yin zhes dam bca' mdzad/ /de bas snang bzhi thob pa na/ /'khor ba ming tsam mi grags cing / /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i mthar thug la/ /sgom med bltas pas grol ba yin/ /dngos med snang ba mthong ba dang / /'od smin pa dang ye shes smin/ /rig pa smin pas grol bar 'gyur/ /'di dag lung las mang du gsungs/ /paṇa chen bī ma mi tra yis/ /don du bsdus te bka' stsal pa/ /lug rgyud rtag tu 'dris par bya/ /mthong thos 'khor ba phyir bsnyil te/ /sangs rgyas sa la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs don gyi mthar thug go /zhes so/ /gzhan yang dri ba so gnyis pa/ /bod yul kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /theg pa rim dgu'i rnam bshad dang / /khyad par a ti yo ga yi/ /lam srol zab khyad 'byed pa la/ /mkhas grub mang du
byon gyur kyang / /'gran zla kun dang bral ba yi/ /sprul sku klong chen rab 'byams dang / /kaXthog shākya rdo rje zhes/ /nyi zla lta bur grags pa yi/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i chos lugs la/ /shes brjod tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshe/ /shing rta'i lam srol so sor phyes/ /de yang sprul sku klong chen pas/ /don dam smra bsam brjod bral yang / /kun rdzob yul dang yul can rnams/ /snang tsam nyid nas ma grub ste/ /dper na rmi lam snang ba bzhin/ /des na kun rdzob 'khrul snang rnams/ /dbyings dang rang byung ye shes min/ /de phyir nyon mongs ye shes min/ /khams gsum sems can sangs rgyas min/ /sems kyang rig pa ma yin zhing / /snang ba rang sems min no zhes/ /lung rigs mang pos bsgrub mdzad de/ /zhes dris de yi lan brjod pa/ /don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo bral chos sku'i ngo bor brjod/ /de la ye shes rgyal khams zhes/ /dam pa dang po'i lugs la'ang grags/ /kun rdzob yul dang yul can rnams/ /rmi lam dus kyi longs spyod bzhin/ /sad pa'i yul na mi gnas par/ /'jigs pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ /blo yi yul du byas pa ste/ /kun rdzob phyir na blo 'das min/ /de la rnam shes rgyal khams zhes/ /dus kyi 'bor le'i bzhed pa yin/ /chos dbyings skye ba med pa dang / /rang byung ye shes 'od gsal ba/ /zung 'jug dri med yin pa'i phyir/ /nyon mongs yin na ye shes min/ /rang bzhin gnas
༄༅/ /rigs kyis khyab pa'i/ /sa bon tsam la dgongs nas ni/ /yin zhes gsungs pa'i skabs yod kyi/ /khams gsum sems can yin pa na/ /rnam grol sangs rgyas yin pa 'gal/ /sems ni bag chags rang bzhin te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dpyad pa na/ /bag chags dri ma zad pa'i mthar/ /rig pa mngon sum snang ba yin/ /des na rnam shes ye shes dag /bsres nas gsungs pa'i skabs mang yang / /sems dang rig pa rab phye ba'i/ /bcu bdun rgyud sogs man ngag gi /dgongs pa yin phyir 'dir bshad la/ /man ngag sde yi dgongs pa yin/ /de phyir dgongs pa zang thal sogs/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud sde dang / /be+e ro tsa na'i snyan rgyud kyi/ /dgongs pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /lugs dang mthun par bzhed pa yin/ /snang ba rang sems yin pa dang / /min pa'i dbye ba mang mod kyi/ /'khrul snang rang sems yin pa dang / /grol snang rig pa chos sku gnyis sems dang rig pa phye bas rtogs/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang dri ba so gsum pa/ /kaXthog shākya rdo rje ni/ /snang srid 'bor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang byung ye shes rang snang yin/ /khams gsum sems can sangs rgyas yin/ /sdug bsngal bde ba chen po yin/ /'khor ba myang ngan 'das pa yin/ /mdor na 'bor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang byung ye shes yin par ni/ /lung rigs mang pos bsgrubs mdzad de/ /de ltar skyes
chen de gnyis kyi/ /dgongs bzhed so sor snang ba la/ /mthun nam 'gal ba ji ltar yin/ /zhes dris lan du 'di lta ste/ kun byed rgyal po la sogs pa/ zab mo'i rgyud sde mang po dang / /ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo nang las/ /khams gsum srid gsum 'khor ba dang / /myang 'das lam gyi chos rnams dang / /thams cad sems snang nyid du gsungs/ /de ni khams gsum po 'di dag /sems tsam yin zhes gsungs pa dang / /de bzhin sa yi sde snod las/ /snang ba sems su sgrub pa'i gzhung / /mang du gsungs shing bir wa pas/ /lam gyi 'khor 'das dbyer med du/ /chos kun sems nyid snang ba zhes/ /de bzhin gzugs can yin phyir dang / /de kho na nyid rgya mtsho yi/ /don dang ma bral pa yi don/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel du/ /snang ba sems su sgrub pa la/ /rtsa ba'i dpe ni bzhi bzhi brgyad sgyu ma rten 'brel nyid bsgrub phyir/ /swa lu ljang pa'i mdo sogs kyi/ /lung gi dgongs pa dpe brgyad dang / /rten 'brel de yang brjod bral du/ /sgrub pa'i thabs la dpe brgyad bstan/ /de bzhin rdzi bo ras pa la rje btsun mi la des gsungs pa/ /snang ba sems su 'dus par gda'/ /sems nyid gsal ba'i ngo por gda'/ /de la ngos bzung med par gda'/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas mthar thug tu/ /brjod bral bsam
༄tshi/ /dang bral bar bstan/ /de bzhin gcer sgom rdzongs pa dang / /grub thob smyon pa don ldan sogs/ /skyes chen 'ga' yi dgongs pa ni/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /snang srid 'khor 'das cir snang yang snang ba nyid na de dang de'i/ /chos nyid gcig dang du bral te/ /so sor rang rig rang dag yin/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs mod kyi/ /thams cad rten 'brel rang snang yin/ /de ltar gsungs pa ci bzhin du/ /nyon mongs sprin dang 'dra ba la/ /rten 'brel gyis ni rang bzhin gang / /dngos po med la dngos po'i sprin/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'byung zhing 'gyur/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /rang bzhin ye shes kun khyab yin/ /de bzhin khams gsum sems can gyi/ /rang bzhin gdod nas gzhi rtsa bral/ /de nyid la ni sangs rgyas zhes/ /smras kyi sdug bsngal rang bzhin yang / /bde chen chos sku'i ngo bor bzhugs 'khor ba rmi lam 'dra ba la/ /myang 'das rang bzhin med pa yin/ /de lta bu yi don la dgongs/ /yum chen sprul pa'i zhal nas kyang / /'khor ba spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /myang 'das 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas ma rnyed nyon re mongs/ /sdug bsngal spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /bde ba 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas ma rnyed nyon re mongs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don rnams kyang / /'bor pa'i chos kun rang rang gi /
rang byung ye shes rang snang phyir/ /ka ba'i chos nyid de dang ni/ /bum pa'i chos nyid gcig yin zhes/ /brjod pa du ni mi mdzad kyi/ /ka ba bum pa'i chos nyid ni/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /chos nyid du ni mtshungs pa'o de ltar skyes chen rnam gnyis kyi/ /dgongs pa 'gal ba ltar snang yang / /don la 'gal 'dus skyon med de/ /rgyud don brjod bya so so yang / /dri med mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi/ /nyams myong dag la dbye ba med/ /mthar thug mngon sum mthong ba yi/ /lhag mthong don la gnyis su med/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin dri ba so gzhi pa/ /mthun na de yi shes byed gang / /'gal na cig shos cig shos rdzun/ /de yi ngos 'dzin ji ltar yin/ /kha cig snang srida'akhor 'das chos/ /rtogs na rang byung ye shes yin/ /ma rtogs 'khrul snang yin zhes gsungs/ /de yang ji ltar 'thad lags sam/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod do/ /mthun dang mi mthun gong du bstan/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs ye shes dang / /'khrul snang yin par lung gis gsal/ /rang byung ye shes ngo 'phrod na/ /grol bar 'gyur pa rgyud las gsungs/ /rang gi rang 'od las gzhan du/ /'khrul nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa las/ /rgyas bshad gzhan zhig brjod mi 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /slar yang dri ba so lnga pa / /de ltar bzhed lugs gsum po ni/ /rdzogs chen rang gzhung gang dang mthun/ /zhes dris lan du 'di brjod do/ /'khor 'das
༄tshi/ /chos kun sems su thag bcad nas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ma bcos sor bzhag pa/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes rig pa byang chub sems/ /yin tshul cir yang yin par ma shes la/ /snang tshul cir yang yin par ma yin pas/ /snang tshad rang rang so se'i snang ba ste/ /rang grol don la mnyam bzhag rjes thob ldan/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems sde'i dgongs pa yin/ /don dam chos dbyings sgro 'dogs bral ba'i klong / /ma 'gag rang gsal 'dzin med rig pa'i sku/ /rnam thar sgo gsum yangs pa'i bha ga rtswa /rtsa rlung thig le bde chen rol pa'i nyams/ /so ma rang mdangs lhug par skyong byed pa/ theg brgyad ma 'dris a tir lhun gyis grub/ /chos bdun ngang nas gsal stong 'dzin med bya/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos skur thag chod pa/ /klong dgu bam po nyis khri'i dgongs pa yin/ /ka dag lhun grub lam gyis gzhir bcas nas/ /ru shan gsum phye snang bzhi'i rim pa yis/ /sems kyi na bun rig pa'i nam mkhar dengs/ /dngas pa'i mtsho la gza' skar bkra ba ltar/ /'ja' 'od thig le sku dang zhing khams kyi/ /mngon sum snang ba gong 'phel tshad du phebs/ /theg pa bya ba byed rgyu'i chos zad cing / /blo bral mthar thug 'od gsal mngon du gyur/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob pa ni/ /a ti'i mthar thug man ngag dgongs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /dri ba'i mthar thug pa yi gtam brjod pa/ /de
ltar a ti'i 'dzin ma las 'khrungs pa'i/ /'grel gtam dri yig ngo mtshar kun+da'i tshal/ /phan bde'i dri bsung ci yang 'phro ba 'di/ /phrin las 'od dkar lha yi zla bas phye/ /zhes bya ba 'di rang gi dri ba la ngo mtshar skyes pa'i gtam mo/ /yang dri ba pos/ 'di ni kun slong chags dang sdang bas min/ /rnyed dang grags pa'i phyir du'ang 'di ma smras/ /khengs sems co 'dri'i slad du'ang 'di ma brtsams/ /theg mchog dgongs don rtogs phyir 'di sbyar ro/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di smras pa/ kye ho/ 'jig rten gnas la chags pa'i skye bo dag /tshor ba bde sdug dag la dri zhing rtsod/ /lam zhugs rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /lam gyi bye brag dag la dri bar mdzad/ /de ni nyon mongs pa dang bral yin no/ /zhes so/ /theg mchog dgongs don rtogs phyir dri ba ni/ /zol gyis gzhan rgyud rtogs pa'i skyon med na/ /dri ba po la rjes su yi rang phul/ /'on kyang theg mchog dgongs pa tshul bzhin du/ /rtogs par 'dod na rgyal ba'i bka' lung dang / /mthun par spyod pa'i bshes gnyen zhabs pad la/ /tshul bzhin brten nas bdag gzhan don ched du/ /gus pa'i sems kyis mnyes pa'i yon sbyar te/ /dbang rgyud man ngag dgongs pa lon pa dang / /tshul bzhin bsgoms nas rtogs shing grol ba dang / /rig pa'i tshul gyis gzhan la phan pa yi/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis 'gro kun bde gyur pa'i/ /zag med
༄༅/ /sbyin pa'i yon tan 'phel bar 'tshal/ /sngon du smras shing 'dir yang bzlos pa ni/ /sngon byung ston pa'i rnam 'gyur ji bzhin dang / /bar du rgya bod lo paṇa skyes mchog gis/ /dam chos skyong ba'i lung bzhin mdzad 'tshal lo/ /zab mo'i gnad la srang mdo'i glu bro ltar/ /dri bar byed dang de yi gnas ston pa/ /chos la byang ba'i lag len ma yin phyir/ /dam pa'i brgyud pa'i lag len nod 'tshal lo/ /zhes smras so/ /yang dri ba pos kun bzang dgongs pa'i rin chen gter mdzod nas/ /a ti'i dga' ston dpag yas sbyin 'dod pa/ /theg mchog 'phrul gyi sgo mo 'byed byed pa'i/ /legs bshad lde mig 'di la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces pa'i lan du cung zad smra yis gson/ /g.yo can gzhan gyi tshod la bgam bya'i phyir/ /zol gyis dris pa'i phyogs gtam ma yin nam/ /ci phyir bdag gis gong du brjod pa'i tshig /de dang 'dir ni mthun par ma gyur tam/ /rang gis shes nas gzhan la ston 'dod na/ /legs bshad lde mig gzhan la spro mi 'tshal/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i gter mdzod zin gyur na/ /khengs sems co 'dri'i slad du ma brtsams shing / /theg mchog dgongs don rtogs phyir dri mi dgos/ /des na g.yo can gtam gyis pha rol gyi/ /blo gros rtogs phyir gal te brtsams pa na/ /khyed ni gyi na tsam du ma gyur tam/ /zhes so/ /yang dri ba pos smras pa/ /'di bris rnam dkar dge ba
gang mchis des/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa mchog /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /'gro rnams gdod ma'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces smon lam du bgyis pa legs pa ste/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i don ltar mkha' mnyam sems can gyis rtsod bral rang byung rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /tshul bzhin rtogs nas sgrub pa mthar phyin te/ /gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyid dang dbyer med shog /ces pa 'di ni o rgyan pad+ma yi/ /rjes 'brang rig 'dzin las 'phro gling pa zhes/ /gang des dris pa'i gsungs bzhin mnga' ris pa/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gang des myur bar sgrags mda'i rdzong du bris/ /'di la khong khro la sogs spangs nas ni/ /tshul bzhin brtags na phan pa'i gtam du yod/ /de ltar yin kyang rtsod pa'i dus 'di rtswa /thub pas legs par gsungs yang mu stegs kyis/ /smad pa mthong nas sgro bskur byas pa ltar/ /kho bos legs par smras kyang rang skyon gyis/ sgro bskur phyogs 'dzin nyid du 'gyur dogs kyang / /nan gyis bskul ba'i ngo bor bzung tho yis/ /drang po'i tshig tu ngo 'dzin spangs nas smras/ /go byi ba'i lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu la mgyogs par bris nas nongs pa thams
༄7/ /cad 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings su bshags so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
༄tsho/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi cha lag sdom pa gsum rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /na mo gu ra we/ dpal ldan tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od dkar nges gsang gru char 'bebs/ /gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan mchog /mtsho skyes rdo rje 'gro ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /'gro blo'i dri ma 'khrud mkhas drang srong gis/ /blo gros be+e ḍū'i bum bzang rab thogs nas/ /legs bshad sdom gsum bdud rtsi'i chu sbyin gyi/ /don gnyer skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shog /rdzogs pa chen po ye shes spyi yi gzugs/ /yongs su dag sku rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /'bras bu'i mthar thug sangs rgyas nyag gcig de/ /zab rgyas chos kyi sgo 'phar bgrang yas kyang / /gsang chen smin grol lam mchog ma bsten par/ /thob pa min zhes rdzogs sangs rgyas des gsungs/ /ji srid sems kyi 'jug pa ma zad bar/ /bsam yas theg pa'i grangs mthar thug pa med/ /bgrod
༄tshi/ /gcig lam la bkri ba'i ngal stegs te/ /rang rang rjes mthun 'bras bu bla dang bcas/ / thob kyang theg pa so so'i nges 'byung las/ /theg gcig lam la ma zhugs 'bras thob ci/ /'dir ni rdzogs pa chen po'i ring lugs ltar/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' la/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa gsum zhes gsungs/ /kṛ ya u pa yo ga phy-i rgyud gsum/ /bla med pha rgyud ma hā yo ga dang / /ma rgyud a nu yo gar grags pa dang / /gnyis med rgyud sde a ti yo ga la/ /nang rgyud gsum zhes theg pa rim dgur bsdu/ /nyan rang byang sems rigs can so so la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam zhugs yod do zhes//'bum lnga'i rgyud kyi lung las gsal bar grub/ /bsam pa'i dbye bas sngags la 'jug pa'i tshul/ /chos sgo mang yang de dag spro bya min/ /'dir ni dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum las/ /rab mchog sbyangs pa
mthar son skal ldan te/ /dbang bskur thob pas sdom gsum cig car skyes/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam in+t+ra bhā ti bzhin/ /'bring ni sdom gsum so so'i cho ga la/ /brten nas rim thob nā ga rdzu na ltar/ /tha ma skal dman shin tu gdul dka' de/ /gso sbyong bslab pa'i gnas bcu grub mtha' bzhi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud nun rim shes nas/ /bla med 'jug pa brtag pa gnyis par gsungs/ /'dir ni dbang po 'bring gi tshul 'chad de/ /dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen sdom ldan de/ /rdo rdze 'dzin pa'i rab 'bring tha yin zhes/ /phur pa'i rgyud dang dus 'bor las gsungs shing / /'on kyang ye shes ldan pa gtso bor bzung / /snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i rtsa ba kun 'dus las/ /rang dang gzhan don phan pa che bshad pa/ /so thar sems bskyed dbang bskur nyid yin te/ /so sor 'dzin na nyan thos byang sems dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes su mkhas la grags/ /de ltar thun mong sdom pa 'og ma gnyis/ /'dir ni bla med dbang gi yan lag tu/ /rgyud sde rgya mtshor bshad ltar 'dir 'chad do/ /sdom gsum so sor khog dbub gleng gzhi dang / /dang po sdom pa ma thob thob pa'i tshul/ /bar du thob pa mi nyams bsrung ba'i thabs/ /tha ma nyams na gso tshul bzhi res sdom/ /sdom gsum spyi'i bshad gzhi'i rim par phye ba ste dang po'o// // mya/ gleng gzhi ston pas wā ra ṇā si rtswa /lhag pa'i tshul khrims gtsor ston bden
༄༅/ /pa bzhi/ /lnga sder gsungs pa 'od srung sogs kyis bsdus/ /bye brag bshad mdzod la sogs 'phags pas brtsams/ /yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od kyis spel/ /snga 'gyur sdom rgyun zhi ba 'tsho dang ni/ /phyis nas shākya shrī las kyang dar/ /ngo bo nges 'byung bsam pas kun bslangs nas/ /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas ldog pa lus ngag las/ /skye phyir gzugs can yin zhes 'dod pa dang / /spong sems rgyun chags sa bon la 'dod pa/ /rang gi sde pa gong 'og so so'i lugs/ /dbye na bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis/ khyim pa'i phyogs yin dge tshul pha ma dang / /dge slob ma dang dge slong pha ma lnga// rab byung la yin so thar rigs brgyad po/ /rdzas su bsdu na bzhir 'dod mdzod kyi lugs/ /dang po sdom pa ma thob thob tshul la/ /len tshul gnyis te sngon gyi cho ga ni/ /rang byung ye shes khong chud 'phrin gyis rdzogs/ /ston par khas blangs tshur shog gsol bzhi dang / /dris pa'i lan ldon lci chos khas blangs sogs/ /gdul bya blo dag mkhan po 'phags pas yin/ /da lta'i cho ga nges pa lnga bral zhing / /ma ning la sogs skye bar bar chad dang / /rgyal pos ma gnang la sogs gnas pa dang bya rog skrod mi nus sogs khyad par dang / /skra ser can sogs mdzes pa'i bar chad med/ /nges 'byung blo can skal bzang skyes bu de/ /legs gsung 'dul ba rgya mtsho mtha' dag dang / /brgya rtsa gcig pa'i las
phran la byang ba'i/ /mkhan por bcas pas rim bzhin bsnyen par rdzogs/ /snga ma ma byas rdzogs pa'ang mdo sder snang / /thob mtshams brjod pa gsum gyi mtha' mar 'dod/ /bar du thob pa mi nyams bsrung ba la/ /bslab bya skyabs 'gro thun mong min gsum ni/ /skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol sems can 'tshe ba spong / /mu stegs mi 'grogs so sor gus skyed do/ /srog dang bya dgar dkon cog gsum mi spong / /dgos gal che yang thabs gzhan mi 'tshol zhing / /dus mchod mi bcag rang gzhan skyabs 'gror 'god/ /gar 'gro'i phyogs kyi sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /lnga rnams thun mong bslab byar jo bos bzhed/ /rtsa bzhi sbong ba tshul khrims yan lag bzhi chang spang bag yod yan lag mal che mtho/ /gar phreng la sogs phy-i dro'i kha zas gsum/ /brtul zhugs yan lag bsnyen gnas sdom pa yin/ /yan lag 'di brgyad gtan du ma yin pas/ /yon tan rten min de phyir so thar ni/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa rigs bdun kho na yin/ /'di brgyad ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar bsrungs na/ /go mi'i dge bsnyen yin kyang yod smra'i min/ /gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs su dbyig gnyen bzhed/ /gsod rku brdzun smra 'dod pas log par g.yem/ /myos 'gyur spang rnams dge bsnyen sdom pa ste/ /gang 'dod khas len grangs ltar sna gcig spyod/ /sna 'ga' phal cher spyod dang yongs rdzogs spyod/ /gcig gnyis gsum dang
༄tshi/ /lnga spong de yi steng / /mi tshangs spyod spong tshangs spyod dge bsnyen no/ /'di dang go mi gnyis ni khyim pa dang / /rab byung gnyis ka min zhes mkhas rnams bzhed/ /mi dge lhag drug phyogs mthun spang bya dang / /dge bsnyen sdom ldan rig pa 'dzin pas kyang / /rab byung rtags dang cho ga ma gtogs pa/ /lhag rnams nyams su len pa dpung bzang bshad/ /srog gcod rku dang mi tshangs spyod dang rdzun/ /chang 'thung gar sogs phreng sogs mal che mtho/ /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul spong ba ste/ /zhus pa spong phyir rags pa bcur dril gsungs/ /chos gos lhung bzed 'chang ba 'bral ba dang / /sa rko rin chen reg dang me la reg /btang nas za dang shing 'dzegs shing gcod dang / /byin len rtswa sngon khrod du mi gtsang 'dor/ /gsog 'jog za dang sa bon 'joms pa rnams/ /gnang bas nyes med bcu gsum ma gtogs pa/ /dge slong ji bzhin spang blang mtha' dag gcig / 'chang ba'i zlar bsdu gos rgyu zla bar 'jog /'bral ba'i zlar bsdu dgon pa'i 'bral spang byed/ /gsog 'jog zlar bsdu gsog 'jog byed pa'ang gnang / khyim rtags spong nyams rab byung rtags len nyams//brnyas pas mkhan por nyams te nyams pa gsum/ /spang ba dge tshul sdom pa'i bslab bya'o/ /dge slob ma ni dge tshul thob pa'i steng / /gcig 'gro chur rkyal skyes reg lhan cig 'dug /smyan bya nyes 'chab rtsa
ba'i chos drug go /gser bzung 'doms spu 'dreg dang sa rko spang / /byin len med dang gsog 'jog byas mi za/ /rtswa sngon mi gcod 'di rnams rjes mthun drug /dge slong khrims la nyis brgya lnga bcu gsum// sdom pa'i rtsa ba pham pa bzhi zhes pa/ /gzhi yi yan lag cha kun gzung 'os pa/ /skye gnas lam du pho dbang las rung ni/ /bsam pa ngo tsha 'jigs med chags sems kyis/ /sbyor ba drud pa mthar thug sim pa thob/ /des ni tshangs par spyod las rnam par nyams/ /brku ba'i gzhi ni mi g.yin nor yin pa/ /bsam pa rang nyid 'tsho phyir brku sems kyis/ /yul dus rin thang tshang ba sbyor ba brkus/ /mthar thug brkus sam rkur bcug rtsad nas thob / / srog gcod gzhi ni mi gzhan ma 'khrul bar/ /bsam pa gsod sems gsod bya der shes pa/ /sbyor ba gsod par brtsams nas ma phyog pa/ /mthar thug srog gi dbang po 'gags pa dang //gsod bcug yi rang bsngags sogs rkyen byas kyang / /rdzun gyi gzhi ni smra shes don go'i mir/ /bsam pa 'du shes bsgyur nas brjod blo skyes/ /sbyor ba mngon shes la sogs yon tan tshogs/ /med kyang yod ces bla ma'i rdzun smras pa/ /mthar thug gzhan gyis rdzun de go na nyams/ /'di bzhi gang spyad dge slong de pham phyir/ /phas pham bzhi zhes thams cad mkhyen des gsungs/ /dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum zhes grags pa/ /bgrod min gnas su khu
༄tshi/ /ba 'byin pa dang / /chags pas bud med lus kyi cha shas 'dzin/ /'khrig tshig rjen smra bud med chags phyir bkur/ /pho mo phan tshun smyan byas 'dus te 'phrad/ /rang don tshad lhag khang pa khang chen brtsegs/ /brjod gzhi med dang snyad ka bag tsam la/ /brten nas dge slong skur btab dge 'dun dbyen/ /dbyen de'i rjes phyogs bslab pa dang 'gal ba/ /khyim sun 'byin tshe skrod byed la bsnyon pa/ /ltung byung bskul che bka' blo mi bde ba'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu'i sde bshad pa/ /rang gi gos lhag zhag bcu 'das bar 'chad/ /chos gos dang bral zhag gcig lon pa dang / /gos rgyu zla gcig 'jog dang dge slong mar/ /chos gos 'khrur 'jug de las gos rgyu len/ /nye min khyim par gos rgyu slong ba dang / /ster na stod g.yogs smad g.yogs lhag por len// rang la ster bsam chos gos gnas dpags pa/ /rin dang khru tshad kyis slong brtags dran slong gos rin rin chen bskur ba len rnams so/ /srin bal nang tshang byas pa'i stan byed dang / /dkon sar bal nag 'ba' zhig stan du 'dings/ /bal nag cha gnyis stan byed lo drug ni/ /ma song stan gsar byed dang tshad ldan gyi/ /'ding ba yod kyang slar bzo bal nag ni/ /rnyed nas lam gyi dpag tshad gsum mthar byed/ /dge slong mar ni bal 'khru rmel bcug dang / /gser dngul len dang tshong bun mngon tshan can/ /ched du
tshong byed lhung bzed byin ma brlabs/ /zhag bcu 'das 'chang lhung bzed zung 'chang ba/ /gla rngan med par 'thag 'jug thag rgya bskyed/ /dge slong gos byin slar phrogs brtad byung gos/ /sbyin dus bshad las snga bar bdag gir byas/ /dgon par 'jigs bcas gos bral zhag bdun 'das/ /ras chen dgag dbye zin kyang zla phyed 'das/ /dge 'dun bsngos pa'i rnyed pa bdag tu bzung/ /na sman zhag bdun 'das na gsog 'jog go / ltung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu tham pa ni/ /shes bzhin rdzun smra dge slong skyon brjod pa/ /phra mas 'byed dang skyo sngogs bzlums kyang dbye/ /bud med chos ston bsnyen par ma rdzogs dang / /lhan cig chos 'don gnas ngan len ltung brjod/ /mi chos bla ma bden smra bshes ngor 'phya//bslab gzhi khyad gsod sa bon skye ba gcod/ /bdag gi ngor 'phya bsgo ba rnar gzon ni/ /ltung byung gleng la ma thos lan gzhan 'debs/ khri dang 'ding ba ma bsdus bting song dang / /dge slong skrod dang mtho mtshams phyis gnon byas/ /mal khris bug dbyung srog chags ldan pa'i chu/ /rtswar 'debs gtsug lag pha gu rim gnyis brtsigs/ /shes bzhin gyis so 'di man dge slong mar/ /ma bskos chos ston bskos kyang nyi nub dang / kha zas phyir ston gos btsems chos gos sbyin/ /don mthun lam 'grogs gru de gyen thur 'gro/ /dben par gcig 'jug pa dang 'greng ba dang / /sbyor
༄tshi/ /bcug zas za rnams ni spang bar bya/ /yang yang zas za mu stegs 'dug pa'i sar/ /zhag gcig lhag bsdad za dang lhung bzed do/ /za dang zos rjes bza' bca' za ba dang // spang zas ltung 'byung ched du rdzun gyis bstab/ /gnang min mtshams nang logs su 'dus nas za/ /dus min phyed yol za dang gsog 'jog za/ /sbyin len ma byas sman bzhi khar mid pa/ /bsod pa zhim pa'i zas blang srog chags bcas/ /chur sbyor nyal po byed pa'i shul du nyal/ /dben pa'i skyibs su 'greng dang gcer bur rgyu/ /dmag lta dmag sar zhag gnyis lhag pa bsdad/ /dmag gi ru bkod byed dang dge slong brdeg /brdeg brtsams gnas ngan len gyi ltung ba 'chab/ /dge slong zas gcod me la reg tu bcug /dge 'dun las la 'dun phul phyir ldog smra/ /bsnyen ma rdzogs dang nub gnyis lhag par nyal/ /sdig lta'i chos lugs mi gtong phebs par smra/ /dge tshul sdig lta mi gtong lhan cig nyal/ /rung ba'i tshon min kha dog can gos gyon/ /rin chen dmag chas rol mo'i chas la reg /tsha dus rang gar khrus byed dud 'gro gsod/ /dge slong byas la 'gyod skye dgag tshil rgog/ chur rtse bud med gnas gcig nyal ba dang / /dge slong dngangs byed de yi yo byad sbed/ /sngar byin gding med slar blangs spyod pa dang / /gzhi med skur btab bud med lhan cig tu/ /skyes pa med par lam 'gro rkun ma'ang
mtshungs nyi shu ma lon pa la bsnyen rdzogs phog /sa brko mgron pos zla bzhi lhag par zos/ /mi shes brjod dang 'thab pa'i nyan rna byed/ /nyes med mi smra 'gro dang mi gus 'gal/ /chang 'thung dus min phyi dro grong du rgyu zas bcas phyi dro rgyu dang khyim gsum 'das/ /rgyal pos btsun mor rtse ba'i khab tu nyal/ /mdo sogs 'don la da gdod shes zer dang / /rin chen khab ral khri rkang tshad lhag bzos/ /ngan sems shing bal khri steng brdal te bgos// gding g.yan ras chen chos gos tshad lhag go /so sor bshags bya'i sde ni bzhi yin te/ /dge slong ma las grong du zas blangs zos/ khyim du dge slong mas bsgos ma zlog zos/ /bslab sdom sbyin las rung min blangs te zos/ /nags ma myul bar dgon par blangs zos bzhi'o/ /nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis zhes grags pa/ /sham thab zlum min brtsengs 'jol glang sna 'dra/ /bltab dang phur ma gdengs ka lta bu bdun zlum min ring thung stod gsum gos kyi bcu'o/ /ma bsdams bgo ba ca co mig g.yengs dang / /ring blta mgo bstums gos brdzes phrag la gzar/ /lag pa gnya' gong bsnol dang ltag par bsnol/ /mchong rgyang rkang pa'i brang dang rting btsugs 'gro/ /lag pa dkur brten lus bsgyur lag pa g.yug /mgo bsgyur phrag pa sprad dang lag sbrel rnams/ /mi byed khyim 'gro'i spyod pa nyi shu'o/ /bstan la ma bsgos ma brtags
༄༅/ /'phongs brdeb dang / /rkang brkyangs bsnol dang brla bsnol long bu brtsegs/ khri 'og rkang dgug rkang pa gdangs te 'dug /'doms mthong rnams spang 'dug tshul dgu yin no/ /legs par mi len mu kha mnyam par len/ /mthar chags mi len lhung bzed zur mig blta/ /bzed sngas sngar byung sbas nas bzed pa dang / /snod gzhan steng bzed spang ba zas bslangs brgyad/ /'gal za kham che chung dang ran par min/ /kha gdangs za bzhin smra dang tsug tsug dang / /cag cag hu hu phu phu lte phyung za/ /'bru nas gud phye zas la skyon 'phya dang / kham gcig mkhur sbo rkan tog kham 'phro bcad/ /lag pa ldag 'byog lag sprug skyom skyom byed/ /mchod rten 'drar byed nyer gcig za tshe spang / /lhung bzed la 'phya phyir lta lag pa ni/ /zas 'bag chu snod mi reg chu mi gtor/ /ma dris 'bag chu 'pho dang zas lhag bzhag/ sa rjen gad kha ri gzar bang rim bzhir/ /mi bzhag gad g.yang rkan gzar du mi 'khru/ /langs dang chu drag mi bcu bcu bzhi'o/ /chos ston sde ni langs nyal rang dmar 'dug /mdun nas 'gro la phyi bshad lam po'i 'gram/ /mgo g.yogs brdzes gzar lag pa gnya' ltag bsnol/ /do ker bcings dang zhwa gyon cod pan btags/ /'phreng ba dang ni mgo dkris glang rta zhon/ khyogs dang bzhon pa mchil lham gyon pa dang / /mkhar ba gdugs mtshon ral gri dgra cha mda'/ /go cha
gyon la mi bshad nyer drug go /bsgrub tshul gsum ni 'greng ste bshang gci 'dor/ /chu dang rtswa la bshang gci snabs mi 'dor/ /shing la mi gang mthor 'dzeg rgyu gcig go /dge slong ma la pham brgyad lhag nyi shu/ /spang ltung so gsum ltung byed brgya brgyad cu/ /sor bshags bcu gcig nyes byas brgya bcu gnyis/ /sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi mdo tsam mo/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya yongs su sbyong ba'i tshul/ /gso sbyong dbyar gnas dgag dbye gos kyi gzhi/ /ko lpags gnas mal sman sogs gzhan du shes/ /mdor na ye nas gnang dang bkag pa med/ /byar rung dang nye mi rung ldog byed na/ /de dag spyod cig mi rung dang nye zhing / /rung ba ldog na kun tu spangs zhes gsung/ /skye ba'i rten ni mu stegs mtshams med byas/ /sgra mi snyan dang za ma mtshan gnyis dang / /ma ning rigs lnga mtshan gsum gyur pa dang / /sprul pa ma gtogs gling gsum skyes pa yi/ /skyes pa bud med sdom pa'i rten du 'dod// tha mar nyams na gso ba'i tshul bshad pa/ /gtong ba bslab pa phul dang sh+lau 'phos dang / /mtshan gnyis gcig car byung dang lan gsum gyur/ /rgyu 'bras med ltas rtsa ba chad rnams lci/ /nyi shu ma lon bsnyen rdzogs rjes su shes/ /dge slong sdom gtong rten phyir khas blangs 'das/ /dge slong ma'o mtshan 'das bsnyen gnas kyi/ /sdom pa gtong rnams so sor thun mong min/ /rtsa ltung byung dang dam chos nub na'ang
༄khu/ /gtong / / kha che'i yul gyi bye brag smra ba rnams/ /sdom ldan rtsa ltung byung ba gnyis ldan na/ /nor ldan bu lon can bzhin 'dod pa dang / /kha cig rtsa bzhi gcig spyad kun nyams zer/ /dang po'i las can sems zhabrug tshor bas gzir/ /bsgrubs par ma nus pa la nyes pa med/ /'chab pa zhes grags gsang ste mi brjod pa/ /pham pa 'chab bcas tshe 'dir gso mi rung / /'chab pa med na dngos po brjod pa yis/ /dge 'dun la bshags mthong sdom bar gyis 'dag /sdom pa slar nod lhag ma bcu gsum sogs/ /lci yang ma ltos bshags te rim par ldang / /mdor na stobs bzhir ma 'dus bshags pa med/ /sngar byas 'gyod bshags khong du dug song ltar/ /'gyod pa snying nas rnam par sun 'byin stobs/ /dug la sman bzhin 'jug pa drag po yis/ /nyes phyir dge ba'i gnyen po kun spyod stobs/ /dug mi 'thung ltar phyis nas nyes sdom la/ /nges shes drag po rnam par sor chud stobs/ /sman pa bsten ltar skyabs sems ltung bshags sogs/ /dad pa drag pos rten gyi stobs bzhi spyad/ /'on kyang sdig ltung stobs ldan res spyod na/ /sa thob yun du 'gor bas mig ltar bsrung phan yon nad dang rgyal po'i ched phyir blangs/ /rkyen 'ga' sel kyang 'jig skyob tshul khrims yin/ /phyi ma'i ched blangs legs smon tshul khrims zhes/ /lha mi'i bde 'bras thob kyang thar pa min/ /nges par
'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdom ldan na/ /dgra bcom thob pa dga' bo'i rnam thar bzhin/ /skyabs gsum 'dzin sogs yon tan phyi ma mchog /snga ma phyi ma'i thun mong lam yin phyir/ /sems bskyed sngags kyi gdul bya'ang de dang mtshungs/ /de phyir yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin/ /'dul ba so thar gyi rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //rmya/ bskal bzang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa thub chen des/ /bya rgod phung sogs theg chen rigs can la/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dpag yas gsungs/ /'jam dbyangs bka' bsdus klu sgrub sogs kyis bkral/ /zhi ba lhas spel zab mo lta ba'i lugs/ /byams pas bka' bsdus thogs med sku mched bkral/ /jo bo rjes spel rgya chen spyod pa'i srol/ /pad+ma'i ring lugs nā ga rdzu na mthun/ /ngo bo byams dang snying rjes rgyud brlan cing / /gzhan gyi don du byang chub thob 'dod pas/ /sgo gsum nyes pa spong ba'i sems dpa'o/ /dbye ba klu sgrub thogs med srol gnyis grags/ /re rer gcig nas drug bar gnyis gnyis te/ /dang po stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /tshogs gnyis bslab pa kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab gsum dang tshogs sbyor mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed dang / /ma dag sa bdun lhag bsam dag pa dang / /dag pa sa gsum rnam par smin pa dang / /thugs rje chen po sgrib kun spangs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas sa yi sems
༄༅/ /bskyed dag dang bzhi/ /lnga ni lam lnga drug ni phar phyin drug /sa gser zla ba me sogs nyer gnyis ni/ /sa mtshams kyis phye sa bcu'i bar du'o/ /kun kyang bsdu na smon 'jug rnam pa gnyis/ /de yang bsam pas smon dang sbyor bas khyab/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba ji bzhin no/ /dang po sdom pa ma thob thob tshul ni/ /len tshul sdom gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /theg chen snod gyur dad ldan slob ma yis/ /yan lag bdun mthar smon 'jug stabs gcig tu/ /len cing rang gzhan dga' ba sgom pa rnams/ /klu sgrub lugs yin thogs med bzhed pa ni/ /smon sems len la so thar mi dgos kyang / /yang dag blangs pa rigs bdun sngon song nas bar chad dri dang bslab pa khas len sogs/ /smon 'jug cho ga so so'i sgo nas len/ /rgyal ba'i rten la'ang rung bar srol gnyis mthun/ /thob mtshams brjod pa gsum gyi mtha' la'o/ /don dam sems bskyed cho gas blangs thob pa/ /gsang sngags lugs yin mdo las bshad srid na/ /dam bca' nyid yin bsgom pa'i stobs las skye/ /bar du mi nyams bsrung ba'i thabs bshad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gsum yin te/ /nyes spyod sdom dang dge ba chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed gsum las dang po ni/ /dkon mchog dkor 'phrog dang ni chos spong las/ /tshul ldan tshul 'chal khrims gcod bslab 'bebs sogs/ /
mtshams med las byed log lta lnga rgyal po/ /grong ljongs grong khyer grong brdal yul 'khor rnams/ /'joms par byed pa'ang blon por nges pa lnga/ /ma sbyangs stong nyid brjod sngas nyan thos smon/ /rdzogs byang phyir ldog theg dman sems bskyed dang / /so thar spangs nas theg chen slob pa dang / /nyan thos theg pas chags sogs mi zlog pas/ /de zlog de yi 'bras bu med par byas/ /phrag dog dbang gis bdag bstod gzhan smod dang rnyed dang bkur sti'i ched du bdag 'tshong dang / /dge slong chad pas gcod 'jug sug 'bul dang / /spong ba'i longs spyod kha ton pa la byin/ /zhi gnas 'dor bcug phal la 'byung nges brgyad/ /de der 'byung nye'i bzhag gi kun la kun/ /ming du bco brgyad rdzas su bcu bzhi ste/ /smon 'jug sems btang de rnams rtsa ltung yin/ /yan lag nyes byas brgyad cu la sogs pa/ /phra phyir 'dir ni ma bshad bslab btus blta/ /thogs med lugs kyi smon pa'i bslab bya la/ /sems can blos mi gtong dang phan yon 'dra/ /tshogs bsags byang sems sbyang la brtson pa dang / /dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor smon pa'i yin/ /mchod 'os bslu dang 'gyod med 'gyod pa skyed/ /dam par skur 'debs 'gro la g.yo sgyu spyod/ /nag po'i chos bzhi spong zhing ldog pa ni/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi yin pa rgyal bas gsungs/ /rnyed bkur lhag zhen bdag bstod gzhan smod
༄tshi/ /dang / / ser snas zang zing chos dang nor mi ster/ khro bas gzhan 'tshe bshad sbyang gis mi ldog /g.yom las chos ltar bcos mos ston pa bzhi/ /rtsa ltung bzhi ste 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /nyes byas phra ba zhe drug gzhan du shes/ /dge ba chos sdud phar phyin drug slob ste/ /dbul ba sel phyir chos nor mi 'jigs sbyin/ /spong ba'i sems kyis tshul khrims rnam gsum spyod/ khong khro zab mo sdug bsngal bzod par bya/ /go cha dge sdud gzhan phan brtson 'grus brtsam/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bsam gtan bsgom/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab zab mo spyad/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims bsdu dngos bzhi/ /thog mar sbyin pas gdul bya rab bsdus nas/ /snyan par smra ba'i gtam gyis yid rab drang / /theg pa rim dgur bkri ba don spyod de/ /de dag 'dren phyir rang yang don de spyod/ /mthun phyogs kun slob mi mthun mtha' dag spang / /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod bsten/ /'gro 'dug za nyal spyod lam rnam pa bzhir/ /spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo sde ltar/ /gang byed rigs mthun tshig gis smon lam 'debs/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug klong chen rab 'byams ni/ /smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing / /'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug spyod/ /bsdu na dkar nag chos brgyad 'du zhes gsungs/ /'dir ni phan dang bde ba rnams bya zhing / /'dir yang mi
phan phyi mar gnod pa spang / /srol gnyis bslab byar ma 'dus med ces smra/ /skye ba'i rten ni lha klu 'phrog ma sogs/ /sdig can la yang skye bar klu sgrub bzhed/ /thogs med de'i rten so thar dgos zhes gsungs/ /spyir na sangs rgyas chos la dad byed cing / /'bras bu bla med byang chub la dad pa/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshor dad byed na// byang sems skye bar dkon mchog tā lar gsungs/ /tha mar nyams na gso ba'i tshul bshad pa/ /gang gis rigs dang mi rigs ma brtags par/ /rtsom mam bzlog gam btang snyoms 'jog kyang rung / /'os las 'das byed thams cad ltung ba'i sde/ /don chen bsgrub la chung btang gzugs brnyan te// nus pa'i yul min thams cad ltung ba med/ /mi nus der brtson de yi gzugs brnyan yin/ /gzhan phyir phan na lus ngag mi dge bdun/ /gnang ba'i skabs yod don la dge ba yin/ /thun 'das nyams na 'phags pa nam snying la/ /tho rangs gsol btab rmi lam ltung ba chags/ /lhag ma phung po gsum pa nyin mtshan du/ /lan gsum bton pas gzhil ba klu sgrub lugs// smon pa'i sems ni nag po'i chos bzhi spyad/ /sems can snying nas blos btang de gtong 'gyur/ /rgyun mi chad spyod ngo tsha khrel med dang / /des mgu dga' dang de nyid yon tan du/ /lta ba kun dkris chen pos sdom pa 'joms/ /pham pa zhes brjod chung dang 'bring la min/ /phas pham byung na
༄tshi/ /slar blang 'bring ni gsum/ /tha ma gcig mdun dngos po brjod pas bshags/ /mthun pa'i gang zag med na yid kyis bsdam/ / rgya chen spyod pa'i ring lugs zla med do// 'di 'dra'i byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin na/ /gnyid sogs bag med gyur la'ang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi chad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur/ /grangs med gsum bdun so gsum byang chub thob/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed kyi bslab bya bshad pa'i rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// 7/ kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang ston pa des/ /'og min chen por rgyud sde rgya mtsho gsungs/ /phyis nas 'bras spungs sogs su bzlas te bstan/ /phyag rdor dang ni zhu ba'i 'khor gyis bsdus/ /grub chen brgyad sogs rgya bod mkhas pas bkral/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs bka' gter grags pa dang / /gsar ma'i bzhed srol dpag tu med na yang / /rgyud sde spyi yi dam tshig 'dir 'chad de/ /ngo bo sgo gsum thabs shes kyis zin par/ /bsdams pa'i tshul khrims so so'i ring lugs bzhin/ /dbye ba bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bzhir/ /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi so sor grangs nges pa/ /dus kyi 'khor lor bshad pa gzhan du blta/ /bla med lugs la brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ /rigs lnga'i sdom pa rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / /sbom po dang ni rdzogs pa chen po'i srol/ /dang po ma thob 'thob pa'i tshul bshad pa/ /rdul tshon dang ni de bzhin bha
ga dang / /kun rdzob don dam byang sems dkyil 'khor bzhir/ /bum pa gsang ba shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang / /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob bur rim pas bskur/ /sad rmi gnyid stug snyoms 'jug gnas skabs bzhis/ /skyed pa'i sgo gsum shes bya'i dri ma sbyang / /bskyed rim gtum mo dpe don ye shes gnyis/ /bsgom dang sku bzhi thob pa'i nus rung bya/ /dang po gnas gsum rdo rje gsum bskyed nas/ /tha ma dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa thob cing de yi rjes/ khas blangs sdom dang dam tshig bslab la 'bad/ /bar du mi nyams bsrung ba'i thabs bshad pa/ /thog ma'i brtul zhugs dus kyi 'bor lo las/ /gsod rdzun brku dang 'dod log chang 'thung ba/ /spang bya bslab pa'i gzhi lnga spang zhes gsungs/ /cho lo kha na ma tho'i zas za dang / /ngan tshig 'byung po lha min chos bslab pa/ /rnam pa lnga ni bya ba min lnga'o/ /ba lang byis pa skyes pa bud med dang mchod rten bsnun pa gsod pa lnga ru grags/ /dge grogs rje bo sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang / /bla mar khong khro sgom rnams 'khu ba lnga/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yul lnga la/ /mig dang rna ba sna l+le lus dbang lnga/ /zhen par mi byed brtul zhugs nyer lnga'o/ /thun mong gyur pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa lnga/ /smon 'jug gnyis dang tshul khrims rnam pa gsum/ /slob pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa'o/ /rdor dril phyag rgya bla mar gzung rdo rje/ /
༄tshi/ /nor chos mi 'jigs byams sbyin rin chen 'byung / /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg 'dzin pad+ma'i rigs/ /mchod gtor las rim 'dzin pa las kyi'o/ khyad par srog gcod rdo rje rigs yin te/ /zhing bcu tshang dang rlung dang rtog pa yin/ /rin chen rigs la ma byin len pa ni/ /nor dang bud med theg chen zab mo'i chos/ /rang dang g.yin don bsgrub la dgongs pas gsungs/ /pad+ma'i rigs la las chos dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya che ste bud med bsten par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs la rdzun du smra gsungs pa/ /bdag dang sems can mi dmigs bden med ston/ /'khor lo'i rigs la chang dang sha lnga dang / /yul kun bsten gsungs phyi nang gsang ba'i theg rim pa ma nyams spyod pa bla med lugs/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi bstan pa ni/ /slob dpon rnam gsum snying nas smod pa dang / /brnyas dang thugs dkrugs ltung ba'i sgo kun las/ /shin tu lpi phyir 'di nyid dang por bshad/ /blang dor gnas ston bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'/ /bla mas gsungs shing rang gis go bzhin du/ khyad gsod mi mthun spyod 'brel bka' 'das gnyis/ /spyi ring nye dang nang 'dres spun la khros// 'khon 'dzin phrag dog brnyas sogs gsum pa'o/ /sems can bde ba kun dang bral na bsam/ /snying nas byams pa btang ba bzhi pa'o/ /'dod chags sems kyis gnas skabs ma yin par/ /bsam bzhin khu ba 'byin dang
