sems can la/ /byang chub sems bskyed btang ba lnga pa yin/ /lam tshol mu stegs lam zhugs nyan rang dang / /lam chen theg chen grub mthar smod na drug /snod dang cho ga ma byas ma rdzogs dang / /nyams dang zab mos 'jigs lngar gsang sgrogs bdun/ /phung lnga sangs rgyas lnga la brnyas pa yis/ /smod dang gdung ba bskyed na brgyad pa yin/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rang bzhin dag pa la/ /bkri bar the tshom za ba dgu par bshad/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba nus bzhin du/ /mi sgrol bu dang byams par byed na bcu/ /ming sogs bral la dngos dang dngos med rtog /rtog ges 'jal bar byed na bcu gcig pa'o/ /dad gsum ldan pa'i sems can don mi byed/ /sems mi bsrung dang bslu ba bcu gnyis pa/ /skabs bab yo byad longs spyod dam tshig rdzas/ /dus tshod 'brel kyang mi bsten bcu gsum pa/ /spyi dang bye brag la ltos shes rab ma/ /ngos lkog snying tshim smad go bcu bzhi pa'o/ /da ni yan lag sbom po'i ltung ba bshad/ /dbang dang dam tshig ma smin rig ma bsten/ /tshogs kyi 'bor lo'i dus su lus ngag rtsod/ /ma gsung rig mar rang stobs bdud rtsi len/ /snod ldan slob mar gsang sngags mi ston dang / /dad ldan chos dri ba la chos gzhan ston/ /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun longs par bsdad/ /rnal 'byor ye shes mi ldan sngags par rlom/ /snod min la bshad yan lag ltung ba
༄tshi/ /brgyad / / bsnyen sogs ma byas dbang rab las sogs 'jug /phyi chos mos la lus kyi phyag rgya bstan/ /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas las dgos med 'da'/ /zhes sogs sbom po'i ltung ba du ma rnams/ /yod kyang nyes pa chung zhes dus 'khor bshad/ khyad par snga 'gyur rdzogs pa chen po'i srol/ /rtsa ba bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum la/ /dgu dgur phye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / /yan lag dam tshig nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /ta na ga na ma byin len dang rdzun/ /ngag 'khyal rnams ni spyad par bya ba lnga/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog rnams ni mi spang dam tshig lnga/ /dri chen dri chu rak+ta maX sa dang / /rdo rje'i zil pa dang du blang ba lnga/ /phung lnga 'byung lnga yul lnga dbang po lnga/ kha dog lnga rnams lha ru shes pa lnga/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje rin po che/ /pad+ma las rigs bsgrub bya lnga rnams ni/ /dus tshod 'brel ba'i spyod pas dgongs pa blang / /de sogs dam tshig rnam gzhag mang gsungs pa/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas 'dir ma 'dus med/ /mdor na rang lus rdo rje gsum shes na/ /sngags kyi dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde 'dus/ /skye ba'i rten ni nyin bzhin bram ze gsod/ /mtshams med lnga byed la sogs kun la'o/ /tha mar nyams na gso ba'i tshul bshad pa/ /lhung mtshams mi shes bla ma sogs mi gus/ /bag med spyod cing nyon mongs mang ba bzhi/ /lhung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhir thogs med
bzhed de yi gnyen por bslab byar slob pa dang / /kun la gus bskyed rtag par dran shes bsten/ /nyon mongs gang che'i gnyen por 'bad de bslab/ /spang bya bzhi steng brjed ngas dran mi gsal/ /gnyis bsnan dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu drug ces/ /dpal ldan sdom pa'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs/ /kun la yul bsam sbyor ba mthar thug gam/ /kun slong nyon mongs gang 'gal der shes dang / /lus ngag sbyor byas dngos gzhi'i bar chod pa/ /ma 'khrul spyad dang 'gyod med bshags tshad 'das/ /pham pa zhes brjod dngos gzhi ma tshang na/ /thun 'das ltung ba zhes brjod lhag ma ltar/ /rim pas dman na sbom po ltung byed dang / /nyes byas ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan shes par bya/ /kun la dbang nyams bya ba gzhan gyis dang / /don chen skye med brten dang dgos ldan dang / /nus rnyed gnang dang bka' bsgo bar chad las/ /nyes pa med ces snying po rgyan las gsungs de ltar nyin mtshan thun la lan drug tu/ /spang blang dam tshig gnas la bsgrims te dpyad/ /drug cha 'das na thun tshod 'das zhes bya/ /zhag gcig zla gcig lo gcig lo gnyis 'das/ /'gal nyams 'das ral zhes brjod de dag kyang / /snying nas bshags na gsor rung phyi rim lci/ /lo gsum 'das na gsor mi rung ba yin/ /dbang bdun thob la lha grangs re re la/ /bzlas pa sum khri drug stong byas pas 'byongs/ /bum
༄tshi/ /gsang thob nyams sngon du chad las sbyang / /de rjes dkyil 'khor zhugs la dbang bzhi len/ /sher dbang tshig dbang thob nyams bskyed rim dang / /'pho med tshul khrims rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / /rang rgyud byin rlabs ma gtogs gzhan mi 'dag/ 'gal na tshogs 'khor nyams na bdog pas bskang / /'das na bu dang chung ma nor sogs dang / /ral na rang gi srog gis gso bar bshad/ /snying po rgyan las gso ba'i cho ga ni tshogs zhing la bshags dral ba'i sngags rgya dang / /bkru ba'i rim pa gtum mo'i mes sreg dang / /mi dmigs bsgom dang dbang bzhi blang ba dang / /tshogs su zhu dang rten la smre ba dang / /maṇ+ḍal 'bul dang mchod rten bya ba dang / /me la sbyang dang gtor ma gtong ba dang / /gsang sngags bzla dang zab mo'i bsam gtan dang / /srog skyob bka' klog bla ma bsten pa dang / /bdag 'jug rgyal ba'i yig brgya dus bzang bzla/ /phung po gsum pa rdor sems bla ma dang / /thig le phra ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas gso/ /glang chen rab 'bog rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor spyi khrus 'gyod tshangs dong sprug gi /bshags pas mi 'dag med phyir nyams su blangs/ /ma bshags tshe 'dir yid mi 'ong bas mnar/ /phyi ma rdo rje'i dmyal ba zhes bya ba/ /mnar med do zla med pa'i gnas su skye/ /ma nyams ring mtha' skye ba bcu drug gam/ /myur na tshe 'di'i 'chi kha bar do rtswa /
thun mong grub pa brgyad dang dbang phyug brgyad/ /mchog gi dngos grub kha sbyor bdun ldan thob/ /de phyir rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o// rmya/ de lta'i sdom gsum gang zag rgyud gcig la/ /rang ldog ma 'dres dgag dgos yongs su rjerdzogs/ /ngo bo gnas 'gyur yon tan yar ldan pas/ /gnad kyis mi 'gal dus skabs gang gtsor spyad/ /de yang blang yul bsam pa cho ga rnams/ /so sor nges phyir rang ldog ma 'dres yin/ /dgag bya nyon mongs dgos pa mi 'ching bar/ /rang rang lam gyi ngos nas yongs su rdzogs/ /spong bsgyur lam du khyer ba so sor yang / /nyon mongs rang mtshan spong bar mkhas rnams mthun/ /so thar kun slong sems bskyed kyis zin na/ /nyes spyod sdom pa zhes bya'i tshul khrims yin/ /dbang thob rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sdom par 'gyur/ /de phyir ngo bo gnas 'gyur yin no zhes 'bum phrag lnga pa'i lung gis gsal bar grub/ /'jig rten rnal 'byor rnal 'gyor blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma kong mas gnod phyir 'og ma yi/ /yon tan yar ldan 'og ma zil gyis gnon/ /'du shes gsum gyis 'khrig na rnal 'byor de/ /yul bsam sbyor ba mthar thug ma tshang bas/ /rmi lam ji bzhin gnad kyis 'gal mi srid/ /sdig to mi dge'i phyogs dang tshogs pa'i gseb/ /'og ma gtsor byed 'dod pas dben pa dang / /
༄༅/ /spyod pa'i dus dang dben par gsang sngags spyad/ /nang ma 'doms na ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bsrung / /'dom na dgag dgos brtsi zhes mkhas rnams bzhed/ /las dang po dang rnal 'byor grub thob dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod pa gang yin pa/ /dus tshod 'brel ba dgos zhes dus 'khor bshad/ /yon tan gzhi rten so thar gang nus steng / /byang chub sems bskyed sngags kyi yan lag yin/ /smin byed dbang thob sdom gsum mig ltar bsrung / /gdan gsum lha ru shes pa'i bskyed rim dang / /mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom/ /nye rgyu'i spyod pas rim bzhin mtshams sbyar na/ /'di'am 'chi kha dang ni bar do rtswa /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /sdom gsum spyir bshad pa'i rim par phye ba ste lnga pa'o// rmya/ deng sang ma sbyangs mu cor smra ba brgyas/ /rang gi ye shes rdul tsam ma rtogs par/ /rang bze'i cho gas rmongs rnams tshim pa'i dus/ /skyabs de bsams kyin snying nas mchi ma dku/ /mdo sngags lam rnams mu med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /tshang la ma nor lam 'di rgyal bas gsungs/ /gangs can 'di na de dag phyogs rer 'dzin/ /gcig tu sems kyang sdom gsum ming tsam lus/ /'di ni mkhas grub du ma'i legs bshad las/ /sgrin po'i blo yis phyogs gcig dag tu bkod/ /de phyir nongs pa'i dri ma med snyam rlom/ /dge des kun bzang go 'phang myur thob
gogab/ cesasdom gsum rnam ngesatshigagiri rim par phye ba 'di/ gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i yul ljongs lto phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba ngesapar 'byung ba'i bsam pa can/ mnga' risakyi paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma dbang gi rgyal posabakod pa phyogs dusathamasacad du rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa la bya ba byed nusapar gyur :rig/ //dge'o// //
༄tshi/ /byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs kyi par byang smon tshig bzhugs so/ /swasti/ 'di na rgyal ba nyid lhag bka' drin can/ /o rgyan rje des brtse bas gangs can pa'i/ /skal ba kho nar zab mo'i chos gter gyis/ /mtha' dbus kun tu nam mkha'i mdzod ltar gtams/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba/ /bskyed rdzogs rjesags pa'i man ngag gzhan las kyang khyad 'phags lha brag mdzod chen lnga yi gter/ /chos tshul 'di yi dza gad nying bcud la/ /spyod pa'i skal chen du ma nyams rtogs kyis/ /rab myos do ha'i rgyang glu len dang bcas/ /'pho chen 'od sku'i gar gyis gshegs par grags/ /bstan 'gro'i srog rtsa bzung ba'i las tshogs kyang / /sna mang dgos pa kun tshang 'dir mchis pas/ /bod kyi blon po lta bu'i gter yin zhes/ /che thang nyid du pad+ma'i lung gis bsngags/ /de phyir thubaX bstanaX 'dren la zla med pa'i/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas zab chos 'di'i nyi m+baX / /mi zad chos sbyin par gyi mkha' dbyings su/ /drangs par mdzad la snying nas rjes yi rangs/ /rlabs su che ba'i bstan pa'i bya ba la dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang ḍāk+kis kyang / /dbyings nas gzigs shing dga' ba'i gar dang bcas/ /bsngags pa'i me tog char du bsnyil bar nges/ /legs byas 'di yis rgyal bstan spyi bye brag /snga
'gyur rdo rdze theg pa'i ring lugs rgyas/ /de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs zung srid mthar brtan/ /phrin las rab rgyas bzhed don yongs 'grub therdzog /dge 'dun sde yi rol mtsho rgyas pa'i dbus/ /thugs mthun khrims kyi lhun po rmang nas brling / /bslab gsum la gnas bang rim rnam par brjid/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i rna chas rtag mdzes shog /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par swa la'i ljongs/ /mi zad dus kyi rgud pa kun bral zhing / /snod bcud dge mtshan lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /'dir 'bad 'brel bcas skye bar dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin spyod dang dge ba'i mthun rkyen yang / /yang dag 'byor sogs rten 'brel phun tshogs la/ /la 'ur 'jug nas byang chen myur 'thob rtsosnog /lam mchog 'di yang yongs 'du'i 'khri shong ltar/ /phrin las yal 'dab nam mkha'i bla brer bres/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i char gyis nor 'dzin khye1na/ /'gengs pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan phre(ga /ces pa'i par byang smon tshig g.yar khral tsam zhig rdo brag rig 'dzin bla ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs tsam phog pa'i mañdza'i ming can nas shin tu dga' gus yi rangs kyi ngang nas bris te zla tshes bzang po la phul ba dge legs 'phel// //
